explanation: On account of his deep attachment for Sita, he shed profuse tears. Unable to maintain his natural composure, he sank down to the ground, saying 'O my darling Sita' and cried inconsolably

shloka_text: हृदि कृत्वा तु बहुशस्तमलङ्कारमुत्तमम्। निशश्वास भृशं सर्पो बिलस्थ इव रोषितः।।4.6.18।।
explanation: Pressing the excellent ornaments to his bosom again and again Rama hissed like a cobra provoked in its anthill.

shloka_text: अविच्छिन्नाश्रुवेगस्तु सौमित्रिं वीक्ष्य पार्श्वतः। परिदेवयितुं दीनं रामस्समुपचक्रमे4.6.19।।
explanation: Rama began to wail piteously while tears streamed down his eyes incessantly. He looked at Saumitri standing by his side and said:

shloka_text: पश्य लक्ष्मण वैदेह्या सन्त्यक्तं ह्रियमाणया। उत्तरीयमिदं भूमौ शरीराद्भूषणानि च4.6.20।।
explanation: 'O Lakshmana, behold the veil and the ornaments dropped on the ground by Vaidehi while she was being abducted.

shloka_text: शाद्वलिन्यां ध्रुवं भूमौ सीतया ह्रियमाणया। उत्सृष्टं भूषणमिदं तथारूपं हि दृश्यते4.6.21।।
explanation: 'Sita, for sure, dropped these ornaments on the grassy ground. They are in good shape (without any damage).

shloka_text: एवमुक्तस्तु रामेण लक्ष्मणो वाक्यमब्रवीत्। नाहं जानामि केयूरे नाहं जानामि कुण्डले4.6.22।। नूपुरे त्वभिजानामि नित्यं पादाभिवन्दनात्।
explanation: Thus addressed by Rama, Lakshmana replied, 'I recognise neither the armlets nor the earrings. I only recognise the anklets as I used to bow at her feet daily.'

shloka_text: ततस्तु राघवो वाक्यं सुग्रीवमिदमब्रवीत्4.6.23।। ब्रूहि सुग्रीव कं देशं ह्रियन्ती लक्षिता त्वया। रक्षसा रौद्ररूपेण मम प्राणैः प्रिया प्रिया4.6.24।।
explanation: Then Rama said to Sugriva,.'Tell me, O Sugriva, to which region that fiercelooking demon has carried away my Sita, who is dearer than my life.

shloka_text: ततस्तु राघवो वाक्यं सुग्रीवमिदमब्रवीत्4.6.23।। ब्रूहि सुग्रीव कं देशं ह्रियन्ती लक्षिता त्वया। रक्षसा रौद्ररूपेण मम प्राणैः प्रिया प्रिया4.6.24।।
explanation: Then Rama said to Sugriva,.'Tell me, O Sugriva, to which region that fiercelooking demon has carried away my Sita, who is dearer than my life.

shloka_text: क्व वा वसति तद्रक्षो महद्व्यसनदं मम। यन्निमित्तमहं सर्वान्नाशयिष्यामि राक्षसान्4.6.25।।
explanation: 'Let me know where dwells that huge  ogre who has caused this agony to me. I will exterminate all the demons

shloka_text: हरता मैथिलीं येन मां च रोषयता भृशम्। आत्मनो जीवितान्ताय मृत्युद्वारमपावृतम्4.6.26।।
explanation: 'By abducting Maithili he has stirred my fierce anger and has opened the door of his death.

shloka_text: मम दयिततरा हृता वनान्ता द्रजनिचरेण विमथ्य येन सा। कथय मम रिपुं तमद्य वै प्लवगपते यमसादनं नयामि4.6.27।।
explanation: 'O lord of monkeys tell me the whereabouts of that nightranger who has carried off my darling from the heart of the forest and has harassed her. I will send him now to the abode of Death. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे षष्ठस्सर्गः Thus ends the sixth sarga of Kishkindakanda of the Holy Ramayana,  the first epic, composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: एवमुक्तस्तु सुग्रीवो रामेणार्तेन वानरः। अब्रवीत्प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यं सबाष्पं बाष्पगद्गदः।।4.7.1।।
explanation: On hearing the words of Rama in deep distress, the monkey replied to him with folded hands, his throat choked with tears:

shloka_text: न जाने निलयं तस्य सर्वथा पापरक्षसः। सामर्थ्यं विक्रमं वापि दौष्कुलेयस्य वा कुलम्4.7.2।।
explanation: 'I do not have any knowledge of this sinful demon's dwelling , his capability, his valour or his clan or his despicable lineage.

shloka_text: सत्यं ते प्रतिजानामि त्यज शोकमरिन्दम। करिष्यामि तथा यत्नं यथा प्राप्स्यसि मैथिलीम्4.7.3।।
explanation: 'O subduer of enemies, give up sorrow. I promise I will make necessary effort so that you will obtain the princess from Mithila.

shloka_text: रावणं सगणं हत्वा परितोष्यात्मपौरुषम्। तथाऽस्मि कर्ता न चिराद्यथा प्रीतो भविष्यसि4.7.4।।
explanation: 'With all my capability I will kill Ravana and his clan. Thus I will be able to satisfy you soon with my efforts.

shloka_text: अलं वैक्लब्यमालम्ब्य धैर्यमात्मगतं स्मर। त्वद्विधानां न सदृशमीदृशं बुद्धिलाघवम्।।4.7.5।।
explanation: 'Give up despair. It is enough. Be patient. Maintain your natural disposition.It is unworthy of men like you to entertain such frivolus thoughts?

shloka_text: मयाऽपि व्यसनं प्राप्तं भार्याविरहजं महत्। नाहमेवं हि शोचामि न च धैर्यं परित्यजे4.7.6।।
explanation: 'Separated from my wife, I, too, am afflicted with deep grief. But I do not brood, I do not lose patience.

shloka_text: नाहं तामनुशोचामि प्राकृतो वानरोऽपि सन्। महात्मा च विनीतश्च किं पुनर्धृतिमान्भवान्4.7.7।।
explanation: 'I am an ordinary monkey born. Even then, I do not brood over my wife. You are highsouled, humble and patient. Why do you grieve?

shloka_text: बाष्पमापतितं धैर्यान्निग्रहीतुं त्वमर्हसि। मर्यादां सत्त्वयुक्तानां धृतिं नोत्स्रष्टुमर्हसि4.7.8।।
explanation: 'Restrain the flow of your tears. Be  patient. Men (like you) endowed with  equilibrium and dignity and patience ought not to leave their composure.

shloka_text: व्यसने वाऽर्थकृच्छ्रे वा भये वा जीवितान्तके। विमृशन्वै स्वया बुद्ध्या धृतिमान्नावसीदति4.7.9।।
explanation: 'In times of grief or loss of wealth or at the hour of death, one who is patient does not abandon his wisdom, he does not despair.

shloka_text: बालिशस्तु नरो नित्यं वैक्लब्यं योऽनुवर्तते। स मज्जत्यवशश्शोके भाराक्रान्तेव नौर्जले4.7.10।।
explanation: A man who is unwise and distraught only gets sunk in grief like a heavily loaded boat (sinks) in water.

shloka_text: एषोऽञ्जलिर्मया बद्धः प्रणयात्त्वां प्रसादये। पौरुषं श्रय शोकस्य नान्तरं दातुमर्हसि4.7.11।।
explanation: 'I implore you with folded palms on account of our friendship to show manliness. You should not give in to grief.

shloka_text: ये शोकमनुवर्तन्ते न तेषां विद्यते सुखम्। तेजश्च क्षीयते तेषां न त्वं शोचितुमर्हसि4.7.12।।
explanation: 'There is no happiness for those who give way to sorrow. Their brilliance is dimmed. Therefore, you ought not grieve.

shloka_text: शोकेनाभिप्रपन्नस्य जीविते चापि संशयः। स शोकं त्यज राजेन्द्र धैर्यमाश्रय केवलम्4.7.13।।
explanation: 'Even the chances of survival are doubtful for a man who is overpowered by sorrow. Give up sorrow and have patience, O king

shloka_text: हितं वयस्यभावेन ब्रूमि नोपदिशामि ते। वयस्यतां पूजयन्मे न त्वं शोचितुमर्हसि4.7.14।।
explanation: 'Out of friendly concern I offer my opinion in your interest. I am not competent to advise you. Respecting my friendship, you should never yield to grief.'

shloka_text: मधुरं सान्त्वित स्तेन सुग्रीवेण स राघवः। मुखमश्रुपरिक्लिन्नं वस्त्रान्तेन प्रमार्जयत्4.7.15।।
explanation: Consoled by the sweet words of Sugriva, Rama wiped his face filled with tears by the hem of his upper cloth.

shloka_text: प्रकृतिस्थस्तु काकुत्स्थस्सुग्रीववचनात्प्रभुः। सम्परिष्वज्य सुग्रीवमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्4.7.16।।
explanation: When lord Rama, the scion of the Kakutstha race was comforted by these words of Sugriva, he came to his senses, and clasping him said:

shloka_text: कर्तव्यं यद्वयस्येन स्निग्धेन च हितेन च। अनुरूपं च युक्तं च कृतं सुग्रीव तत्त्वया4.7.17।।
explanation: 'O Sugriva you have done what a friend should have done in a befitting manner with your sweet words and good wishes.

shloka_text: एष च प्रकृतिस्थोऽहमनुनीतस्त्वया सखे। दुर्लभो हीदृशो बन्धुरस्मिन्काले विशेषतः4.7.18।।
explanation: 'O friend you have guided me back to my senses thus. It is difficult to find a friend like you specially at this time.

shloka_text: किं तु यत्नस्त्वया कार्यो मैथिल्याः परिमार्गणे। राक्षसस्य च रौद्रस्य रावणस्य दुरात्मनः4.7.19।।
explanation: 'Indeed, you must make effort to trace the princess from Mithila and the evilminded, fierce  demon Ravana.

shloka_text: मया च यदनुष्ठेयं विस्रब्धेन तदुच्यताम्। वर्षास्विव च सुक्षेत्रे सर्वं सम्पद्यते तव4.7.20।।
explanation: 'Now tell me about my duty without any hesitation. I assure you that your desire will be fulfilled, just as seeds sown in a fertile land with timely rains bear fruit.

shloka_text: मया च यदिदं वाक्यमभिमानात्समीरितम्। तत्त्वया हरिशार्दूल तत्त्वमित्युपधार्यताम्4.7.21।।
explanation: 'O tiger amongst monkeys accept my words uttered out of injured honour in their true sense.

shloka_text: अनृतं नोक्तपूर्वं मे न च वक्ष्ये कदाचन। एतत्ते प्रतिजानामि सत्येनैव च ते शपाम्यहमं।।4.7.22।।
explanation: 'I have never uttered a false word earlier nor will I do it in future. This is my promise. I swear by truth alone.'

shloka_text: ततः प्रहृष्टस्सुग्रीवो वानरैस्सचिवैस्सह। राघवस्य वचश्श्रुत्वा प्रतिज्ञातं विशेषतः4.7.23।।
explanation: Sugriva and his counsellors felt glad on hearing Rama's words, particularly  the assurance given by him.

shloka_text: एवमेकान्तसम्पृक्तौ ततस्तौ नरवानरौ। उभावन्योन्यसदृशं सुखं दुःखमभाषताम्4.7.24।।
explanation: Man and monkey then met privately and shared the weal and woe of one another.

shloka_text: महानुभावस्य वचो निशम्य हरिर्नृपाणामृषभस्य तस्य। कृतं स मेने हरिवीरमुख्य स्तदा स्वकार्यं हृदयेन विद्वान्4.7.25।।
explanation: Wise Sugriva, chief of monkeys, heard the words of the magnanimous Rama, a bull among men. He felt glad at heart thinking that his task has been achieved. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे सप्तमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the seventh sarga of Kishkindakanda of the Holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by the sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: परितुष्टस्तु सुग्रीवस्तेन वाक्येन वानरः। लक्ष्मणस्याग्रतो राममिदं वचनमब्रवीत्4.8.1।।
explanation: Sugriva, the monkey was very pleased with Rama's words and said to him in front of Lakshmana:

shloka_text: सर्वथाऽहमनुग्राह्यो देवतानां न संशयः। उपपन्न गुणोपेतस्सखा यस्य भवान्मम4.8.2।।
explanation: 'Since one like you endowed with all virtues has become my friend I am (now) worthy of grace of the gods in all respects. There is no doubt.

shloka_text: शक्यं खलु भवेद्राम सहायेन त्वयाऽनघ। सुरराज्यमपि प्राप्तुं स्वराज्यं किं पनः प्रभो 4.8.3।।
explanation: 'O Rama, my sinless Lord, it is possible to attain even the kingdom of the gods with your help, what  to speak of my own kingdom?

shloka_text: सोऽहं सभाज्यो बन्धूनां सुहृदां चैव राघव। यस्याग्निसाक्षिकं मित्रं लब्धं राघववंशजम्4.8.4।।
explanation: 'O Rama, since you, born in Raghava dynasty, have become my friend with fire as witness, I have become equally honourable among my relatives and friends.

shloka_text: अहमप्यनुरूपस्ते वयस्यो ज्ञास्यसे शनैः। न तु वक्तुं समर्थोऽहं स्वयमात्मगतान्गुणान्4.8.5।।
explanation: 'You will come to know slowly that I am also a friend worthy of you.It is not proper for me to speak of my qualities( flatter myself).

shloka_text: महात्मनां तु भूयिष्ठं त्वद्विधानां कृतात्मनाम्। निश्चला भवति प्रीतिर्धैर्यमात्मवतामिव4.8.6।।
explanation: 'The affection of exalted souls is exceedingly stable like the patience of  selfcontrolled and wellcomposed men like you.

shloka_text: रजतं वा सुवर्णं वा वस्त्राण्याभरणानि च। अविभक्तानि साधूनामवगच्छन्ति साधवः4.8.7।।
explanation: 'Good friends consider(valuables such as) silver or gold, clothes or ornaments of worldly wealth indivisible.

shloka_text: आढ्यो वापि दरिद्रो वा दुःखितस्सुखितोऽपि वा। निर्दोषो वा सदोषो वा वयस्यः परमा गतिः4.8.8।।
explanation: 'Whether rich or poor, afflicted or happy, flawless or guilty, a friend is the ultimate refuge to a friend.

shloka_text: धनत्यागस्सुखत्यागो देहत्यागोऽपि वा पुनः। वयस्यार्थे प्रवर्तन्ते स्नेहं दृष्टवा तथाविधम्4.8.9।।
explanation: 'One will not hesitate to sacrifice wealth or happiness or even life for the sake of a friend like you.'

shloka_text: तत्तथेत्यब्रवीद्रामस्सुग्रीवं प्रियवादिनम्। लक्ष्मणस्याग्रतो लक्ष्म्या वासवस्येव धीमतः4.8.10।।
explanation: As wise Lakshmana, brilliant like Indra stood witness, Rama said, 'it is true as you say' to Sugriva who spoke pleasing words.

shloka_text: ततो रामं स्थितं दृष्ट्वा लक्ष्मणं च महाबलम्। सुग्रीवस्सर्वतश्चक्षुर्वने लोलमपातयत्4.8.11।।
explanation: With mighty Rama and Lakshmana standing by, Sugriva cast his eyes eagerly all round the forest.

shloka_text: स ददर्श ततस्सालमविदूरे हरीश्वरः। सुपुष्पमीषत्पत्राढ्यं भ्रमरैरुपशोभितम्4.8.12।।
explanation: Then the chief of monkeys saw a sala tree looking lovely with tender leaves and flowers graced by bees.

shloka_text: तस्यैकां पर्णबहुलां भङ्क्त्वा शाखां सुपुष्पिताम्। सालस्यास्तीर्य सुग्रीवो निषसाद सराघवः4.8.13।।
explanation: Sugriva cut a branch of the beautifully blossomed sala tree with plenty of leaves,   spread it (on the ground) and squatted along with Rama.

shloka_text: तावासीनौ ततो दृष्ट्वा हनूमानपि लक्ष्मणम्। सालशाखां समुत्पाट्य विनीतमुपवेशयत्4.8.14।।
explanation: Thereafter Hanuman also broke a branch of the sala tree and seated Lakshmana on it.

shloka_text: सुखोपविष्टं रामं तु प्रसन्नमुदधिं यथा। फलपुष्पसमाकीर्णे तस्मिन् गिरिवरोत्तमे4.8.15।। ततः प्रहृष्टस्सुग्रीवश्लक्ष्णं मधुरया गिरा। उवाच प्रणयाद्रामं हर्षव्याकुलिताक्षरम्4.8.16।।
explanation: Now Rama, seated comfortably on the best of mountains overgrown with trees full of flowers and fruits, appeared tranguil like an ocean. Extremely delighted and excited, Sugriva spoke to Rama words that got mixed up with softness and sweetness out of love:

shloka_text: सुखोपविष्टं रामं तु प्रसन्नमुदधिं यथा। फलपुष्पसमाकीर्णे तस्मिन् गिरिवरोत्तमे4.8.15।। ततः प्रहृष्टस्सुग्रीवश्लक्ष्णं मधुरया गिरा। उवाच प्रणयाद्रामं हर्षव्याकुलिताक्षरम्4.8.16।।
explanation: Now Rama, seated comfortably on the best of mountains overgrown with trees full of flowers and fruits, appeared tranguil like an ocean. Extremely delighted and excited, Sugriva spoke to Rama words that got mixed up with softness and sweetness out of love:

shloka_text: अहं विनिकृतो भ्रात्रा चराम्येष भयार्दितः। ऋष्यमूकं गिरिवरं हृतभार्यस्सुदुःखितः4.8.17।।
explanation: 'I am sadly roaming here in the great Rishyamuka mountain, my wife stolen, offended by my brother and frightened.

shloka_text: सोऽहं त्रस्तो भये मग्नो वसाम्युद्भ्रान्तचेतनः। वालिना निकृतो भ्रात्रा कृतवैरश्च राघव4.8.18।।
explanation: 'O Rama my brother is my enemy. Deceived and threatened by him, I live in the forest stricken with fear and utterly confused.

shloka_text: वालिनो मे भयार्तस्य सर्वलोकाभयङ्कर। ममापि त्वमनाथस्य प्रसादं कर्तुमर्हसि4.8.19।।
explanation: 'O great warrior who can frighten all the worlds scared of Vali, I feel  helpless like an orphan to whom you ought to extend your grace.'

shloka_text: एवमुक्तस्तु तेजस्वी धर्मज्ञो धर्मवत्सलः। प्रत्युवाच स काकुत्स्थस्सुग्रीवं प्रहसन्निव4.8.20।।
explanation: Thus spoken to, the glorious Rama, lover of righteousness who knew his duty, replied to Sugriva with a smile on his face:

shloka_text: उपकारफलं मित्रमपकारोऽरिलक्षणम्। अद्यैव तं हनिष्यामि तव भार्यापहारिणम्4.8.21।।
explanation: 'While a friend is known for his help, an enemy is known for his offensiveness. I will this very day kill the one who wrested your wife.

shloka_text: इमे हि मे महावेगा पत्रिणस्तिग्मतेजसः। कार्तिकेयवनोद्भूताश्शरा हेमविभूषिताः4.8.22।। कङ्कपत्रपरिच्छन्ना महेन्द्राशनिसन्निभाः। सुपर्वाणस्सुतीक्ष्णाग्रास्सरोषा भुजगा इव4.8.23।।
explanation: 'Here are my highspeed, winged arrows glowing like fierce fire, born out of Kartikeya's bed of reeds.They are smooth and welljointed, decked with gold, comparable in strength to great Indra's thunderbolt, very sharp with pointed tips looking like angry serpents.

shloka_text: इमे हि मे महावेगा पत्रिणस्तिग्मतेजसः। कार्तिकेयवनोद्भूताश्शरा हेमविभूषिताः4.8.22।। कङ्कपत्रपरिच्छन्ना महेन्द्राशनिसन्निभाः। सुपर्वाणस्सुतीक्ष्णाग्रास्सरोषा भुजगा इव4.8.23।।
explanation: 'Here are my highspeed, winged arrows glowing like fierce fire, born out of Kartikeya's bed of reeds.They are smooth and welljointed, decked with gold, comparable in strength to great Indra's thunderbolt, very sharp with pointed tips looking like angry serpents.

shloka_text: भ्रातृसंज्ञममित्रं ते वालिनं कृतकिल्बिषम्। शरैर्विनिहतं पश्य विकीर्णमिव पर्वतम्4.8.24।।
explanation: 'Vali who calls himself your brother is your enemy and a doer of wrong deeds. You will see him crushed, like a mountain shattered, by my arrows.'

shloka_text: राघवस्य वचश्श्रुत्वा सुग्रीवो वाहिनीपतिः। प्रहर्षमतुलं लेभे साधु साध्विति चाब्रवीत्4.8.25।।
explanation: On hearing Rama's words, Sugriva, chief of the army of monkeys experienced immeasurable happiness and exclaimed, 'you're great, you're great.'

shloka_text: राम शोकाभिभूतोऽहं शोकार्तानां भवान्गतिः। वयस्य इति कृत्वा हि त्वय्यहं परिदेवये4.8.26।।
explanation: 'Rama I am overwhelmed with sorrow. You are the refuge of the distressed. As you are a friend I ventilate all my grief to you.

shloka_text: त्वं हि पाणिप्रदानेन वयस्यो मेऽग्निसाक्षिकम्। कृतः प्राणैर्बहुमतस्सत्येनापि शपामि ते4.8.27।।
explanation: 'I value your hand of friendship extended to me, with fire as witness more than my very life. I, on my own, offer my pledge of friendship.

shloka_text: वयस्य इति कृत्वा च विस्रब्धः प्रवदाम्यहम्। दुःखमन्तर्गतं यन्मे मनो हरति नित्यशः4.8.28।।
explanation: And considering you a friend, I speak trustingly of the inner sorrow that constantly afflicts my mind.

shloka_text: एतावदुक्त्वा वचनं बाष्पदूषितलोचनः। बाष्पोपहतया वाचा नोच्चैश्शक्नोति भाषितुम्4.8.29।।
explanation: His vision blurred, words choked with tears he was unable to speak further.

shloka_text: बाष्पवेगं तु सहसा नदीवेगमिवागतम्। धारयामास धैर्येण सुग्रीवो रामसन्निधौ4.8.30।।
explanation: Quickly Sugriva controlled his tears streaming fast like the rushing river, with patience, Rama seated in front.

shloka_text: सन्निगृह्य तु तं बाष्पं प्रमृज्य नयने शुभे। विनिश्श्वस्य च तेजस्वी राघवं वाक्यमब्रवीत्4.8.31।।
explanation: Effulgent Sugriva controlled his tears, wiped his bright eyes, took deep breath and said to Rama:

shloka_text: पुराऽहं वालिना राम राज्यात्स्वादवरोपितः। परुषाणि च संश्राव्य निर्धूतोऽस्मि बलीयसा4.8.32।।
explanation: 'O Rama I was subjected to the harsh words of powerful Vali in the past when he uprooted me from  the kingdom and threw me out.

shloka_text: हृता भार्या च मे तेन प्राणेभ्योऽपि गरीयसी। सुहृदश्च मदीया ये संयता बन्धनेषु ते4.8.33।।
explanation: 'I was robbed of my wife who is dearer than my own life. All my friends were rounded up and imprisoned.

shloka_text: यत्नवांश्च सुदुष्टात्मा मद्विनाशाय राघव। बहुशस्तत्प्रयुक्ताश्च वानरा निहता मया4.8.34।।
explanation: 'O Rama this evilminded one made several attempts to kill me. The monkeys he sent to kill me were themselves killed.

shloka_text: शङ्कया त्वेतया चेह दृष्ट्वा त्वामपि राघव। नोपसर्पाम्यहं भीतो भये सर्वे हि बिभ्यति4.8.35।।
explanation: 'It is because of suspicion that I did not approach you. Every one is scared when there is ample reason to fear.

shloka_text: केवलं हि सहाया मे हनुमत्प्रमुखास्त्विमे। अतोऽहं धारयाम्यद्य प्राणान् कृच्छ्रगतोऽपि सन्4.8.36।।
explanation: 'Only Hanuman and other chiefs are helping me. Therefore, I am surviving in spite of all difficulties.

shloka_text: एते हि कपयस्स्निग्धा मां रक्षन्ति समन्ततः। सह गच्छन्ति गन्तव्ये नित्यं तिष्ठन्ति च स्थिते4.8.37।।
explanation: 'These monkeys out of love for me keep me protected from all sides. They go out with me when it is necessary and stay back whenever I stop (in order to guard me).

shloka_text: सङ्क्षेपस्त्वेष मे राम किमुक्त्वा विस्तरं हि ते। स मे ज्येष्ठो रिपुर्भ्राता वाली विश्रुतपौरुषः4.8.38।।
explanation: 'O Rama I tell you (my story) briefly. It is not necessary to go into details. My elder brother Vali, who is known for his prowess, is my enemy.

shloka_text: तद्विनाशाद्धि मे दुःखं प्रणष्टं स्यादनन्तरम्। सुखं मे जीवितं चैव तद्विनाशनिबन्धनम्4.8.39।।
explanation: 'My sorrow will go only with his death. My happiness and my life are also subject to his destruction.

shloka_text: एष मे राम शोकान्तश्शोकार्तेन निवेदितः। दुःखितस्सुखितो वापि सख्युर्नित्यं सखा गतिः4.8.40।।
explanation: 'This what I had to tell you out of sorrow. This is how my sorrow will end. In joy and in sorrow your friend is your refuge.

shloka_text: श्रुत्वैतद्वचनं रामस्सुग्रीवमिदमब्रवीत्। किं निमित्तमभूद्वैरं श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्त्वतः4.8.41।।
explanation: After hearing  Sugriva, Rama said 'I wish to know the actual cause of this enmity.

shloka_text: सुखं हि कारणं श्रुत्वा वैरस्य तव वानर। अनन्तरं विधास्यामि सम्प्रधार्य बलाबलम्4.8.42।।
explanation: 'On hearing the cause of your enmity and considering your strength and weakness, I will take steps to make you happy.

shloka_text: बलवान् हि ममामर्षश्श्रुत्वा त्वामवमानितम्। वर्तते हृदयोत्कम्पी प्रावृड्वेग इवाम्भसः4.8.43।।
explanation: 'On hearing about your humiliation I feel highly agitated at heart. I feel very much angry and restless like the water in rainy season.

shloka_text: हृष्टः कथय विस्रब्धो यावदारोप्यते धनुः। सृष्टश्च हि मया बाणो निरस्तश्च रिपुस्तव4.8.44।।
explanation: 'Tell me freely and cheerfully before I string the bow. Your enemy will be destroyed as soon as I release my arrow.'

shloka_text: एवमुक्तस्तु सुग्रीवः काकुत्स्थेन महात्मना। प्रहर्षमतुलं लेभे चतुर्भिस्सह वानरैः4.8.45।।
explanation: When the great Rama said this, Sugriva with all the four monkeys felt immeasurably glad.

shloka_text: ततः प्रहृष्टवदनस्सुग्रीवो लक्ष्मणाग्रजे। वैरस्य कारणं तत्त्वमाख्यातुमुपचक्रमे4.8.46।।
explanation: With a smile on his face, Sugriva started narrating to Lakshmana's elder brother the facts about the cause of his enmity (with Vali). इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे अष्टमस्सर्गः Thus ends the eighth sarga of Kishkindakanda of the Holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: वाली नाम मम भ्राता ज्येष्ठश्शत्रुनिषूदनः। पितुर्बहुमतो नित्यं ममापि च तथा पुरा4.9.1।।
explanation: 'My elder brother called Vali, capable of exterminating enemies was always highly regarded by my father and me.

shloka_text: पितर्युपरतेऽस्माकं ज्येष्ठोऽयमिति मन्त्रिभिः। कपीनामीश्वरो राज्ये कृतः परमसम्मतः4.9.2।।
explanation: When our father passed away, the ministers, considering him the eldest, made him the highly esteemed ruler of the monkeys in the kingdom.

shloka_text: राज्यं प्रशासतस्तस्य पितृपैतामहं महत्। अहं सर्वेषु कालेषु प्रणतः प्रेष्यवत् स्थितः4.9.3।।
explanation: 'I served him obediently like a servant while he ruled over the great  ancestral kingdom inherited by him.

shloka_text: मायावी नाम तेजस्वी पूर्वजो दुन्दुभेः सुतः। तेन तस्य महद्वैरं स्त्रीकृतं विश्श्रुतं पुरा4.9.4।।
explanation: 'Dundubhi's eldest son Mayabi was a mighty demon. He developed bitter enmity with Vali for the sake of a woman.

shloka_text: स तु सुप्तजने रात्रौ किष्किन्धाद्वारमागतः। नर्दति स्म सुसंरब्धो वालिनं चाह्वयद्रणे4.9.5।।
explanation: 'One midnight when all were asleep, he (Mayabi) came to the entrance of Kishkinda screaming angrily and bellowing at Vali, challenging him to a duel.

shloka_text: प्रसुप्तस्तु मम भ्राता नर्दितं भैरवस्वनम्। श्रुत्वा न ममृषे वाली निष्पपात जवात्तदा4.9.6।।
explanation: ' My brother Vali, who was asleep could not tolerate the frightful sound and jumped out of bed hastily.

shloka_text: स तु वै निस्सृतः क्रोधात्तं हन्तुमसुरोत्तमम्। वार्यमाणस्तत स्त्रीभिर्मया च प्रणतात्मना4.9.7।।
explanation: 'Enraged, he came out to kill the powerful demon even though I with the womenfolk (of the harem) tried to prevent him.

shloka_text: स तु निर्धूय ताः सर्वा निर्जगाम महाबलः। ततोऽहमपि सौहार्दान्निस्सृतो वालिना सह4.9.8।।
explanation: 'That mighty warrior(Vali) came out, pushing aside all the womenfolk. I too followed  him due to my affection towards him.

shloka_text: स तु मे भ्रातरं दृष्ट्वा मां च दूरादवस्थितम्। असुरो जातसन्त्रासः प्रदुद्राव ततो भृशम्4.9.9।।
explanation: 'On seeing my brother and me from a distance, the demon took to his heels scared.

shloka_text: तस्मिन् द्रवति सन्त्रस्ते ह्यावां द्रुततरं गतौ। प्रकाशश्च कृतो मार्गश्चन्द्रेणोद्गच्छता तदा4.9.10।।
explanation: 'Frightened, he ran. We too chased him running faster. As the Moon was rising the path was welllit.

shloka_text: स तृणैरावृतं दुर्गं धरण्या विवरं महत्। प्रविवेशासुरो वेगादावामासाद्य विष्ठितौ4.9.11।।
explanation: 'The demon entered into a hole (cave) covered with a heap of grass, difficult, therefore, of access. Both of us reached there and took position.

shloka_text: तं प्रविष्टं रिपुं दृष्ट्वा बिलं रोषवशं गतः। मामुवाच तदा वाली वचनं क्षुभितेन्द्रियः4.9.12।।
explanation: 'Seeing the enemy entering the cave, Vali became wrathful and his senses were terribly disturbed.He said to me:

shloka_text: इह त्वं तिष्ठ सुग्रीव बिलद्वारि समाहितः। यावत्तत्र प्रविश्याहं निहन्मि सहसा रिपुम्4.9.13।।
explanation: 'O Sugriva wait here at the entrance of the cave and be on your alert until I enter this hole and kill the enemy'.

shloka_text: मया त्वेतद्वचश्श्रुत्वा याचितस्स परन्तपः। शापयित्वा तु मां पद्भ्यां प्रविवेश बिलं महत्4.9.14।।
explanation: 'On hearing him, I begged the scorcher of enemies (Vali) that I would follow him, but he made me swear on his feet and entered the cave.

shloka_text: तस्य प्रविष्टस्य बिलं साग्रस्संवत्सरो गतः। स्थितस्य मम बिलद्वारि स कालो व्यत्यवर्तत4.9.15।।
explanation: A year and more passed since he entered the cave. That time elapsed for me, who was standing at the entrance of the cave.

shloka_text: अहं तु नष्टं ज्ञात्वा तं स्नेहादागतसम्भ्रमः। भ्रातरं न च पश्यामि पापाशङ्कि च मे मनः4.9.16।।
explanation: 'Thinking him dead, I became agitated because of my love for him. My mind began to apprehend his death since I had not seen my brother for long.

shloka_text: अथ दीर्घस्य कालस्य बिलात्तस्माद्विनिस्सृतम्। सफेनं रुधिरं रक्तमहं दृष्ट्वा सुदुःखितः।।4.9.17।।
explanation: Then, after a long time, having seen foamy, red blood emerge from that cave, I became greatly distressed.

shloka_text: नर्दतामसुराणां च ध्वनिर्मे श्रोत्रमागतः। निरस्तस्य च सङ्ग्रामे क्रोशतोनिस्स्वनो गुरोः4.9.18।।
explanation: 'I heard the roaring voices of the demons and not the yelling of my brother engaged in the duel.

shloka_text: अहं त्ववगतो बुद्ध्या चिह्नैस्तैर्भ्रातरं हतम्। पिधाय च बिलद्वारं शिलया गिरिमात्रया4.9.19।। शोकार्तश्चोदकं कृत्वा किष्किन्धामागतस्सखे। गूहमानस्य मे तत्त्वं यत्नतो मन्त्रिभिश्श्रुतम्4.9.20।।
explanation: 'O friend by those signs I understood that my brother was killed and concluding that way I blocked the entrance of the cave with a rock of the size of a mountain and offered oblations to my brother and came to Kishkinda. I intended to hide the fact of Vali's death. But the ministers came to know the truth with their efforts.

shloka_text: अहं त्ववगतो बुद्ध्या चिह्नैस्तैर्भ्रातरं हतम्। पिधाय च बिलद्वारं शिलया गिरिमात्रया4.9.19।। शोकार्तश्चोदकं कृत्वा किष्किन्धामागतस्सखे। गूहमानस्य मे तत्त्वं यत्नतो मन्त्रिभिश्श्रुतम्4.9.20।।
explanation: 'O friend by those signs I understood that my brother was killed and concluding that way I blocked the entrance of the cave with a rock of the size of a mountain and offered oblations to my brother and came to Kishkinda. I intended to hide the fact of Vali's death. But the ministers came to know the truth with their efforts.

shloka_text: ततोऽहं तैस्समागम्य सम्मतैरभिषेचितः। राज्यं प्रशासतस्तस्य न्यायतो मम राघव4.9.21।। आजगाम रिपुं हत्वा वाली तमसुरोत्तमम्।।
explanation: 'Then all the ministers assembled together and consecrated me. While I was ruling the kingdom lawfully, Vali, the monkey came back after killing the enemy demon.

shloka_text: अभिषिक्तं तु मां दृष्ट्वा वाली संरक्तलोचनः। मदीयान्मन्त्रिणो बद्ध्वा परुषं वाक्यमब्रवीत्4.9.22।।
explanation: 'Seeing me on the throne, Vali became angry and his eyes turned red. He imprisoned my ministers and spoke to me harshly.

shloka_text: निग्रहेऽपि समर्थस्य तं पापं प्रति राघव। न प्रावर्तत मे बुद्धिर्भ्रातुर्गौरवयन्त्रिता4.9.23।।
explanation: 'O Rama even though I was capable of restraining the sinner, my intellect did not let me do so out of respect for my brother.

shloka_text: हत्वा शत्रुं स मे भ्राता प्रविवेश पुरं तदा4.9.24।। मानयंस्तं महात्मानं यथावच्चाभ्यवादयम्। उक्ताश्च नाशिषस्तेन सन्तुष्टेनान्तरात्मना4.9.25।।
explanation: 'When my brother came back to the town after killing the enemy, I offered as usual my salutations to him. But he did not bless me wholeheartedly.

shloka_text: हत्वा शत्रुं स मे भ्राता प्रविवेश पुरं तदा4.9.24।। मानयंस्तं महात्मानं यथावच्चाभ्यवादयम्। उक्ताश्च नाशिषस्तेन सन्तुष्टेनान्तरात्मना4.9.25।।
explanation: 'When my brother came back to the town after killing the enemy, I offered as usual my salutations to him. But he did not bless me wholeheartedly.

shloka_text: नत्वा पादावहं तस्य मकुटेनास्पृशं प्रभो अपि वाली मम क्रोधान्न प्रसादं चकार सः4.9.26।।
explanation: 'O lord I bowed at his feet with my crown in total submission. Even then Vali was not pleased a bit. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे नवमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the ninth sarga of Kishkindakanda of the Holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: ततः क्रोधसमाविष्टं सम्रब्धं तमुपागतम्। अहं प्रसादयाञ्चक्रे भ्रातरं प्रियकाम्यया4.10.1
explanation: 'I sought to appease my brother who arrived in an agitated state overpowered with anger.

shloka_text: दिष्ट्यासि कुशली प्राप्तो निहतश्च त्वया रिपुः। अनाथस्य हि मे नाथस्त्वमेकोऽनाथनन्दनः4.10.2।।
explanation: 'By providence you have come back safe and the enemy has been killed. You are the only protector to an orphan which I am.

shloka_text: इदं बहुशलाकं ते पूर्णचन्द्रमिवोदितम्। छत्रं सवालव्यजनं प्रतीच्छस्व मया धृतम्4.10.3।।
explanation: 'Here is the manyribbed parasol shining like the full Moon above the horizon and the yak's tailfan held by me.Pray accept it.

shloka_text: आर्तश्चाथ बिलद्वारि स्थितस्संवत्सरं नृप। दृष्ट्वाऽहं शोणितं द्वारि बिलाच्चापि समुत्थितम्4.10.4।। शोकसंविग्नहृदयो भृशं व्याकुलितेन्द्रियः। अपिधाय बिलद्वारं शैलशृङ्गेण तत्तथा4.10.5।। तस्माद्देशादपाक्रम्य किष्किन्धां प्राविशं पुनः।
explanation: 'O king I waited at the entrance of the cave for a year. As you did not come out, I felt distressed and my heart sank in great sorrow seeing blood flowing out of the cave. With my senses fused I returned to Kishkinda, closing the entrance with a rock(lest the demon should come out).

shloka_text: आर्तश्चाथ बिलद्वारि स्थितस्संवत्सरं नृप। दृष्ट्वाऽहं शोणितं द्वारि बिलाच्चापि समुत्थितम्4.10.4।। शोकसंविग्नहृदयो भृशं व्याकुलितेन्द्रियः। अपिधाय बिलद्वारं शैलशृङ्गेण तत्तथा4.10.5।। तस्माद्देशादपाक्रम्य किष्किन्धां प्राविशं पुनः।
explanation: 'O king I waited at the entrance of the cave for a year. As you did not come out, I felt distressed and my heart sank in great sorrow seeing blood flowing out of the cave. With my senses fused I returned to Kishkinda, closing the entrance with a rock(lest the demon should come out).

shloka_text: विषादात्विह मां दृष्ट्वा पौरैर्मन्त्रिभिरेव च4.10.6।। अभिषिक्तो न कामेन तन्मेत्वं क्षन्तुमर्हसि।
explanation: 'Here I was consecrated by the people and ministers who saw me immersed in grief. It was not my desire to be coronated. Therefore, I may be forgiven.

shloka_text: त्वमेव राजा मानार्हस्सदा चाहं यथा पुरम्4.10.7।। राजभावनियोगोऽयं मम त्वद्विरहात्कृतः। सामात्यपौरनगरं स्थितं निहतकण्टकम्4.10.8।।
explanation: 'You alone are the king and worthy of reverence.I will be the same old brother carrying out my work as earlier. I held the responsibility of the state in your absence forced by the citizens and ministers. The kingdom has been kept stable with the enemies destroyed.

shloka_text: त्वमेव राजा मानार्हस्सदा चाहं यथा पुरम्4.10.7।। राजभावनियोगोऽयं मम त्वद्विरहात्कृतः। सामात्यपौरनगरं स्थितं निहतकण्टकम्4.10.8।।
explanation: 'You alone are the king and worthy of reverence.I will be the same old brother carrying out my work as earlier. I held the responsibility of the state in your absence forced by the citizens and ministers. The kingdom has been kept stable with the enemies destroyed.

shloka_text: न्यासभूतमिदं राज्यं तव निर्यातयाम्यहम्। मा च रोषं कृथास्सौम्य मयि शत्रुनिबर्हण4.10.9।।
explanation: 'I am handing over this kingdom which was in trust. O slayer of enemies, O good natured one, give up your anger against me.

shloka_text: याचे त्वां शिरसा राजन्मया बद्धोऽयमञ्जलिः। बलादस्मिन् समागम्य मन्त्रिभिः पुरवासिभिः4.10.10।। राजभावे नियुक्तोऽहं शून्यदेशजिगीषया।
explanation: 'O king I bow my head and beg you with folded hands. The ministers and citizens assembled and forced me to take charge, as the kingdom without a ruler was vulnerable to attack.'

shloka_text: स्निग्धमेवं ब्रुवाणं मां स तु निर्भर्त्स्य वानरः4.10.11।। धिक्त्वामिति च मा मुक्त्वा बहु तत्तदुवाच ह।
explanation: 'Even tnough I spoke to him with affection, Vali abused me in many words, saying, 'Fie on you'.

shloka_text: प्रकृतीश्च समानीय मुन्त्रिणश्चैव सम्मतान्4.10.12।। मामाह सुहृदां मध्ये वाक्यं परमगर्हितम्।
explanation: 'Having invited ordinary people and favourite ministers he condemned me in the presence of friends.

shloka_text: विदितं वो यथा रात्रौ मायावी स महासुरः4.10.13।। मां समाह्वयत क्रूरो युद्धाकाङ्क्षी सुदुर्मतिः।
explanation: 'You know very well how that wicked demon, Mayabi, that night challenged me angrily to a duel.

shloka_text: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा निस्सृतोऽहं नृपालयात्4.10.14।। अनुयातश्च मां तूर्णमयं भ्राता सुदारुणः।
explanation: 'On hearing his words I came out of the royal abode quickly, followed by this wicked brother.

shloka_text: स तु दृष्ट्वैव मां रात्रौ सद्वितीयं महाबलः4.10.15।। प्राद्रवद्भयसन्त्रस्तो वीक्ष्यावां समुपागतौ। अनुद्रुतश्च वेगेन प्रविवेश महाबिलम्4.10.16।।
explanation: 'The powerful demon that night saw me followed by another advancing towards him and fled out of fear. When we chased him, he entered this huge cave in great speed.

shloka_text: स तु दृष्ट्वैव मां रात्रौ सद्वितीयं महाबलः4.10.15।। प्राद्रवद्भयसन्त्रस्तो वीक्ष्यावां समुपागतौ। अनुद्रुतश्च वेगेन प्रविवेश महाबिलम्4.10.16।।
explanation: 'The powerful demon that night saw me followed by another advancing towards him and fled out of fear. When we chased him, he entered this huge cave in great speed.

shloka_text: तं प्रविष्टं विदित्वा सुघोरं सुमहद्बिलम्। अयमुक्तोऽथ मे भ्राता मया तु क्रूरदर्शनः4.10.17।।
explanation: 'When I saw the dreadful demon entering the great cave, I instructed this cruel brother of mine:

shloka_text: अहत्वा नास्ति मे शक्तिः प्रतिगन्तुमितः पुरीम्। बिलद्वारि प्रतीक्ष त्वं यावदेनं निहन्म्यहम्4.10.18।।
explanation: 'I cannot return from here without killing him. Wait at the entrance of the cave until I kill him. Look forward to my return.

shloka_text: स्थितोऽयमिति मत्वा तु प्रविष्टोऽहं दुरासदम्। तं च मे मार्गमाणस्य गतस्संवत्सरस्तदा4.10.19।।
explanation: 'Presuming that Sugriva was waiting there, I entered the formidable cave. While I was searching for the demon there, one year passed.

shloka_text: स तु दृष्टो मया शत्रुरनिर्वेदाद्भयावहः। निहतश्च मया तत्र सोऽसुरो बन्धुभिस्सह।।4.10.20।।
explanation: 'I could find that fearful enemy there and killed him along with his relatives without any difficulty.

shloka_text: तस्यास्यात्तु प्रवृत्तेन रुधिरौघेण तद्बिलम्। पूर्णमासीद्दुराक्रामं स्तनतस्तस्य भूतले4.10.21।।
explanation: From his mouth, by the gushing stream of blood, that cave became full and impassable, as he roared on the ground.

shloka_text: सूदयित्वा तु तं शत्रुं विक्रान्तं दुन्दुभेस्सुतम्। निष्क्रामन्नेव पश्यामि बिलस्य पिहितं मुखम्4.10.22।।
explanation: Having slain that valiant enemy, the son of Dundubhi, as I was exiting, I saw the mouth of the cave closed.

shloka_text: विक्रोशमानस्य तु मे सुग्रीवेति पुनः पुनः। यदा प्रतिवचो नास्ति ततोऽहं भृशदुःखितः4.10.23।।
explanation: 'When there was no response from Sugriva to my repeated call in distress I was very sad.

shloka_text: पादप्रहारैस्तु मया बहुभिस्तद्विदारितम्। ततोऽहं तेन निष्क्रम्य यथा पुरमुपागतः4.10.24।।
explanation: 'I kicked the boulder again and again till it yielded. I came out that way and arrived at the city.

shloka_text: अत्रानेनास्मि संरुद्धो राज्यं प्रार्थयताऽत्मनः। सुग्रीवेण नृशंसेन विस्मृत्य भ्रातृसौहृदम्।।4.10.25।।
explanation: 'I was obstructed by wicked Sugriva who forgot his brotherly love and was desiring  the kingdom, which belongs to me.'

shloka_text: एवमुक्त्वा तु मां तत्र वस्त्रेणैकेन वानरः। निर्वासयामास तदा वाली विगतसाध्वसः4.10.26।।
explanation: 'When Vali, the monkey, spoke that way I remained unperturbed. He banished me  with the only cloth I was wearing.

shloka_text: तेनाहमपविद्धश्च हृतदारश्च राघव। तद्भयाच्छ महीकृत्स्ना क्रान्तेयं सवनार्णवा4.10.27।।
explanation: 'O Rama my wife has been usurped. There is the fear of his attack. So I am roaming this entire earth, covered with forests and oceans.

shloka_text: ऋष्यमूकं गिरिवरं भार्याहरणदुःखितः। प्रविष्टोऽस्मि दुराधर्षं वालिनः कारणान्तरे4.10.28।।
explanation: 'Tormented by the abduction of my wife by Vali, I came to the great Rishyamuka mountain  inaccessible to Vali for some other reason.

shloka_text: एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं वैरानुकथनं महत्। अनागसा मया प्राप्तं व्यसनं पश्य राघव4.10.29।।
explanation: 'O Rama I have given you this long, full account of the cause of our enmity. For no fault of mine I am suffering.

shloka_text: वालिनस्तु भयार्तस्य सर्वलोकभयङ्कर। कर्तुमर्हसि मे वीर प्रसादं तस्य निग्रहात्4.10.30।।
explanation: 'O great warrior you are one who can frighten the entire world Due to the fear of Vali I seek your grace.You may resist Vali and provide me security.'

shloka_text: एवमुक्तस्स तेजस्वी धर्मज्ञो धर्मसंहितम्। वचनं वक्तुमारेभे सुग्रीवं प्रहसन्निव4.10.31।।
explanation: Having thus addressed by Sugriva the righteous and glorious Rama with a gentle smile  consistent with righteousness, started speaking:

shloka_text: अमोघास्सूर्यसङ्काशा ममैते निशिता श्शराः। तस्मिन्वालिनि दुर्वृत्ते निपतिष्यन्ति वेगिताः4.10.32।।
explanation: 'These my sharp, unfailing arrows, bright as the Sun, released by me out of anger will descend on the evildoer, Vali.

shloka_text: यावत्तं नाभिपश्यामि तव भार्यापहारिणम्। तावत्स जीवेत्पापात्मा वाली चारित्रदूषकः4.10.33।।
explanation: 'That sinful Vali who has abducted your wife and violated the moral code will live only as long I do not see him.

shloka_text: आत्मानुमानात्पश्यामि मग्नं त्वां शोकसागरे। त्वामहं तारयिष्यामि कामं प्राप्स्यसि पुष्कलम्4.10.34।।
explanation: 'Inferring from my own experience, I see that you are immersed in an ocean of sorrow.I will help you cross over and fulfil your desire.'

shloka_text: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा हर्षपौरुषवर्धनम्। सुग्रीवः परमप्रीतस्सुमहद्वाक्यमब्रवीत्4.10.35।।
explanation: On hearing his words that boosted his joy and vigour, Sugriva was immensely pleased and said these warm words. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे दशमस्सर्गः Thus ends the tenth sarga of Kishkindhakanda of the Holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: रामस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा हर्षपौरुषवर्धनम्। सुग्रीवः पूजयाञ्चक्रे राघवं प्रशशंस च4.11.1।।
explanation: The words of Rama boosted Sugriva's joy and manliness. He offered him prayers and praise:

shloka_text: असंशयं प्रज्वलितैस्तीक्ष्णैर्मर्मातिगैश्शरैः। त्वं दहेः कुपितो लोकान्युगान्त इव भास्करः4.11.2।।
explanation: 'There is no doubt that your sharp, blazing arrows will pierce through the vital parts of the body once you are angry, just as the Sungod burns all worlds at the end of the Yuga.

shloka_text: वालिनः पौरुषं यत्तद्यच्च वीर्यं धृतिश्च या। तन्ममैकमनाश्श्रुत्वा विधत्स्व यदनन्तरम्4.11.3।।
explanation: Listen to me with a concentrated mind about Vali's valor, his strength, and his endurance, and then do what follows.

shloka_text: समुद्रात्पश्चिमात्पूर्वं दक्षिणादपि चोत्तरम्। क्रामत्यनुदिते सूर्ये वाली व्यपगतक्लमः4.11.4।।
explanation: 'In the early hours before Sunrise Vali crosses over the oceans from the west to the east and moving from south to north (performing sandhya) without getting fatigued.

shloka_text: अग्राण्यारुह्य शैलानां शिखराणि महान्त्यपि। ऊर्ध्वमुत्क्षिप्य तरसा प्रतिगृह्णाति वीर्यवान्4.11.5।।
explanation: 'Climbing up speedily, valiant Vali would catch the huge mountain peaks.

shloka_text: बहवस्सारवन्तश्च वनेषु विविधा द्रुमाः। वालिना तरसा भग्ना बलं प्रथयताऽत्मनः4.11.6।।
explanation: 'Vali would break several sturdy trees in the forest with his vigour and speed, exhibiting his strength.

shloka_text: महिषो दुन्दुभिर्नाम कैलासशिखरप्रभः। बलं नागसहस्रस्य धारयामास वीर्यवान्4.11.7।।
explanation: 'Massive like the shining peak of mount Kailas and valiant like the mightybuffalo in form, Dundubhi possessed the strength of a thousand elephants.

shloka_text: वीर्योत्सेकेन दुष्टात्मा वरदानाच्च मोहितः। जगाम सुमहाकाय स्समुद्रं सरितां पतिम्।।4.11.8।।
explanation: 'Wicked Dundubhi of huge body was proud of his valour and deluded by virtue of the boons, went to the ocean, the lord of rivers.

shloka_text: ऊर्मिमन्तमभिक्रम्य सागरं रत्नसञ्चयम्। मह्यं युद्धं प्रयच्छेति तमुवाच महार्णवम्4.11.9।।
explanation: 'Reaching the mighty ocean, he implored the sea with (high) waves and hoards of gems for a fight.

shloka_text: ततस्समुद्रो धर्मात्मा समुत्थाय महाबलः। अब्रवीद्वचनं राजन्नसुरं कालचोदितम्4.11.10।।
explanation: 'O king, then the powerful and righteous king of the ocean came out and spoke to the demon (Dundubhi) who was driven to death by fate.'

shloka_text: समर्थो नास्मि ते दातुं युद्धं युद्धविशारद। श्रूयतां चाभिधास्यामि यस्ते युद्धं प्रदास्यति4.11.11।।
explanation: 'You are proficient in warfare. I am not competent enough to challenge you to a duel. But  I will name the one who can.

shloka_text: शैलराजो महारण्ये तपस्विशरणं परम्। शङ्करश्वशुरो नाम्ना हिमवानिति विश्रुतः4.11.12।। गुहाप्रस्रवणोपेतो बहुकन्दरनिर्दरः। स समर्थस्तव प्रीतिमतुलां कर्तुमाहवे4.11.13।।
explanation: 'Himavan, the supreme abode of ascetics is the fatherinlaw of Lord Siva. He is wellknown as king of mountains, who has, waterfalls, caves, caverns and great forests.He is competent to match your incomparable love for war.

shloka_text: शैलराजो महारण्ये तपस्विशरणं परम्। शङ्करश्वशुरो नाम्ना हिमवानिति विश्रुतः4.11.12।। गुहाप्रस्रवणोपेतो बहुकन्दरनिर्दरः। स समर्थस्तव प्रीतिमतुलां कर्तुमाहवे4.11.13।।
explanation: 'Himavan, the supreme abode of ascetics is the fatherinlaw of Lord Siva. He is wellknown as king of mountains, who has, waterfalls, caves, caverns and great forests.He is competent to match your incomparable love for war.

shloka_text: तं भीत इति विज्ञाय समुद्रमसुरोत्तमः। हिमवद्वनमागच्छच्छरश्चापादिव च्युतः4.11.14।। ततस्तस्य गिरेश्श्वेता गजेन्द्रविप्रलाश्शिलाः। चिक्षेप बहुधा भूमौ दुन्दुभिर्विननाद च4.11.15।।
explanation: 'Dundubhi, the most powerful of demons, aware that the ocean is frightened of him went swiftly to Himavan like an arrow released from a bow. He raised many huge white cliffs of the size of great elephants to the ground and roared.

shloka_text: तं भीत इति विज्ञाय समुद्रमसुरोत्तमः। हिमवद्वनमागच्छच्छरश्चापादिव च्युतः4.11.14।। ततस्तस्य गिरेश्श्वेता गजेन्द्रविप्रलाश्शिलाः। चिक्षेप बहुधा भूमौ दुन्दुभिर्विननाद च4.11.15।।
explanation: 'Dundubhi, the most powerful of demons, aware that the ocean is frightened of him went swiftly to Himavan like an arrow released from a bow. He raised many huge white cliffs of the size of great elephants to the ground and roared.

shloka_text: ततश्श्वेताम्बुदाकारः सौम्यः प्रीतिकराकृतिः। हिमवानब्रवीद्वाक्यं स्वे एव शिखरे स्थितः4.11.16।।
explanation: 'Then the gentle Himavan of pleasing appearance stood in the form of a white cloud on the peak and spoke:

shloka_text: क्लेष्टुमर्हसि मां न त्वं दुन्दुभे धर्मवत्सल। रणकर्मस्वकुशलस्तपस्विशरणं ह्यहम्4.11.17।।
explanation: 'Dundubhi, it is not proper for you to trouble me, for I am devoted to righteousness. I am the resort of ascetics and not adept in warfare'.

shloka_text: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा गिरिराजस्य धीमतः। उवाच दुन्दुभिर्वाक्यं क्रोधात्संरक्तलोचनः4.11.18।।
explanation: "At these words of Himavan, the wise king of mountains, Dundubhi whose eyes turned red in anger replied:

shloka_text: यदि युद्धेऽसमर्थस्त्वं मद्भयाद्वा निरुद्यमः। समाचक्ष्व प्रदद्यान्मे योऽद्य युद्धं युयुत्सतः4.11.19।।
explanation: 'If you are unable or unwilling to fight me out of fear, tell me who wants to challenge me to a duel.

shloka_text: हिमवानब्रवीद्वाक्यं श्रुत्वा वाक्यविशारदः। अनुक्तपूर्वं धर्मात्मा क्रोधात्तमसुरोत्तमम्4.11.20।।
explanation: 'On hearing such words, which no one had spoken earlier, righteous Himavan, skilful in conversation, flew into a rage and said to Dundubhi,the best of demons:

shloka_text: वाली नाम महाप्राज्ञश्शक्रतुल्य पराक्रमः। अध्यास्ते वानरश्श्रीमान् किष्किन्धामतुलप्रभाम्4.11.21।।
explanation: 'Vali, son of Indra, is a wise, powerful and prosperous monkey. He resides at Kishkinda, a city of incomparable glory.

shloka_text: स समर्थो महाप्राज्ञस्तव युद्धविशारदः। द्वन्द्वयुद्धं महद्दातुं नमुचेरिव वासवः4.11.22।।
explanation: 'Vali is profoundly wise, an expert in warfare. He is capable of challenging you to a duel like Indra to Namuchi.

shloka_text: तं शीघ्रमभिगच्छ त्वं यदि युद्धमिहेच्छसि। स हि दुर्धर्षणो नित्यं शूरस्समरकर्मणि4.11.23।।
explanation: 'If you wish to fight, go to him quickly.He is ever heroic and difficult to combat.

shloka_text: श्रुत्वा हिमवतो वाक्यं कोधाविष्टस्स दुन्दुभिः। जगाम तां पुरीं तस्य किष्किन्धां वालिनस्तदा4.11.24।।
explanation: 'Having heard Himavan, Dundubhi, seized with anger, went to Kishkindha,  the city of Vali.

shloka_text: धारयन्माहिषं रूपं तीक्ष्णशृङ्गो भयावहः। प्रावृषीव महामेघस्तोयपूर्णो नभस्स्थले4.11.25।। ततस्तु द्वारमागम्य किष्किन्धाया महाबलः। ननर्द कम्पयन्भूमिं दुन्दुभिर्दुन्दुभिर्यथा4.11.26।।
explanation: 'Mighty Dundubhi assuming the form of a frightening buffalo with pointed horns looking like a huge, dark raincloud in the sky in monsoon marched to the entrance of Kishkinda and roared like a wardrum as if shaking the earth.

shloka_text: धारयन्माहिषं रूपं तीक्ष्णशृङ्गो भयावहः। प्रावृषीव महामेघस्तोयपूर्णो नभस्स्थले4.11.25।। ततस्तु द्वारमागम्य किष्किन्धाया महाबलः। ननर्द कम्पयन्भूमिं दुन्दुभिर्दुन्दुभिर्यथा4.11.26।।
explanation: 'Mighty Dundubhi assuming the form of a frightening buffalo with pointed horns looking like a huge, dark raincloud in the sky in monsoon marched to the entrance of Kishkinda and roared like a wardrum as if shaking the earth.

shloka_text: समीपस्थान्द्रुमान्भञ्जन्वसुधां दारयन्खुरैः। विषाणेनोल्लिखन् दर्पात्तद्द्वारं द्विरदो यथा4.11.27।।
explanation: 'Dundubhi felled the trees nearby, rent the earth with its hoofs, scratched the entrance gate of the city as an elephant would do with its horns in arrogance.

shloka_text: अन्तःपुरगतो वाली श्रुत्वा शब्दममर्षणः। निष्पपात सह स्त्रीभिस्ताराभिरिव चन्द्रमाः4.11.28।।
explanation: 'Unable to tolerate the sound, Vali jumped out of the harem along with the women like the Moon with stars.

shloka_text: मितं व्यक्ताक्षरपदं तमुवाचाथ दुन्दुभिम्। हरीणामीश्वरो वाली सर्वेषां वनचारिणाम्4.11.29।।
explanation: 'Vali, king of the monkeys who roam the forest, saw Dundubhi and addressed, but briefly:

shloka_text: किमर्थं नगरद्वारमिदं रुध्द्वा विनर्दसि। दुन्दुभे विदितो मेऽसि रक्षप्राणान्महाबल4.11.30।।
explanation: 'O Dundubhi why are you roaring, blocking the entrance of the city? I know you are powerful. Go and save your life.'

shloka_text: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा वानरेन्द्रस्य धीमतः। उवाच दुन्दुभिर्वाक्यं रोषात्संरक्तलोचनः4.11.31।।
explanation: 'Dundubhi whose eyes turned red in anger when he heard the words of Vali ,the wise king of the monkeys, said:

shloka_text: न त्वं स्त्रीसन्निधौ वीर वचनं वक्तुमर्हसि। मम युद्धं प्रयच्छाद्य ततो ज्ञास्यामि ते बलम्4.11.32।।
explanation: 'O hero speaking such words in the presence of women is not proper. Come to me for a combat and I will let you know your strength.

shloka_text: अथवा धारयिष्यामि क्रोधमद्य निशामिमाम्। गृह्यतामुदयस्स्वैरं कामभोगेषु वानर4.11.33।।
explanation: 'O monkey I will restrain my anger tonight and give you time for your indulgence in sensual pleasures till morning.

shloka_text: दीयतां सम्प्रदानं च परिष्वज्य च वानरान्। सर्वशाखामृगेन्द्र स्त्वं संसादय सुहृज्जनान्4.11.34।।
explanation: 'O king of monkeys, hug them and give them any gift you want. Spend the night with your dear ones.

shloka_text: सुदृष्टां कुरु किष्किन्धां कुरुष्वात्मसमं पुरे। क्रीडस्व च सह स्त्रीभिरहं ते दर्पनाशनः4.11.35।।
explanation: 'Have a good look a Kishkinda. Assign some one like you kingship. Sport freely  with women and come, I shall destroy your arrogance.

shloka_text: यो हि मत्तं प्रमत्तं वा सुप्तं वा रहितं भृशम्। हन्यात्स भ्रूणहा लोके त्वद्विधं मदमोहितम्4.11.36।।
explanation: 'Whoever kills a person, who is drunk or is heedless or is asleep or without weapons or stupified by lust in this world, is equal to a killer of a foetus in the womb.'

shloka_text: स प्रहस्याब्रवीन्मन्दं क्रोधात्तमसुरोत्तमम्। विसृज्य ताः स्त्रियस्सर्वास्ताराप्रभृतिकास्तदा4.11.37।।
explanation: 'Then, Vali sent away Tara and all other women slowly and replied angrily to the foolish demon with a mischievous smile:

shloka_text: मत्तोऽयमिति मा मंस्था यद्यभीतोऽसि संयुगे। मदोऽयं सम्प्रहारेऽस्मिन्वीरपानं समर्थ्यताम्4.11.38।।
explanation: 'Do not consider me drunken. This drink will serve as a warrior's drink in the combat. Be ready, if you are not afraid of a combat.'

shloka_text: तमेवमुक्त्वा सङ्कृद्धो मालामुत्क्षिप्य काञ्चनीम्। पित्रा दत्तां महेन्द्रेण युद्धाय व्यवतिष्ठत4.11.39।।
explanation: 'Having addressed thus in a rage, Vali removed the golden garland gifted by Indra, his father, and stood ready for the combat.

shloka_text: विषाणयोर्गृहीत्वा तं दुन्दुभिं गिरिसन्निभम्। आविध्यत तदा वाली विनदन्कपिकुञ्जरः4.11.40।।
explanation: 'Vali, the elephantlike monkey then held the mountainlike Dundubhi by the horns and struck him down, roaring loudly.

shloka_text: वाली व्यापातयाञ्चक्रे ननर्द च महास्वनम्। श्रोत्राभ्यामथ रक्तं तु तस्य सुस्राव पात्यतः4.11.41।।
explanation: 'Vali whirled him round and round and threw him downroaring. Blood flowed from Dundubhi's ears.

shloka_text: तयोस्तु क्रोधसंरम्भात्परस्परजयैषिणोः। युद्धं समभवद्घोरं दुन्दुभेर्वानरस्यच4.11.42।।
explanation: 'Each one of them was highly agitated and angry trying to win over the other. A terrific fight took place between Dundubhi and Vali.

shloka_text: अयुद्ध्यत तदा वाली शक्रतुल्यपराक्रमः। मुष्टिभिर्जानुभिश्चैव शिलाभिः पादपैस्तथा4.11.43।।
explanation: 'Then Vali who was equal to Indra in prowess fought, hitting him with fists, knees, rocks and trees.

shloka_text: परस्परं घ्नतो स्तत्र वानरासुरयोस्तदा। आसीदसुरो युद्धे शक्रसूनुर्व्यवर्धत4.11.44।।
explanation: 'Then as the monkey and demon fought pouncing on each other, the prowess of Dundubhi got diminished and that of Vali, the son of Indra, increased.

shloka_text: व्यापारवीर्यधैर्यैश्च परिक्षीणं पराक्रमैः। तं तु दुन्दुभिमुद्यम्य धरण्यामभ्यपातयत्।।4.11.45।। युद्धे प्राणहरे तस्मिन्निष्पिष्टो दुन्दुभिस्तदा। पपात च महाकायः क्षितौ पञ्चत्वमागतः4.11.46।।
explanation: In the fight, Dundubhi fell down, with his strength, courage and prowess dwindled. Vali lifted his huge body and dashed it down on the ground. The body of Dundubhi dissolved into the five elements.

shloka_text: व्यापारवीर्यधैर्यैश्च परिक्षीणं पराक्रमैः। तं तु दुन्दुभिमुद्यम्य धरण्यामभ्यपातयत्।।4.11.45।। युद्धे प्राणहरे तस्मिन्निष्पिष्टो दुन्दुभिस्तदा। पपात च महाकायः क्षितौ पञ्चत्वमागतः4.11.46।।
explanation: In the fight, Dundubhi fell down, with his strength, courage and prowess dwindled. Vali lifted his huge body and dashed it down on the ground. The body of Dundubhi dissolved into the five elements.

shloka_text: तं तोलयित्वा बाहुभ्यां गतसत्त्वमचेतनम्। चिक्षेप बलवान्वाली वेगेनैकेन योजनम्4.11.47।।
explanation: 'Mighty Vali lifted on both shoulders the insensate body drained of life and hurled it speedily to a distance of a yojana.

shloka_text: तस्य वेगप्रविद्धस्य वक्त्रात्क्षतजबिन्दवः। प्रपेतुर्मारुतोत्क्षिप्ता मतङ्गप्याश्रमं प्रति4.11.48।।
explanation: 'Scattered by the wind, drops of blood fell at the hermitage of Matanga from the mouth of the deadbody flung.

shloka_text: तान्दृष्ट्वा पतितांस्तस्य मुनिश्शोणितविप्रुषः। क्रुद्धस्तत्र महाभागश्चिन्तयामास कोन्वयम्4.11.49।।
explanation: 'The venerable sage became furious to see drops of blood fallen there. He started thinking who could he be?

shloka_text: येनाहं सहसा स्पृष्टश्शोणितेन दुरात्मना। कोऽयं दुरात्मा दुर्भुदि्घरकृतात्मा च बालिशः4.11.50।।
explanation: 'Who is that petty, wicked, evil minded one who caused the drops of blood to touch (fall on) me suddenly?

shloka_text: इत्युक्त्वाऽथ विनिष्क्रम्य ददर्श मुनिसत्तमः। महिषं पर्वताकारं गतासुं पतितं भुवि4.11.51।।
explanation: 'The venerable sage came out of the hermitage and saw a mountaneous buffalo fallen dead on the floor.

shloka_text: स तु विज्ञाय तपसा वानरेण कृतं हि तत्। उत्ससर्ज महाशापं क्षेप्तारं वालिनं प्रति4.11.52।।
explanation: 'Having known through his ascetic vision that it was the act of a monkey, he pronounced a curse on Vali who had hurled (the body):

shloka_text: इह तेनाप्रवेष्टव्यं प्रविष्टस्य वधो भवेत्। वनं मत्संश्रयं येन दूषितं रुधिरस्रवैः4.11.53।।
explanation: 'Whoever has desecrated this forest, protected by me, with drops of blood is forbidden to enter this place. Once he does it, he will die.

shloka_text: सम्भग्नाः पादपाश्चैमेक्षिपतेहासुरीं तनुम्। समन्तादाद्योजनं पूर्णमाश्रमं मामकं यदि4.11.54।। आगमिष्यति दुर्बुद्धिर्व्यक्तं स न भविष्यति।
explanation: 'Whoever has broken the trees all over this forest and has thrown the demon's body will not survive if he enters within a radius of one yojana  of my hermitage.

shloka_text: ये चापि सचिवाः स्तस्य संश्रिता मामकं वनम्4.11.55।। न च तैरिह वस्तव्यं श्रुत्वा यान्तु यथासुखम्।
explanation: 'Indeed his counsellors who are here must leave this forest. Let them depart safely.

shloka_text: यदि तेऽपी ह तिष्ठन्ति शपिष्ये तानपि ध्रुवम्4.11.56।। वनेऽस्मिन्मामके नित्यं पुत्रवत्परिरक्षिते। पत्राङ्कुरविनाशाय फलमूलाभवाय च4.11.57।।
explanation: 'If the monkeys stay back to destroy the leaves and shoots and plunder the fruits and roots of this forest which I have protected just like my son will also certainly invite my curse.

shloka_text: यदि तेऽपी ह तिष्ठन्ति शपिष्ये तानपि ध्रुवम्4.11.56।। वनेऽस्मिन्मामके नित्यं पुत्रवत्परिरक्षिते। पत्राङ्कुरविनाशाय फलमूलाभवाय च4.11.57।।
explanation: 'If the monkeys stay back to destroy the leaves and shoots and plunder the fruits and roots of this forest which I have protected just like my son will also certainly invite my curse.

shloka_text: दिवसश्चास्य मर्यादा यं द्रष्टा श्वोऽस्मि वानरम्। बहुवर्षसहस्राणि स वै शैलो भविष्यति4.11.58।।
explanation: 'I give one day's time for the monkeys (to leave). Whomsoever, I see tomorrow will get transformed into a mountain for many thousands of years'

shloka_text: ततस्ते वानराश्श्रुत्वा गिरं मुनिसमीरिताम्। निश्चक्रमुर्वनात्तस्मात्तान्दृष्ट्वा वालिरब्रवीत्4.11.59।।
explanation: 'The monkeys fled on hearing the words spoken by the sage. Said Vali:

shloka_text: किं भवन्तस्समस्ताश्च मतङ्गवनवासिनः। मत्समीपमनुप्राप्ता अपि स्वस्ति वनौकसाम्4.11.60।।
explanation: 'Why have you, residents of the groves of Matanga, come to me? Hope all are safe'

shloka_text: ततस्ते कारणं सर्वं तदा शापं च वालिनः। शशंसुर्वानरास्सर्वे वालिने हेममालिने4.11.61।।
explanation: 'Then all the monkeys collected together and narrated everything about the curse given to Vali , adorned with a golden chain(on his neck).

shloka_text: एतच्छ्रुत्वा तदा वाली वचनं वानरेरितम्। स महर्षिंतदाऽसाद्य याचते स्म कृताञ्जलिः4.11.62।।
explanation: 'On hearing the monkeys, Vali went to the sage and begged forgiveness with folded hands.

shloka_text: महर्षिस्तमनादृत्य प्रविवेशाश्रमं तदा। शापधारणभीतस्तु वाली विह्वलतां गतः4.11.63।।
explanation: 'The sage went into the hermitage without obliging Vali who became apprehensive of the curse of the sage.

shloka_text: ततश्शापभयाद्भीत ऋश्यमूकं महागिरिम्। प्रवेष्टुं नेच्छति हरिर्द्रष्टुं वापि नरेश्वर4.11.64।।
explanation: 'O Lord Rama because of the fear of the curse, Vali will not enter the great Rishyamuka mountain nor will he like to see it.

shloka_text: तस्याप्रवेशं ज्ञात्वाऽहमिदं राम महावनम्। विचरामि सहामात्यो विषादेन विवर्जितः4.11.65।।
explanation: 'O Rama aware of the prohibition of Vali from entering the place, I roam about this great forest  accompanied by my ministers without any apprehension.

shloka_text: एषोऽस्थिनिचयस्तस्य दुन्दुभेस्सम्प्रकाशते। वीर्योत्सेकान्निरस्तस्य गिरिकूटोपमो महान्4.11.66।।
explanation: 'Hurled with the pride of his(Vali's) prowess is this heap of bones of Dundubhi here, which shines like a huge mountain peak.

shloka_text: इमे च विपुलास्सालास्सप्त शाखावलम्बिनः। यत्रैकं घटते वाली निष्पत्रयितुमोजसा4.11.67।।
explanation: 'Look at these seven sturdy Sala trees with branches  of one overlapping the other.  Vali was able to remove all the leaves of one Sala tree with just one arrow.

shloka_text: एतदस्यासमं वीर्यं मया राम प्रकीर्तितम्। कथं तं वालिनं हन्तुं समरे शक्ष्यसे नृप4.11.68।।
explanation: 'O Rama Vali's strength and fame related by me is unequalled. O king how is it possible for you to kill him in a combat?'

shloka_text: तथा ब्रुवाणं सुग्रीवं प्रहसन् लक्ष्मणोऽब्रवीत्। कस्मिन्कर्मणि निर्वृत्ते श्रद्दध्या वालिनो वधम्4.11.69।।
explanation: Smiling, Lakshmana asked Sugriva, 'By what action will you trust?. By the fulfilment of which task (by Rama) will you have faith?'

shloka_text: तमुवाचाथ सुग्रीवस्सप्त सालानिमान्पुरा। एवमेकैकशो वाली विव्याथाथ स चासकृत्। 4.11.70।।
explanation: Then Sugriva told Lakshmana that earlier Vali had split through these seven Sala trees one after the other, several times.

shloka_text: रामोऽपिदारयेदेषां बाणेनैकेन च द्रुमम्। वालिनं निहतं मन्ये दृष्ट्वा रामस्य विक्रमम्4.11.71।।
explanation: 'If I see Rama splitting these trees with one arrow, I will believe he can kill Vali with his prowess.

shloka_text: हतस्य महिषस्यास्थि पादेनैकेन लक्ष्मण। उद्यम्याथ प्रक्षिपेच्चेत्तरसा द्वे धनुश्शते4.11.72।।
explanation: 'O Lakshmana and if Rama can also lift the dead buffalo's (Dundubhi's) skeleton and hurl it to a distance  of two hundred bows with one of his feet.

shloka_text: एवमुक्त्वा तु सुग्रीवो रामं रक्तान्तलोचनम्। ध्यात्वा मुहूर्तं काकुत्स्थं पुनरेव वचोऽब्रवीत्4.11.73।।
explanation: Having said this and thinking for a moment, Sugriva again said to the heroic Rama whose eyes had turned red.

shloka_text: शूरश्च शूरघाती च प्रख्यातबलपौरुषः। बलवान्वानरो वाली संयुगेष्वपराजितः4.11.74।।
explanation: 'Powerful Vali is valiant and has killed brave fighters. He is wellknown for his prowess and valour. He has not faced defeat in war.

shloka_text: दृश्यन्ते चास्य कर्माणि दुष्कराणि सुरैरपि। यानि सञ्चिन्त्य भीतोऽहमृश्यमूकं समाश्रितः4.11.75।।
explanation: 'Even gods cannot do what he has done. Thinking of all this and being afraid of him, I have taken refuge at Rishyamuka.

shloka_text: तमजय्यमधृष्यं च वानरेन्द्रममर्षणम्। विचिन्तयन्न मुञ्चामि ऋश्यमूकमहन्विमम्4.11.76।।
explanation: 'Thinking that this indignant, invincible lord of the monkeys, cannot be overpowered, I have not stepped out of Rishyamuka.

shloka_text: उद्विग्नश्शङ्कितश्चापि विचरामि महावने। अनुरक्तैः सहामात्यैर्हनुमत्प्रमुखैर्वरैः4.11.77।।
explanation: Agitated and apprehensive, I wander in the great forest, along with my devoted and excellent ministers, with Hanumat as their chief.

shloka_text: उपलब्धं च मे श्लाघ्यं सन्मित्रं मित्रवत्सल। त्वामहं पुरुषव्याघ्र हिमवन्तमिवाश्रितः4.11.78।।
explanation: 'I have discovered in you a faithful friend. O tiger among men, O venerable one, you are to me like the Himalayas.

shloka_text: किं तु तस्य बलज्ञोऽहं दुर्भ्रातुर्बलशालिनः। अप्रत्यक्षं तु मे वीर्यं समरे तव राघव4.11.79।।
explanation: 'What to do? I know the strength of my mighty bad brother. But so far I have not seen your power in a battle.

shloka_text: न खल्वहं त्वां तुलये नावमन्ये न भीषये। कर्मभिस्तस्य भीमैस्तु कातर्यं जनितं मम4.11.80।।
explanation: 'The dreadful acts of Vali have made me feel timid. This is not to compare you with him or your strength with his or insult you and scare you.

shloka_text: कामं राघव ते वाणी प्रमाणं धैर्यमाकृतिः। सूचयन्ति परं तेजो भस्मच्छन्नमिवानलम्4.11.81।।
explanation: 'Rama  your word and your courage indicate your supreme strength which is like fire covered with ashes.'

shloka_text: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा सुग्रीवस्य महात्मनः। स्मितपूर्वमथो रामः प्रत्युवाच हरिं प्रभुः4.11.82।।
explanation: Having heard the great Sugriva, Rama replied with a gentle smile:

shloka_text: यदि न प्रत्ययोऽस्मासु विक्रमे तव वानर। प्रत्ययं समरे श्लाघ्यमहमुत्पादयामि ते4.11.83।।
explanation: 'If you have no confidence in my strength in fight, O monkey, I will create it in you so much so that you will admire it.'

shloka_text: एवमुक्त्वा तु सुग्रीवं सान्त्वं लक्ष्मणपूर्वजः। राघवो दुन्दुभेः कायं पादाङ्गुष्ठेन लीलया4.11.84।। तोलयित्वा महाबाहुश्चिक्षेप दशयोजनम्। असुरस्य तनुं शुष्कं पादाङ्गुष्ठेन वीर्यवान्4.11.85।।
explanation: Rama,the mighty elder brother of Lakshmana, having said so to Sugriva in a pleasing manner, lifted the dried body of Dundubhi easily with his toe, shook it and flung it with ease to a distance of ten yojanas.

shloka_text: एवमुक्त्वा तु सुग्रीवं सान्त्वं लक्ष्मणपूर्वजः। राघवो दुन्दुभेः कायं पादाङ्गुष्ठेन लीलया4.11.84।। तोलयित्वा महाबाहुश्चिक्षेप दशयोजनम्। असुरस्य तनुं शुष्कं पादाङ्गुष्ठेन वीर्यवान्4.11.85।।
explanation: Rama,the mighty elder brother of Lakshmana, having said so to Sugriva in a pleasing manner, lifted the dried body of Dundubhi easily with his toe, shook it and flung it with ease to a distance of ten yojanas.

shloka_text: क्षिप्तं दृष्ट्वा ततः कायं सुग्रीवः पुनरब्रवीत्। लक्ष्मणस्याग्रतो राममिदं वचनमर्थवत्4.11.86।।
explanation: Having seen Rama flinging the body, Sugriva said to him again in the presence of Lakshmanameaningfully:

shloka_text: आर्द्रस्समांसः प्रत्यग्रः क्षिप्तः कायः पुरा सखे4.11.87।। लघुस्सम्प्रति निर्मांस स्तृणभूतश्च राघव। परिश्रान्तेन मत्तेन भ्रात्रा मे वालिना तदा4.11.88।। क्षिप्तमेवं प्रहर्षेण भवता रघुनन्दन।
explanation: 'O friend, when Vali my brother flung the body, he was tired and intoxicated and the body was fresh with flesh (meaning heavy), but now, O Delight of the Raghu race, it is fleshless and light like a bunch of (dry) grass (for) which you could throw it playfully.

shloka_text: आर्द्रस्समांसः प्रत्यग्रः क्षिप्तः कायः पुरा सखे4.11.87।। लघुस्सम्प्रति निर्मांस स्तृणभूतश्च राघव। परिश्रान्तेन मत्तेन भ्रात्रा मे वालिना तदा4.11.88।। क्षिप्तमेवं प्रहर्षेण भवता रघुनन्दन।
explanation: 'O friend, when Vali my brother flung the body, he was tired and intoxicated and the body was fresh with flesh (meaning heavy), but now, O Delight of the Raghu race, it is fleshless and light like a bunch of (dry) grass (for) which you could throw it playfully.

shloka_text: नात्र शक्यं बलं ज्ञातुं तव वा तस्य वाऽधिकम्। आर्द्रं शुष्कमिति ह्येतत्सुमहद्राघवान्तरम्4.11.89।।
explanation: 'I was unable to gauge whether your strength is more  than his (Vali's) since there is a great difference between a dry body and a wet one.

shloka_text: स एव संशयस्तात तव तस्य च यद्बले4.11.90।। सालमेकं तु निर्भिद्या भवेद्व्यक्तिर्बलाबले।
explanation: 'O Dear, therefore, I have my doubt about your relative strength. If you can split a sala tree with a single arrow then can your strength or weakness be demonstrated.

shloka_text: कृत्वेदं कार्मुकं सज्यं हस्तिहस्त मिवाततम्4.11.91।। आकर्णपूर्णमायम्य विसृजस्व महाशरम्।
explanation: 'Now string your bow, draw it like the trunk of an elephant up to your ear and release the great arrow.

shloka_text: इमं हि सालं सहित स्त्वया शरो न संशयोऽत्रास्ति विदारयिष्यति। अलं विमर्शेन मम प्रियं ध्रुवं कुरुष्व राजात्मज शापितो मया4.11.92।।
explanation: 'It will be enough and my doubt will be cleared. If you can pierce the sala tree with your arrow it will be my pleasure and not a test of your strength.

shloka_text: यथा हि तेजस्सु वरस्सदा रवि र्यथा हि शैलो हिमवान्महाद्रिषु। यथा चतुष्पात्सु च केसरी वर स्तथा नरणामसि विक्रमे वरः4.11.93।।
explanation: 'Just as the Sun is the best among the brilliant, the Himalayas among the great mountains, the lion among the quadrupeds, so also you are the best among men of valour.' इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे एकादशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends  the eleventh sarga of Kishkindakanda of the Holy Ramayana, the first epic, composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: एतच्च वचनं श्रुत्वा सुग्रीवेण सुभाषितम्। प्रत्ययार्थं महातेजा रामो जग्राह कार्मुकम्4.12.1।।
explanation: Having heard Sugriva's pleasing words, the brilliant Rama took up the bow in order to inspire confidence in Sugriva.

shloka_text: स गृहीत्वा धनुर्घोरं शरमेकं च मानदः। सालमुद्दिश्य चिक्षेप ज्यास्वनैः पूरयन्दिशः। 4.12.2।।
explanation: Rama, subduer of the enemy's pride, strung his terrific bow, produced the twang that filled all directions, and discharged a single arrow aimed at the sala tree.

shloka_text: स विसृष्टो बलवता बाणस्स्वर्णपरिष्कृतः। भित्त्वा सालान् गिरिप्रस्थं सप्त भूमिं विवेश ह4.12.3।।
explanation: Released with great force, Rama's arrow embellished with gold pierced through the seven sala trees and splitting the mountain terrain entered the earth.

shloka_text: प्रविष्टश्च मुहूर्तेन धरां भित्त्वा महाजवः। निष्पत्य च पुनस्तूर्णं स्वतूणीं प्रविवेश ह4.12.4।।
explanation: In a moment the arrow emerged from the earth which it pierced and reentered the quiver with great speed.

shloka_text: तान्दृष्ट्वा सप्त निर्भिन्नान्सालान्वानरपुङ्गवः। रामस्य शरवेगेन विस्मयं परमं गतः4.12.5।।
explanation: The chief of the monkeys was struck with wonder seeing Rama's arrow piercing through  the seven sala trees so swiftly.

shloka_text: स मूर्ध्ना न्यपतदभ्मौ प्रलम्बीकृतभूषणः। सुग्रीवः परमप्रीतो राघवाय कृताञ्जलिः4.12.6।।
explanation: Sugriva was immensely happy and offered obeisance to Rama with folded hands and bowed down and prostrated while his ornaments touched the ground.

shloka_text: इदं चोवाच धर्मज्ञं कर्मणा तेन हर्षितः। रामं सर्वास्त्रविदुषां श्रेष्ठं शूरमवस्थितम्4.12.7।।
explanation: Sugriva who stood by, elated to watch the deed of Rama, best among the valiant, proficient in the use of arms of all kinds and knower of dharma, said:

shloka_text: सेन्द्रानपि सुरान्सर्वांस्त्वं बाणैः पुरुषर्षभ। समर्थस्समरे हन्तुं किं पुन र्वालिनं प्रभो 4.12.8।।
explanation: 'O bull among men, O lord, you are capable of killing with your arrows even the gods including Indra in the battle, what to speak of Vali.

shloka_text: येन सप्तमहासाला गिरिर्भूमिश्च दारिताः। बाणेनैकेन काकुत्स्थ स्थाता ते को रणाग्रतः4.12.9।।
explanation: 'O Rama who can in a battle confront you, capable of splitting seven huge sala trees, the mountain and the earth with a single arrow?

shloka_text: अद्य मे विगतश्शोकः प्रीतिरद्य परा मम। सुहृदं त्वां समासाद्य महेन्द्रवरुणोपमम्4.12.10।।
explanation: 'Having found a friend in you comparable to Indra and Varuna, my grief is gone and I am so happy now.

shloka_text: तमद्यैव प्रियार्थं मे वैरिणं भ्रातृरूपिणम्। वालिनं जहि काकुत्स्थ मया बद्धोऽयमञ्जलिः4.12.11।।
explanation: 'O Rama, for my pleasure kill Vali who is, to me, an enemy in the guise of a brother. I fold my hands to you.

shloka_text: ततो रामः परिष्वज्य सुग्रीवं प्रियदर्शनम्। प्रत्युवाच महाप्राज्ञो लक्ष्मणानुगतं वचः4.12.12।।
explanation: Then wise Rama embraced handsome Sugriva and replied in these words which were agreeable to Lakshmana:

shloka_text: अस्माद्गच्छेम किष्किन्धां क्षिप्रं गच्छ त्वमग्रतः। गत्वा चाह्वय सुग्रीव वालिनं भ्रातृगन्धिनम्4.12.13।।
explanation: 'O Sugriva, get ready at once. We will promptly proceed to Kishkinda from here. Go ahead and challenge Vali, your brother only in name, to a combat.'

shloka_text: सर्वे ते त्वरितं गत्वा किष्किन्धां वालिनः पुरीम्। वृक्षैरात्मानमावृत्य व्यतिष्ठन्गहने वने4.12.14।।
explanation: Thay all rushed to Kishkinda, the capital of Vali and waited in the thick forest behind the trees.

shloka_text: सुग्रीवो व्यनदद्घोरं वालिनोऽऽह्वानकारणात्। गाढं परिहितो वेगान्नादैर्भिन्दन्निवाम्बरम्4.12.15।।
explanation: Sugriva tightened up his waist cloth hurriedly and roared terrifically as though piercing the sky. And screamed  for Vali.

shloka_text: तं श्रुत्वा निनदं भ्रातुः क्रुद्धो वाली महाबलः। निश्चक्राम सुसंरब्धो भास्करोऽस्ततटादिव4.12.16।।
explanation: On hearing his brother roaring, powerful Vali was enraged and rushed like the Sun from behind the western shore of the ocean (this simile suggests the downfall of Vali).

shloka_text: ततस्सुतुमुलं युद्धं वालिसुग्रीवयोरभूत्। गगने ग्रहयोर्घोरं बुधाङ्गारकयोरिव4.12.17।।
explanation: Then a tumultuous combat took place between Vali and Sugriva who looked like the planets Mercury and Mars.

shloka_text: तलैरशनिकल्पैश्च वज्रकल्पैश्च मुष्टिभिः। जघ्नतुस्समरेऽन्योन्यं भ्रातरौ क्रोधमूर्छितौ4.12.18।।
explanation: The brothers, insensate with fury, struck each other like thunder with their palms, soles  and fists in the combat.

shloka_text: ततो रामो धनुष्पाणिस्तावुभौ समुदीक्ष्यतु। अन्योन्यसदृशौ वीरावुभौ देवाविवाश्विनौ4.12.19।।
explanation: Bow in hand, Rama watched both the heroes who resembled the twin Aswini Kumaras.

shloka_text: यन्नावगच्छत्सुग्रीवं वालिनं वापि राघवः। ततो न कृतवान्बुद्धिं मोक्तुमन्तकरं शरम्4.12.20।।
explanation: Since Rama was not able to distinguish between Vali and Sugriva, he could not decide whether he should discharge his deadly arrow .

shloka_text: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे भग्नस्सुग्रीवस्तेन वालिना। अपश्यन्राघवं नाथमृश्यमूकं प्रदुद्रुवे4.12.21।।
explanation: Discomfited  by Vali, and not seeing Rama around, Sugriva ran towards Rishyamuka mountain.

shloka_text: क्लान्तो रुधिरसिक्ताङ्गः प्रहारैर्जर्झरीकृतः। वालिनाऽभिद्रुतः क्रोधात्प्रविवेश महावनम्4.12.22।।
explanation: Exhausted, disfigured and body mauled and drenched in blood all over, Sugriva, chased by the infuriated Vali, entered the region of  great sage Matanga.

shloka_text: तं प्रविष्टं वनं दृष्ट्वा वाली शापभयार्दितः। मुक्तो ह्यसि त्वमित्युक्त्वा स निवृत्तो महाद्युतिः4.12.23।।
explanation: Effulgent Vali saw Sugriva entering the (prohibited) grove and turned back due to the fear of the curse (of sage Matanga) saying, 'You have escaped'.

shloka_text: राघवोऽसि सह भ्रात्रा सह चैव हनूमता। तदेव वनमागच्छत्सुग्रीवो यत्र वानरः4.12.24।।
explanation: Rama together with Lakshmana and Hanuman also arrived at the same gave where  Sugriva was.

shloka_text: तं समीक्ष्यागतं रामं सुग्रीवस्सहलक्ष्मणम्। ह्रीमान्दीनमुवाचेदं वसुधामवलोकयन्4.12.25।।
explanation: At the sight of Rama accompanied by Lakshmana, Sugriva felt ashmed and aggrieved, and looking down on the ground, said:

shloka_text: आह्वयस्वेति मामुक्त्वा दर्शयित्वा च विक्रमम्। वैरिणा घातयित्वा च किमिदानीं त्वया कृतम्4.12.26।।
explanation: 'You demonstrated your prowess and directed me to challenge Vali and then why did you make the enemy hit me thus?

shloka_text: तामेन वेलां वक्तव्यं त्वया राघव तत्त्वतः। वालिनं न निहन्मीति ततो नाहमितो व्रजे4.12.27।।
explanation: 'Had you, in fact, told me that you were not going to kill Vali, I would not have budged from this place.'

shloka_text: तस्य चैवं ब्रुवाणस्य सुग्रीवस्य महात्मनः। करुणं दीनया वाचा राघवः पुनरब्रवीत्4.12.28।।
explanation: On hearing the great Sugriva's miserable and moving words, Rama again said:

shloka_text: सुग्रीव श्रूयातां तात क्रोधश्च व्यपनीयताम्। कारणं येन बाणोऽयं न मया स विसर्जितः4.12.29।।
explanation: 'O dear Sugriva dispel your anger and listen to me why I had not released the arrow.

shloka_text: अलङ्कारेण वेषेण प्रमाणेन गतेन च। त्वं च सुग्रीव वाली च सदृशौ स्थः परस्परम्4.12.30।।
explanation: 'O Sugriva in form, ornaments and movements there is perfect resemblance between you and Vali.

shloka_text: स्वरेण वर्चसा चैव प्रेक्षितेन च वानर। विक्रमेण च वाक्यैश्च व्यक्तिं वां नोपलक्षये4.12.31।।
explanation: 'O monkey in your voice, in brightness, in looks, in valour or in words I have marked no difference between you.

shloka_text: ततोऽहं रूपसादृश्यान्मोहितो वानरोत्तम। नोत्सृजामि महावेगं शरं शत्रुनिबर्हणम्4.12.32।।
explanation: 'O distinguished monkey you both are so similar in form that I was puzzled and did not release my swift arrow that could have destroyed the enemy.

shloka_text: जीवितान्तकरं घोरं सादृश्यात्तु विशङ्कितः। मूलघातो न नौ स्याद्धि द्वयोरपि कृतो मया4.12.33।।
explanation: 'I was doubtful because of your similar appearance. I thought that I should not strike at the very root of the interests of both of us. Therefore, I did not release the terrific and deadly  arrow.

shloka_text: त्वयि वीरे विपन्ने हि अज्ञानाल्लाघवान्मया। मौढ्यं च मम बाल्यं च ख्यापितं स्यात्कपीश्वर4.12.34।।
explanation: 'O lord of monkeys I would have betrayed my foolishness and childishness had I exposed you to danger by my ignorance and thoughtlessness.

shloka_text: दत्ताभयवधो नाम पातकं महदुच्यते। अहं च लक्ष्मणश्चैव सीता च वरवर्णिनी4.12.35।। त्वदधीना वयं सर्वे वनेऽस्मिन् शरणं भवान्।
explanation: 'It is said that killing a person to whom protection is promised is highly sinful. Lakshmana, darling Sita and me, are under your care and you are our refuge.

shloka_text: तस्माद्युध्यस्व भूयस्त्वं मा मा शङ्केश्च वानर4.12.36।। एतन्मुहूर्ते सुग्रीव पश्य वालिनमाहवे। निरस्तमिषुणैकेन वेष्टमानं महीतले4.12.37।।
explanation: 'Therefore, O monkey, go and engage yourself in fight again. Do not suspect me. With this single arrow of mine, in one moment you will see Vali thrown down and rolling on the ground in this combat.

shloka_text: तस्माद्युध्यस्व भूयस्त्वं मा मा शङ्केश्च वानर4.12.36।। एतन्मुहूर्ते सुग्रीव पश्य वालिनमाहवे। निरस्तमिषुणैकेन वेष्टमानं महीतले4.12.37।।
explanation: 'Therefore, O monkey, go and engage yourself in fight again. Do not suspect me. With this single arrow of mine, in one moment you will see Vali thrown down and rolling on the ground in this combat.

shloka_text: अभिज्ञानं कुरुष्व त्वमात्मनो वानरेश्वर। येन त्वामभिजानीयां द्वन्द्वयुद्धमुपागतम्4.12.38।।
explanation: 'O lord of monkeys while you both are engaged in a duel wear some identification mark by which I can recognise you.

shloka_text: गजपुष्पीमिमां फुल्लामुत्पाट्य शुभलक्षणाम्। कुरु लक्ष्मण कण्ठेऽस्य सुग्रीवस्य महात्मनः।।4.12.39।।
explanation: 'O Lakshmana this Gajapushpi  in bloom is auspicious. Pluck and fasten it on great Sugriva's neck.'

shloka_text: ततो गिरितटे जातामुत्पाट्य कुसुमाकुलाम्। लक्ष्मणो गजपुष्पीं तां तस्य कण्ठे व्यसर्जयत्4.12.40।।
explanation: Then Lakshmana went to the mountain slope, plucked the (creeper with) gajapuspi blossoms and fastened it on the neck of Sugriva.

shloka_text: स तया शुशुभे श्रीमान् लतया कण्ठसक्तया। मालयेव बलाकानां ससन्ध्य इव तोयदः4.12.41।।
explanation: With the creeper round the neck, Sugriva looked like the raincloud at twilight, adorned by a row of cranes like a garland.

shloka_text: विभ्राजमानो वपुषा रामवाक्यसमाहितः। जगाम सह रामेण किष्किन्थां वालिपालिताम्4.12.42।।
explanation: Radiant Sugriva intent on carrying out Rama's words again went to Kishkinda ruled by Vali. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे द्वादशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the twelfth sarga of Kishkindakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: ऋष्यमूकात्स धर्मात्मा किष्किन्धां लक्ष्मणाग्रजः। जगाम सहसुग्रीवो वालिविक्रमपालिताम्4.13.1।।
explanation: Lakshmana's righteous elder brother left Rishyamuka with Sugriva for Kishkinda protected by Vali's valour.

shloka_text: समुद्यम्य महच्चापं रामः काञ्चनभूषितम्। शरांश्चादित्यसङ्काशान्गृहीत्वा रणसाधकान्4.13.2।।
explanation: Getting ready to go, Rama took up his great bow and arrows adorned with gold and potent in war looking (dazzling) like the Sun.

shloka_text: अग्रतस्तु ययौ तस्य राघवस्य महात्मनः। सुग्रीवः संहतग्रीवो लक्ष्मणश्च महाबलः4.13.3।।
explanation: The strongnecked Sugriva and mighty Lakshmana walked in front of the highsouled Rama.

shloka_text: पृष्ठतो हनुमान्वीरो नलो नीलश्च वानरः। तारश्चैव महातेजा हरियूथपयूथपः4.13.4।।
explanation: Brave and brilliant Hanuman, Nala, Nila, and Tara among the leaders of the monkeys  walked behind.

shloka_text: ते वीक्षमाणा वृक्षांश्च पुष्पभारावलम्बिनः। प्रसन्नाम्बुवहाश्चैव सरितस्सागरङ्गमाः4.13.5।।
explanation: They saw (on the way) trees bent down with the load of flowers, and rivers with pure water flowing into the sea.

shloka_text: कन्दराणि च शैलांश्च निर्दराणि गुहास्तथा। शिखराणि च मुख्यानि दरीश्च प्रियदर्शनाः4.13.6।।
explanation: (They saw) beautiful valleys, mountains, caves, prominent peaks with deep caverns.

shloka_text: वैढूर्यविमलै:पर्णै पद्मैश्चाकोशकुट्मलैः। शोभितांत्सजलान्मार्गे तटाकांश्च व्यलोकयन्4.13.7।।
explanation: Observing on the way delightful lotus buds with leaves like Vaidurya, clear water and full tanks (They moved on).

shloka_text: कारण्डैस्सारसैर्हंसैर्वञ्जुलैर्जलकुक्कुटैः। चक्रवाकै स्तथा चान्यैश्शकुनैः रुपनादितान्4.13.8।।
explanation: Ducks, cranes, swans, vanjulas, waterfowls, chakravakas and other birds warbling melodiously.

shloka_text: मृदुशष्पाङ्कुराहारान्निर्भयान्वनगोचरान्। चरतस्सर्वतौऽपश्यन् स्थलीषु हरिणान् स्थितान्4.13.9।।
explanation: They observed deer feeding on tender grass on the ground around without fear, some standing and some roaming the forest

shloka_text: तटाकवैरिणश्चापि शुक्लदन्तविभूषितान्। घोरानेकचरान्वन्यान्द्विरदान्कूलघातिनः4.13.10।।
explanation: Observing terrific elephants adorned with white tusks wandering alone destroying the tanks, shattering the banks.

shloka_text: मत्तान्गिरितटोत्कृष्टान्पर्वतानिव जङ्गमान्। वारणान्वारिदप्रख्यान्महीरेणुसमुक्षितान्4.13.11।।
explanation: (Observing) intoxicated elephants knocking the edges of mountain slopes, elephants resembling (dark) rainbearing clouds, elephants like moving mountains, elephants with dust covered all over the body.

shloka_text: वने वनचरांश्चान्यान्खेचरांश्च विहङ्गमान्। पश्यन्तस्त्वरिता जग्मुस्सुग्रीववशवर्तिनः4.13.12।।
explanation: Following Sugriva faithfully, they proceeded swiftly, observing animals of the forest and birds flying in the sky.

shloka_text: तेषां तु गच्छतां तत्र त्वरितं रघुनन्दनः। द्रुमषण्डं वनं दृष्ट्वा रामस्सुग्रीवमब्रवीत्4.13.13।।
explanation: While walking fast, looking at the forest full of trees Rama, the delight of the Raghus said to Sugriva:

shloka_text: एष मेघ इवाकाशे वृक्षषण्डः प्रकाशते। मेघसङ्घातविपुलः पर्यन्तकदलीवृतः4.13.14।।
explanation: 'This cluster of trees surrounded by plantain groves look splendid like a vast collection of clouds in the sky.

shloka_text: किमेतत् ज्ञातुमिच्छामि सखे कौतूहलं हि मे। कौतूहलापनयनं कर्तुमिच्छाम्यहं त्वया4.13.15।।
explanation: 'O friend I wish to know what this is? Could you answer my curiosity?'

shloka_text: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा राघवस्य महात्मनः। गच्छन्नेवाचचक्षेऽथ सुग्रीवस्तन्महद्वनम्4.13.16।।
explanation: On hearing great Rama's words while walking in the extensive forest,  Sugriva started narrating:

shloka_text: एतद्राघव विस्तीर्णमाश्रमं श्रमनाशनम्। उद्यानवनसम्पन्नं स्वादुमूलफलोदकम्4.13.17।।
explanation: 'O Raghava this is a hermitage, enchanting with vast gardens and trees bearing sweet fruits, full of tasty roots and water that relieves tiresomeness (of travellers).

shloka_text: अत्र सप्तजना नाम मुनय स्संश्रितव्रताः। सप्तैवासन्नधशशीर्षा नियतं जलशायिनः4.13.18।।
explanation: Here, the seven sages, known as Saptajana, who observed strict vows, were seven, constantly lying in water with their heads downwards.

shloka_text: सप्तरात्रकृताहारा वायुनाचलवासिनः। दिवं वर्षशतैर्याताः सप्तभिः सकलेबराः4.13.19।।
explanation: 'These seven sages used to live on air and that too once in seven nights. They lived for seven hundred years performing penance with motionlessness and attained heaven along with their bodies.

shloka_text: तेषामेवं प्रभावानां द्रुमप्राकारसंवृतम्। आश्रमस्सुदुराधर्ष अपि सेन्द्रैस्सुरासुरैः4.13.20।।
explanation: 'By virtue of the power of their penance, this hermitage surrounded by a row of trees is impenetrable even for demons and gods including Indra.

shloka_text: पक्षिणो वर्जयन्त्येतत्तथाऽन्ये वनचारिणः। विशन्ति मोहाद्येऽप्यत्र निवर्तन्ते न ते पुनः4.13.21।।
explanation: 'Birds and wild animals avoid the hermitage and whoever enters there out of ignorance never returns.

shloka_text: विभूषणरवास्तत्र श्रूयन्ते सकलाक्षराः। तूर्यगीतस्वनाश्चात्र गन्धो दिव्यश्च राघव4.13.22।।
explanation: 'O Rama, one can hear pleasant sounds of jingling ornaments (of nymphs), of songs and windinstruments here. One can inhale divine fragrance, too.

shloka_text: त्रेताग्नयोऽपि दीप्यन्ते दूमो ह्यत्र प्रकाशते। वेष्टयन्निव वृक्षाग्रान्कपोताङ्गारुणो घनः4.13.23।।
explanation: 'The three sacred fires keep burning and the thick smoke they emit resembles the red feet of  pigeons. It shines forth as if enveloping the treetops.

shloka_text: एते वृक्षाः प्रकाशन्ते धूमसंसक्तमस्तकाः। मेघजालप्रतिच्छन्ना वैढूर्यगिरयो यथा4.13.24।।
explanation: 'These treetops covered with thick smoke glow like mountains of Vaidurya concealed by a cluster of clouds.

shloka_text: कुरु प्रणामं धर्मात्मंस्तेषामुद्दिश्य राघव। लक्ष्मणेव सह भ्रात्रा प्रयन्तस्सयताञ्जलिः4.13.25।।
explanation: 'O rigteous Rama you and your brother Lakshmana humbly offer obeisance to them(sacred hermitage and sages Saptajana) with folded hands and meditate on them.

shloka_text: प्रणमन्ति हि ये तेषां मुनीनां भावितात्मनाम्। न तेषामशुभं किञ्चिच्छरीरे राम दृश्यते4.13.26।।
explanation: 'O Rama, nothing inauspicious happens to them who offer obeisance to those highly spiritual sacred sages.'

shloka_text: ततो रामस्सह भ्रात्रा लक्ष्मणेन कृताञ्जलिः। समुद्दिश्य महात्मानस्तानृषीनभ्यवादयत्4.13.27।।
explanation: Rama and Lakshmana  offered salutations with folded hands in memory of those great sages, great souls.
