shloka_text: ग्रसमान इवाकाशं ताराधिपमिवोल्लिखन्। हरन्निव सनक्षत्रं गगनं सार्कमण्डलम्।।5.57.5।। मारुतस्यात्मजः श्रीमान्कपिर्व्योमचरो महान्। हनुमान्मेघजालानि विकर्षन्निव गच्छति।।5.57.6।।
explanation: Great Hanuman, son of the Windgod, flew through the abode of the Windgod as if he was swallowing the space, scratching the  Moon, lord of the stars, as if seizing the heavens along with the constellation of Sun and stars and as though he was drawing the clusters of clouds.

shloka_text: ग्रसमान इवाकाशं ताराधिपमिवोल्लिखन्। हरन्निव सनक्षत्रं गगनं सार्कमण्डलम्।।5.57.5।। मारुतस्यात्मजः श्रीमान्कपिर्व्योमचरो महान्। हनुमान्मेघजालानि विकर्षन्निव गच्छति।।5.57.6।।
explanation: Great Hanuman, son of the Windgod, flew through the abode of the Windgod as if he was swallowing the space, scratching the  Moon, lord of the stars, as if seizing the heavens along with the constellation of Sun and stars and as though he was drawing the clusters of clouds.

shloka_text: पाण्डुरारुणवर्णानि नीलमाञ्जिष्ठकानि च। हरितारुणवर्णानि महाभ्राणि चकाशिरे।।5.57.7।।
explanation: (In contact with Hanuman) the clouds shone forth brilliantly in white and black, in blue and yellow and in greenish red colour.

shloka_text: प्रविशन्नभ्रजालानि निष्पतंश्च पुनः पुनः। प्रच्छन्नश्च प्रकाशश्च चन्द्रमा इव लक्ष्यते।।5.57.8।।
explanation: With his exist and entrances into the mass of clouds, his appearances and disappearances among the clouds, he looked like the Moon.

shloka_text: विविधाभ्रघनापन्नगोचरो धवलाम्बरः। दृश्यादृश्यतनुर्वीरस्तदा चन्द्रायतेऽम्बरे।।5.57.9।।
explanation: Passing through the clouds, appearing and disappearing, the heroic Hanuman clad in white was like the Moon in the white sky.

shloka_text: तार्क्ष्यायमाणो गगने बभासे वायुनन्दनः। दारयन्मेघबृन्दानि निष्पतंश्च पुनः पुनः।।5.57.10।। नदन्नादेन महता मेघस्वनमहास्वनः।
explanation: As he made his way through flakes of clouds, again and again appearing and disappearing, Hanuman the delight of the Windgod shone in the sky roaring like a thundering cloud. He looked like Garuda.

shloka_text: प्रवरान्राक्षसान् हत्वा नाम विश्राव्य चात्मनः।।5.57.11।। आकुलां नगरीं कृत्वा व्यथयित्वा च रावणम्। अर्दयित्वा बलं घोरं वैदेहीमभिवाद्य च।।5.57.12।। आजगाम महातेजाः पुनर्मध्येन सागरम्।
explanation: The glorious Hanuman, having killed eminent ogres and thereby making himself widely known, having caused havoc to the city of Lanka and  terrific sorrow to Ravana by tormenting the army, offered salutations to Vaidehi from midocean and continued his journey.

shloka_text: प्रवरान्राक्षसान् हत्वा नाम विश्राव्य चात्मनः।।5.57.11।। आकुलां नगरीं कृत्वा व्यथयित्वा च रावणम्। अर्दयित्वा बलं घोरं वैदेहीमभिवाद्य च।।5.57.12।। आजगाम महातेजाः पुनर्मध्येन सागरम्।
explanation: The glorious Hanuman, having killed eminent ogres and thereby making himself widely known, having caused havoc to the city of Lanka and  terrific sorrow to Ravana by tormenting the army, offered salutations to Vaidehi from midocean and continued his journey.

shloka_text: पर्वतेन्द्रं सुनाभं च समुपस्पृश्य वीर्यवान्।।5.57.13।। ज्यामुक्त इव नाराचो महावेगोऽभ्युपागतः।
explanation: The valiant Hanuman touched the lord of mountains fondly and went with great speed just as an arrow released from the centre of a powerful bowstring.

shloka_text: स किञ्चिदनुसम्प्राप्तः समालोक्य महागिरिम्।।5.57.14।। महेन्द्रं मेघसङ्काशं ननाद हरिपुङ्गवः।
explanation: The chief of the monkeys arrived near, and beholding the face of the Mahendra mountain, which resembled a mass of clouds, thundered.

shloka_text: स पूरयामास कपिर्दिशो दश समन्ततः।।5.57.15।। नदन्नादेन महता मेघस्वनमहास्वनः।
explanation: The thundering noise of Hanuman filled all the ten directions with great sound.

shloka_text: स तं देशमनुप्राप्तः सुहृद्धर्शनलालसः।।5.57.16।। ननाद हरिशार्दूलो लाङ्गूलं चाप्यकम्पयत्।
explanation: Having sighted the place of his companions and waiting to see them for long that tiger among monkeys made a loud noise and shook his tail in joy.

shloka_text: तस्य नानद्यमानस्य सुपर्णचरिते पथि।।5.57.17।। फलतीवास्य घोषेण गगनं सार्कमण्डलम्।
explanation: By the terrific sounds made by Hanuman in joy, it seemed as though the pathway of Garuda, the sky along with the Sun's orbit was splitting.

shloka_text: ये तु तत्रोत्तरे तीरे समुद्रस्य महाबलाः।।5.57.18।। पूर्वं संविष्ठिताश्शूरा वायुपुत्रदिदृक्षवः। महतो वातनुन्नस्य तोयदस्येव गर्जितम्।।5.57.19।। शुश्रुवुस्ते तदा घोषमूरुवेगं हनूमतः।
explanation: Thereafter the brave and powerful monkeys waiting on the northern shore of the ocean for the arrival of the son of the Windgod, heard the roar and thundering sound of the stormy cloud produced by the sweeping motion of Hanuman's thighs propelled by the speed of his movement.

shloka_text: ये तु तत्रोत्तरे तीरे समुद्रस्य महाबलाः।।5.57.18।। पूर्वं संविष्ठिताश्शूरा वायुपुत्रदिदृक्षवः। महतो वातनुन्नस्य तोयदस्येव गर्जितम्।।5.57.19।। शुश्रुवुस्ते तदा घोषमूरुवेगं हनूमतः।
explanation: Thereafter the brave and powerful monkeys waiting on the northern shore of the ocean for the arrival of the son of the Windgod, heard the roar and thundering sound of the stormy cloud produced by the sweeping motion of Hanuman's thighs propelled by the speed of his movement.

shloka_text: ते दीनमनसस्सर्वे शुश्रुवुः काननौकसः।।5.57.20।। वानरेन्द्रस्य निर्घोषं पर्जन्यनिनदोपमम्।
explanation: All the vanaras who were feeling dejected and waiting anxiously heard the noise of Hanuman that sounded like a thundering cloud.

shloka_text: निशम्य नदतो नादं वानरास्ते समन्ततः।।5.57.21।। बभूवुरुत्सुकास्सर्वे सुहृद्धर्शनकाङ्क्षिणः।
explanation: On hearing the loud voice of Hanuman, all the vanaras were longing to see their friend.

shloka_text: जाम्बवान् स हरिश्रेष्ठः प्रीतिसंहृष्टमानसः।।5.57.22।। उपामन्त्र्य हरीन् सर्वानिदं वचनमब्रवीत्।
explanation: Jambavan the chief of vanaras became very happy at heart and called all the vanaras and spoke:

shloka_text: सर्वथा कृतकार्योऽसौ हनुमान्नात्र संशयः।।5.57.23।। न ह्यस्याकृतकार्यस्य नाद एवंविधो भवेत्।
explanation: "Oh Hanuman is always successful. If he has not, he would not make sounds in this manner".

shloka_text: तस्य बाहूरुवेगं च निनादं च महात्मनः।।5.57.24।। निशम्य हरयो हृष्टाः समुत्पेतुस्ततस्ततः।
explanation: Hearing the sound of his dashing movements of arms and thighs the vanaras jumped about in joy, then and there.

shloka_text: ते नगाग्रान्नगाग्राणि शिखराच्छिखराणि च।।5.57.25।। प्रहृष्टाः समपद्यन्त हनूमन्तं दिदृक्षवः।
explanation: The vanaras were very happy. Longing to see Hanuman, they jumped from one tree top to another and from one peak of a mountain to the other.

shloka_text: ते प्रीताः पादपाग्रेषु गृह्य शाखाः सुविष्ठिताः।।5.57.26।। वासांसीव प्रशाखाश्च समाविध्यन्त वानराः।
explanation: Waiting for Hanuman, the vanaras jumped from the tree tops holding the branches. They shook the branches just like clothes to welcome friends.

shloka_text: गिरिगह्वरसंलीनो यथा गर्जति मारुतः।।5.57.27।। एवं जगर्ज बलवान् हनुमान्मारुतात्मजः।
explanation: Hanuman, the powerful son of the Windgod roared like the wind captured in a mountain cave would.

shloka_text: तमभ्रघनसङ्काशमापतन्तं महाकपिम्।।5.57.28।। दृष्ट्वा ते वानरास्सर्वे तस्थुः प्राञ्जलयस्तदा।
explanation: (On seeing) Hanuman, who was resembling a heavy cloud approaching, the vanaras stood with folded hands.

shloka_text: ततस्तु वेगवांस्तस्य गिरेर्गिरिनिभः कपिः।।5.57.29।। निपपात महेन्द्रस्य शिखरे पादपाकुले।
explanation: Thereafter the vanara, who resembled a mountain, descended with great speed on the summit of mount Mahendra full of trees.

shloka_text: हर्षेणापूर्यमाणोऽसौ रम्ये पर्वतनिर्झरे।।5.57.30।। छिन्नपक्ष इवाऽकाशात्पपात धरणीधरः।
explanation: Overwhelmed with immeasurable joy, Hanuman descended from the sky like the mountain with its wings cut off and dropped on the bank of a mountain stream.

shloka_text: ततस्ते प्रीतमनसस्सर्वे वानरपुङ्गवाः।।5.57.31।। हनुमन्तं महात्मानं परिवार्योपतस्थिरे। परिवार्य च ते सर्वे परां प्रीतिमुपागताः।।5.57.32।।
explanation: Feeling very happy at heart all the vanara leaders gathered around Hanuman. They  stood motionless with extreme happiness.

shloka_text: ततस्ते प्रीतमनसस्सर्वे वानरपुङ्गवाः।।5.57.31।। हनुमन्तं महात्मानं परिवार्योपतस्थिरे। परिवार्य च ते सर्वे परां प्रीतिमुपागताः।।5.57.32।।
explanation: Feeling very happy at heart all the vanara leaders gathered around Hanuman. They  stood motionless with extreme happiness.

shloka_text: प्रहृष्टवदना स्सर्वे तमरोगमुपागतम्। उपायनानि चादाय मूलानि च फलानि च।।5.57.33।। प्रत्यर्चयन् हरिश्रेष्ठं हरयो मारुतात्मजम्।
explanation: The vanaras were filled with joy seeing Hanuman who returned unhurt. They offered roots and fruits to him. Hanuman on his part offered salutations to the foremost of the monkeys.

shloka_text: हनुमांस्तु गुरून् वृद्धाञ्जाम्बवत्प्रमुखांस्तदा।।5.57.34।। कुमारमङ्गदं चैव सोऽवन्दत महाकपिः।
explanation: The great Hanuman also offered salutations to elders, preceptors such as Jambavan and other leaders. He also saluted the young Angada.

shloka_text: स ताभ्यां पूजितः पूज्यः कपिभिश्च प्रसादितः।।5.57.35।। दृष्टा सीतेति विक्रान्त स्संक्षेपेण न्यवेदयत्।
explanation: The valiant Hanuman worthy of worship having been honoured by both Jambavan and Angada was pleased. He responded briefly, saying 'Saw Sita'.

shloka_text: निषसाद च हस्तेन गृहीत्वा वालिनस्सुतम्।।5.57.36।। रमणीये वनोद्देशे महेन्द्रस्य गिरेस्तदा।
explanation: Then holding the hand of Vali's son he sat down at a beautiful location of the garden of mountain Mahendra.

shloka_text: हनुमानब्रवीद्धृष्टस्तदा तान्वानरर्षभान्।।5.57.37।। अशोकवनिकासंस्था दृष्टा सा जनकात्मजा। रक्षमाणा सुघोराभी राक्षसीभिरनिन्दिता।।5.57.38।। एकवेणीधरा बाला रामदर्शनलालसा। उपवासपरिश्रान्ता जटिला मलिना कृशा।।5.57.39।।
explanation: Hanuman felt happy and told Angada, the bull of vanaras, "I saw Sita in the groves of Ashoka guarded by dreadful ogres. She is blameless, eager to see Rama. She is wearing a single braid of hair. She is young and emaciated due to fasting. Her hair is matted and soiled".

shloka_text: हनुमानब्रवीद्धृष्टस्तदा तान्वानरर्षभान्।।5.57.37।। अशोकवनिकासंस्था दृष्टा सा जनकात्मजा। रक्षमाणा सुघोराभी राक्षसीभिरनिन्दिता।।5.57.38।। एकवेणीधरा बाला रामदर्शनलालसा। उपवासपरिश्रान्ता जटिला मलिना कृशा।।5.57.39।।
explanation: Hanuman felt happy and told Angada, the bull of vanaras, "I saw Sita in the groves of Ashoka guarded by dreadful ogres. She is blameless, eager to see Rama. She is wearing a single braid of hair. She is young and emaciated due to fasting. Her hair is matted and soiled".

shloka_text: हनुमानब्रवीद्धृष्टस्तदा तान्वानरर्षभान्।।5.57.37।। अशोकवनिकासंस्था दृष्टा सा जनकात्मजा। रक्षमाणा सुघोराभी राक्षसीभिरनिन्दिता।।5.57.38।। एकवेणीधरा बाला रामदर्शनलालसा। उपवासपरिश्रान्ता जटिला मलिना कृशा।।5.57.39।।
explanation: Hanuman felt happy and told Angada, the bull of vanaras, "I saw Sita in the groves of Ashoka guarded by dreadful ogres. She is blameless, eager to see Rama. She is wearing a single braid of hair. She is young and emaciated due to fasting. Her hair is matted and soiled".

shloka_text: ततो दृष्टेति वचनं महार्थममृतोपमम्। निशम्य मारुतेस्सर्वे मुदिता वानराभवन्।।5.57.40।।
explanation: Then hearing Hanuman's meaningful and nectarlike words all the vanaras rejoiced.

shloka_text: क्ष्वेलन्त्यन्ये नदन्त्यन्ये गर्जन्त्यन्ये महाबलाः। चक्रुः किलकिलामन्ये प्रतिगर्जन्ति चापरे।।5.57.41।।
explanation: Some powerful vanaras howled, some chattered, some roared and some screamed, going round and round and others echoed the sounds.

shloka_text: केचिदुच्छ्रितलाङ्गूलाः प्रहृष्टाः कपिकुञ्जराः। आयताञ्चितदीर्घाणि लाङ्गूलानि प्रविव्यधुः।।5.57.42।।
explanation: Some elephantlike vanaras who were excited and felt overjoyed lifted their long and beautiful tails and hit them on the ground.

shloka_text: अपरे च हनूमन्तं वानरा वारणोपमम्। आप्लुत्य गिरिशृङ्गेभ्यस्संस्पृशन्ति स्म हर्षिताः।।5.57.43।।
explanation: A few vanaras jumped down from the mountain top and hugged the elephantlike Hanuman.

shloka_text: उक्तवाक्यं हनूमन्तमङ्गदस्तमथाब्रवीत्। सर्वेषां हरिवीराणां मध्ये वचनमुत्तमम्।।5.57.44।।
explanation: And hearing Hanuman's sweetest words, Angada addressed the heroic vanaras

shloka_text: सत्त्वे वीर्ये न ते कश्चित्समो वानर विद्यते। यदवप्लुत्य विस्तीर्णं सागरं पुनरागतः।।5.57.45।।
explanation: "O vanara you have leaped such a wide ocean and have returned. In strength and valour. There is none equal to you.

shloka_text: अहो स्वामिनि ते भक्तिरहो वीर्यमहो धृतिः। दिष्ट्या दृष्टा त्वया देवी रामपत्नी यशस्विनी।।5.57.46।। दिष्ट्या त्यक्ष्यति काकुत्स्थ श्शोकं सीतावियोगजम्।
explanation: "O your devotion to the king, O your valour, fortitude  and courage is admirable. You could see Rama's wife, an illustrious lady. This is a matter of our good luck. Rama will (now) shed the sorrow due to separation from Sita.

shloka_text: ततोऽङ्गदं हनूमन्तं जाम्बवन्तं च वानराः।।5.57.47।। परिवार्य प्रमुदिता भेजिरे विपुलाश्शिलाः।
explanation: Then the vanaras went round all the three Angada, Hanuman and Jambavan. Out of joy they lay down on the huge rocks.

shloka_text: श्रोतुकामास्समुद्रस्य लङ्घनं वानरोत्तमाः।।5.57.48।। दर्शनं चापि लङ्कायास्सीताया रावणस्य च। तस्थुः प्राञ्जलयस्सर्वे हनुमद्वचनोन्मुखाः।।5.57.49।।
explanation: All the vanaras longing to listen to Hanuman about his crossing the ocean, seeing Lanka, Sita and Ravana kept looking at the face of Hanuman.

shloka_text: श्रोतुकामास्समुद्रस्य लङ्घनं वानरोत्तमाः।।5.57.48।। दर्शनं चापि लङ्कायास्सीताया रावणस्य च। तस्थुः प्राञ्जलयस्सर्वे हनुमद्वचनोन्मुखाः।।5.57.49।।
explanation: All the vanaras longing to listen to Hanuman about his crossing the ocean, seeing Lanka, Sita and Ravana kept looking at the face of Hanuman.

shloka_text: तस्थौ तत्राङ्गदः श्रीमान् वानरैर्बहुभिर्वृतः। उपास्यमानो विबुधैर्दिवि देवपतिर्यथा।।5.57.50।।
explanation: Surrounded by many great vanaras, Angada was shining like Indra, lord of the gods attended by the gods in heaven.

shloka_text: हनूमता कीर्तिमता यशस्विना तथाङ्गदेनाङ्गदबद्धबाहुना। मुदा तदाऽध्यासितमुन्नतं महन्महीधराग्रं ज्वलितं श्रियाभवत्।।5.57.51।।
explanation: The mountain peak graced by famous Hanuman and renowned Angada bedecked with armlets seated on top joyfully, appeared prosperous and splendid. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे सप्तपञ्चाशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fiftyseventh sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: ततस्तस्य गिरेः शृङ्गे महेन्द्रस्य महाबलाः। हनुमत्प्रमुखाः प्रीतिं हरयो जग्मुरुत्तमाम्।।5.58.1।।
explanation: Then the mighty Hanuman and other vanaras having assembled on the summit of mountain Mahendra and felt vey much happy.

shloka_text: तं ततः प्रीतिसंहृष्टः प्रीतिमन्तं महाकपिम्। जाम्बवान्कार्यवृत्तान्तमपृच्छदनिलात्मजम्।।5.58.2।।
explanation: Thereafter, very delighted Jambavan inquired Hanuman most affectionately of all that happened.

shloka_text: कथं दृष्टा त्वया देवी कथं वा तत्र वर्तते। तस्यां वा स कथंवृत्तः क्रूरकर्मा दशाननः।।5.58.3।।
explanation: "How did you find the godlike lady? How was she? How was the tenheaded one, cruel in action, behaving with her? You may narrate what she said.

shloka_text: तत्त्वतस्सर्वमेतन्नः प्रब्रूहि त्वं महाकपे। श्रुतार्थाश्चिन्तयिष्यामो भूयः कार्यविनिश्चयम्।।5.58.4।।
explanation: "O Hanuman, tell us in detail  the entire thing. On hearing it, we will think about the next course of action.

shloka_text: यश्चार्थस्तत्त्र वक्तव्यो गतैरस्माभिरात्मवान्। रक्षितव्यं च यत्तत्र तद्भवान्व्याकरोतु नः।।5.58.5।।
explanation: "You are wise and you should tell us in detail what is to be told and what has to be hidden when we report."

shloka_text: स नियुक्तस्ततस्तेन सम्प्रहृष्टतनूरुहः। प्रणम्य शिरसा देव्यै सीतायै प्रत्यभाषत।।5.58.6।।
explanation: Having been asked (by Jambavan and others) Hanuman with horripilations all over his body, bowed down and saluted in the direction of queen Sita and began:

shloka_text: प्रत्यक्षमेव भवतां महेन्द्राग्रात्खामाप्लुतः। उदधेर्दक्षिणं पारं काङ्क्षमाण स्समाहितः।।5.58.7।।
explanation: "I rose upwards leaping into the sky, intent on reaching the southern shore from the mountain Mahendra.It has been witnessed directly by all of you.

shloka_text: गच्छतश्च हि मे घोरं विघ्नरूपमिवाभवत्। काञ्चनं शिखरं दिव्यं पश्यामि सुमनोहरम्।।5.58.8।।
explanation: "Even as I was leaping I saw a terrific and wonderful golden peak which came as if to obstruct me on my path.

shloka_text: स्थितं पन्धानमावृत्य मेने विघ्नं च तं नगम्। उपसङ्गम्य तं दिव्यं काञ्चनं नगसत्तमम्।।5.58.9।। कृता मे मनसा बुद्धिर्भेत्तव्योऽयं मयेति च।
explanation: "The mountain stood on my way turning towards me in order to obstruct me. Then I resolved in my mind that this great, wonderful, golden mountain has to be smashed.

shloka_text: प्रहतं च मया तस्य लाङ्गूलेन महागिरेः।।5.58.10।। शिखरं सूर्यसङ्काशं व्यशीर्यत सहस्रधा।
explanation: "Hit by my tail the great mountain peak, which was radiating like the Sun was shattered into a thousand pieces.

shloka_text: व्यवसायं च तं बुद्ध्वा स होवाच महागिरिः।।5.58.11। पुत्त्रेति मधुरां वाणीं मनः प्रह्लादयन्निव।
explanation: "Perceiving that I am going to smash him he spoke to me in a sweet tone delighting my heart, addressing me like a son.

shloka_text: पितृव्यं चापि मां विद्धि सखायं मातरिश्वनः।।5.58.12।। मैनाकमिति विख्यातं निवसन्तं महोदधौ।
explanation: 'Know me to be a friend of windgod and so I am like your father's brother. I am dwelling in this great ocean and known as Mainaka.

shloka_text: पक्षवन्तः पुरा पुत्त्र बभूवुः पर्वतोत्तमाः।।5.58.13।। छन्दतः पृथिवीं चेरुर्बाधमानाः समन्ततः।
explanation: 'O son in the past, foremost of the mountains too had wings and they used to range  at will all over the earth tormenting all.

shloka_text: श्रुत्वा नगानां चरितं महेन्द्रः पाकशासनः।।5.58.14।। चिच्छेद भगवान् पक्षान्वज्रेणैषां सहस्रशः।
explanation: 'Mahendra, the killer of ogre Paka, heard the story (of the cruel deeds) of mountains and cut off their wings into a thousand pieces with his thunderbolt.

shloka_text: अहं तु मोक्षितस्तस्मात्तव पित्रा महात्मना।।5.58.15।। मारुतेन तदा वत्स प्रक्षिप्तोऽस्मि महार्णवे।
explanation: 'O son I was saved from Indra by your kind father Maruta who dropped me in this great  ocean.

shloka_text: रामस्य च मया साह्ये वर्तितव्यमरिन्दम।।5.58.16।। रामो धर्मभृतां श्रेष्ठो महेन्द्रसमविक्रमः।
explanation: 'O subduer of enemiesI must make efforts to help Rama the foremost among the righteous, for I have received help (from your father) who is equal to Indra in valour'.

shloka_text: एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य मैनाकस्य महात्मनः।।5.58.17।। कार्यमावेद्य तु गिरेरुद्यतं च मनो मम। तेन चाहमनुज्ञातो मैनाकेन महात्मना।।5.58.18।।
explanation: "When I heard Mainaka, I told him about my intention to go up. That great self Mainaka allowed me.

shloka_text: एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य मैनाकस्य महात्मनः।।5.58.17।। कार्यमावेद्य तु गिरेरुद्यतं च मनो मम। तेन चाहमनुज्ञातो मैनाकेन महात्मना।।5.58.18।।
explanation: "When I heard Mainaka, I told him about my intention to go up. That great self Mainaka allowed me.

shloka_text: स चाप्यन्तर्हितः शैलो मानुषेण वपुष्मता। शरीरेण महाशैलः शैलेन च महोदधौ।।5.58.19।।
explanation: "Then the huge mountain in human form concealed as huge mountains remain hidden in the ocean.

shloka_text: उत्तमं जवमास्थाय शेषं पन्थानमास्थितः। ततोऽहं सुचिरं कालं वेगेनाभ्यागमं पथि।।5.58.20।।
explanation: "Then with great speed I proceeded on my path. It took a long time to cross the ocean.

shloka_text: ततः पश्याम्यहं देवीं सुरसां नागमातरम्। समुद्रमध्ये सा देवी वचनं मामभाषत।।5.58.21।।
explanation: "I saw Surasa, the mother of serpents in the midst of the ocean and she said:

shloka_text: मम भक्षः प्रदिष्टस्त्वममरैर्हरिसत्तम। अतस्त्वां भक्षयिष्यामि विहितस्त्वं चिरस्य मे।।5.58.22।।
explanation: 'O powerful monkey you are destined to be my food provided by the immortals. Therefore, I will eat you as I have I found you after a long time. (of unsatiated hunger).'

shloka_text: एवमुक्त स्सुरसया प्राञ्जलिः प्रणतः स्थितः। विवर्णवदनो भूत्वा वाक्यं चेदमुदीरयम्।।5.58.23।।
explanation: "When addressed thus by Surasa, I bowed low with joined palms, stood before her with my face turned pale, and said:

shloka_text: रामो दाशरथिः श्रीमान् प्रविष्टो दण्डकावनम्। लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा सीतया च परन्तपः।।5.58.24।।
explanation: 'Dasaratha's son, the illustrious Rama, a scorcher of enemies, accompanied by his brother Lakshmana and wife Sita entered Dandaka forest.

shloka_text: तस्य सीता हृता भार्या रावणेन दुरात्मना। तस्या स्सङ्काशं दूतोऽहं गमिष्ये रामशासनात्।।5.58.25।।
explanation: 'His wife was abducted by the evilminded Ravana. By Rama's command I am going to meet her as messenger from Rama.'

shloka_text: कर्तुमर्हसि रामस्य साहाय्यं विषये सती। अथवा मैथिलीं दृष्ट्वा रामं चाक्लिष्टकारिणम्।।5.58.26।। आगमिष्यामि ते वक्त्रं सत्यं प्रतिशृणोमि ते।
explanation: "I told her that it is proper for her (living in the domain of Rama) to help his queen and wife. Or else, I promised after I disclose to Rama, Sita's whereabouts, I will come and enter her mouth.

shloka_text: एवमुक्ता मया सा तु सुरसा कामरूपिणी।5.58.27।। अब्रवीन्नातिवर्तेत कश्चिदेष वरो मम।
explanation: Thus addressed by me, that Surasa, who could assume any form at will, said, "No one shall transgress this boon of mine."

shloka_text: एवमुक्तस्सुरसया दशयोजनमायतः।।5.58.28।। ततोर्थगुणविस्तारो बभूवाहं क्षणेन तु।
explanation: "When Surasa said this I who was ten yojanas in height increased  by fifteen yojanas.

shloka_text: मत्प्रमाणानुरूपं च व्यादितं च मुखं तया।।5.58.29।। तद्दृष्ट्वा व्यादितं चास्यं ह्रस्वं ह्यकरवं वपुः। तस्मिन्मुहूर्ते च पुनर्बभूवाङ्गुष्ठमात्रकः।।5.58.30।।
explanation: "She too opened her mouth wide enough for my size. Seeing her distending her mouth, in a moment I became small equal to the size of thumb and came out.

shloka_text: मत्प्रमाणानुरूपं च व्यादितं च मुखं तया।।5.58.29।। तद्दृष्ट्वा व्यादितं चास्यं ह्रस्वं ह्यकरवं वपुः। तस्मिन्मुहूर्ते च पुनर्बभूवाङ्गुष्ठमात्रकः।।5.58.30।।
explanation: "She too opened her mouth wide enough for my size. Seeing her distending her mouth, in a moment I became small equal to the size of thumb and came out.

shloka_text: अभिपत्याशु तद्वक्त्रं निर्गतोऽहं ततः क्षणात्। अब्रवीत्सुरसा देवी स्वेन रूपेण मां पुनः।।5.58.31।।
explanation: "Then Surasa assumed her natural form again in a moment and said this to me:

shloka_text: अर्थसिद्ध्यै हरिश्रेष्ठ गच्छ सौम्य यथासुखम्। समानय च वैदेहीं राघवेण महात्मना।।5.58.32।। सुखी भव महाबाहो प्रीताऽस्मि तव वानर।
explanation: 'O noble vanara O foremost of the vanaras go and accomplish the task.Unite the great Rama with Vaidehi.O strongarmed vanara, be happy. I am pleased with you'.

shloka_text: ततोऽहं साधु साध्विति सर्वभूतैः प्रशंसितः।।5.58.33।। ततोऽन्तरिक्षं विपुलं प्लुतोऽहं गरुडो यथा।
explanation: "Then all creatures praised me saying 'well done well done'. Then I leaped into the vast sky like Garuda.

shloka_text: छाया मे निगृहीता च न च पश्यामि किंचन।।5.58.34।। सोऽहं विहतवेगस्तु दिशो दश विलोकयन्। न किञ्चित्तत्र पश्यामि येन मेऽपहृता गतिः।।5.58.35।।
explanation: "Then I was captured by a shadow of some one. I could not see and I reduced my speed and looked around in all the ten directions. I could not see the one who seized me.

shloka_text: छाया मे निगृहीता च न च पश्यामि किंचन।।5.58.34।। सोऽहं विहतवेगस्तु दिशो दश विलोकयन्। न किञ्चित्तत्र पश्यामि येन मेऽपहृता गतिः।।5.58.35।।
explanation: "Then I was captured by a shadow of some one. I could not see and I reduced my speed and looked around in all the ten directions. I could not see the one who seized me.

shloka_text: ततो मे बुद्धिरुत्पन्ना किन्नाम गगने मम। ईदृशो विघ्न उत्पन्नो रूपं यत्र न दृश्यते।।5.58.36।।
explanation: Then a thought arose in my mind: 'What kind of obstacle has arisen for me in the sky, where no form is visible?'

shloka_text: अधोभागेन मे दृष्टि श्शोचता पातिता मया। ततोऽद्राक्षमहं भीमां राक्षसीं सलिलेशयाम्।।5.58.37।।
explanation: "Thinking so I looked down into the water and there I saw a terrific shedemon.

shloka_text: प्रहस्य च महानादमुक्तोऽहं भीमया तया। अवस्थितमसम्भ्रान्तमिदं वाक्यमशोभनम्।।5.58.38।।
explanation: "She was frightening and  laughed in loud voice without any hesitation. Steadfast she uttered these ominous words to me:

shloka_text: क्वासि गन्ता महाकाय क्षुधिताया ममेप्सितः। भक्षः प्रीणय मे देहं चिरमाहारवर्जितम्।।5.58.39।।
explanation: 'O huge monkey where are you going? I am hungry since long. I am going without food and must eat you. Make me satisfied'.

shloka_text: बाढमित्येव तां वाणीं प्रत्यगृह्णामहं ततः। अस्यप्रमाणादधिकं तस्याः कायमपूरयम्।।5.58.40।।
explanation: "I said 'well' and enlarged my body more than her mouth could hold.

shloka_text: तस्याश्चास्यं महद्भीमं वर्धते मम भक्षणे। न च मां साधु बुबुधे मम वा विकृतं कृतम्।।5.58.41।।
explanation: "She opened her huge mouth to eat me as she did not know that I had already assumed a huge ugly form on my own.

shloka_text: ततोऽहं विपुलं रूपं संक्षिप्य निमिषान्तरात्। तस्या हृदयमादाय प्रपतामि नभ:स्थलम्।।5.58.42।।
explanation: "In a moment I reduced from a huge form to a small one, entered her heart and sprang into the sky.

shloka_text: सा विसृष्टभुजा भीमा पपात लवणाम्भसि। मया पर्वतसङ्काशा निकृत्तहृदया सती।।5.58.43।।
explanation: "She who resembled a mountain fell into the ocean with her arms hanging down when I pulled out her heart.

shloka_text: शृणोमि खगतानां च सिद्धानां चारणैस्सह। राक्षसी सिंहिका भीमा क्षिप्रं हनुमता हता।।5.58.44।।
explanation: "I heard the charanas and siddhas residing in the sky talking to each other that the fierce ogres Simhika has been killed by Hanuman in a moment.

shloka_text: तां हत्वा पुनरेवाहं कृत्यमात्ययिकं स्मरन्। गत्वा चाह महध्वानं पश्यामि नगमण्डितम्।।5.58.45।। दक्षिणं तीरमुदधेर्लङ्का यत्र च सा पुरी।
explanation: "Having slained Simhika, I thought of the huge feat that I have done. I remembered the big mission before me and went to the southern shore of the ocean and saw Lanka full of trees.

shloka_text: अस्तं दिनकरे याते रक्षसां निलयं पुरम्।।5.58.46।। प्रविष्टोऽहमविज्ञातो रक्षोभिर्भीमविक्रमैः।
explanation: When the sun had set, I entered the city, the abode of the Rākṣasas, unnoticed by the Rākṣasas of terrible prowess.

shloka_text: तत्र प्रविशतश्चापि कल्पान्तघनसन्निभा।।5.58.47।। अट्टहासं विमुञ्चन्ती नारी काप्युत्थिता पुरः।
explanation: And as he entered there, a certain woman, resembling a cloud at the end of a cosmic cycle, arose before him, letting out a loud laugh.

shloka_text: जिघांसन्तीं ततस्तां तु ज्वलदग्निशिरोरुहाम्।।5.58.48।। सव्यमुष्टिप्रहारेण पराजित्य सुभैरवाम्। प्रदोषकाले प्रविशं भीतयाऽहं तयोदितः।।5.58.49।।
explanation: "Then the frightening form, with its hair burning like sacrificial fire, emerged to kill me. I defeated her hittting with my left fist and entered the city at sunset time.

shloka_text: जिघांसन्तीं ततस्तां तु ज्वलदग्निशिरोरुहाम्।।5.58.48।। सव्यमुष्टिप्रहारेण पराजित्य सुभैरवाम्। प्रदोषकाले प्रविशं भीतयाऽहं तयोदितः।।5.58.49।।
explanation: "Then the frightening form, with its hair burning like sacrificial fire, emerged to kill me. I defeated her hittting with my left fist and entered the city at sunset time.

shloka_text: अहं लङ्कापुरी वीर निर्जिता विक्रमेण ते। यस्मात्तस्माद्विजेतासि सर्वरक्षांस्यशेषतः।।5.58.50।।
explanation: 'O hero I am the presiding deity of Lanka whom you have won by your valour. Therefore you will win many demons she foretold.

shloka_text: तत्राहं सर्वरात्रं तु विचिन्वन् जनकात्मजाम्। रावणान्तःपुरगतो न चापश्यं सुमध्यमाम्।।5.58.51।।
explanation: "There when I went to the harem of Ravana and searched all night, I did not find the fairwaisted Janaka's daughter.

shloka_text: तत स्सीतामपश्यंस्तु रावणस्य निवेशने। शोकसागरमासाद्य न पारमुपलक्षये।।5.58.52।।
explanation: "Not able to find Sita at the residence of Ravana I was immersed in an ocean of endless sorrow and did not know what to do.

shloka_text: शोचता च मया दृष्टं प्राकारेण समावृतम्। काञ्चनेन विकृष्टेन गृहोपवनमुत्तमम्।।5.58.53।।
explanation: "While worrying like that I saw a long golden boundary wall surrounding a splendid home garden. (upabana)

shloka_text: स प्राकारमवप्लुत्य पश्यामि बहुपादपम्। अशोकवनिकामध्ये शिंशुपापादपो महान्।।5.58.54।। तमारुह्य च पश्यामि काञ्चनं कदलीवनम्।
explanation: "I crossed that boundary wall and saw many kinds of trees and in the midst of that Ashoka garden, a huge Simsupa tree. I ascended it and saw rows of banana plants.

shloka_text: अदूरे शिंशुपावृक्षात्पश्यामि वरवर्णिनीम्।।5.58.55।। श्यामां कमलपत्राक्षीमुपवासकृशाननाम्। तदेकवासस्संवीतां रजोध्वस्तशिरोरुहाम्।।5.58.56।। शोकसन्तापदीनाङ्गीं सीतां भर्तृहिते स्थिताम्। राक्षसीभिर्विरूपाभिः क्रूराभिरभिसंवृताम्।।5.58.57।। मांसशोणितभक्षाभिर्व्याघ्रीभिर्हरिणीमिव।
explanation: "Not far from the Simsupa tree I saw beautiful Sita, of dark complexion, with eyes like lotus petals, whose face was emaciated due to fasting, wearing only a single sari (the same one since her abduction) her locks filled with dust, pathetic looking,  immersed in sorrow, meditating on her husband seated like a doe encircled by tigresses, surrounded by ugly and cruel shedemons fed on flesh and blood.

shloka_text: अदूरे शिंशुपावृक्षात्पश्यामि वरवर्णिनीम्।।5.58.55।। श्यामां कमलपत्राक्षीमुपवासकृशाननाम्। तदेकवासस्संवीतां रजोध्वस्तशिरोरुहाम्।।5.58.56।। शोकसन्तापदीनाङ्गीं सीतां भर्तृहिते स्थिताम्। राक्षसीभिर्विरूपाभिः क्रूराभिरभिसंवृताम्।।5.58.57।। मांसशोणितभक्षाभिर्व्याघ्रीभिर्हरिणीमिव।
explanation: "Not far from the Simsupa tree I saw beautiful Sita, of dark complexion, with eyes like lotus petals, whose face was emaciated due to fasting, wearing only a single sari (the same one since her abduction) her locks filled with dust, pathetic looking,  immersed in sorrow, meditating on her husband seated like a doe encircled by tigresses, surrounded by ugly and cruel shedemons fed on flesh and blood.

shloka_text: अदूरे शिंशुपावृक्षात्पश्यामि वरवर्णिनीम्।।5.58.55।। श्यामां कमलपत्राक्षीमुपवासकृशाननाम्। तदेकवासस्संवीतां रजोध्वस्तशिरोरुहाम्।।5.58.56।। शोकसन्तापदीनाङ्गीं सीतां भर्तृहिते स्थिताम्। राक्षसीभिर्विरूपाभिः क्रूराभिरभिसंवृताम्।।5.58.57।। मांसशोणितभक्षाभिर्व्याघ्रीभिर्हरिणीमिव।
explanation: "Not far from the Simsupa tree I saw beautiful Sita, of dark complexion, with eyes like lotus petals, whose face was emaciated due to fasting, wearing only a single sari (the same one since her abduction) her locks filled with dust, pathetic looking,  immersed in sorrow, meditating on her husband seated like a doe encircled by tigresses, surrounded by ugly and cruel shedemons fed on flesh and blood.

shloka_text: सा मया राक्षसीमध्ये तर्ज्यमाना मुहुर्मुहुः।।5.58.58।। एकवेणीधरा दीना भर्तृचिन्तापरायणा। भूमिशय्या विवर्णाङ्गी पद्मिनीव हिमागमे।।5.58.59।। रावणाद्विनिवृत्तार्था मर्तव्यकृतनिश्चया। कथञ्चिन्मृगशाबाक्षी तूर्णमासादिता मया।।5.58.60।।
explanation: She, being repeatedly threatened amidst the demonesses, wearing a single braid, distressed, absorbed in thoughts of her husband, sleeping on the ground, with a pale body like a lotus plant in winter, having rejected Ravana's advances, and determined

shloka_text: सा मया राक्षसीमध्ये तर्ज्यमाना मुहुर्मुहुः।।5.58.58।। एकवेणीधरा दीना भर्तृचिन्तापरायणा। भूमिशय्या विवर्णाङ्गी पद्मिनीव हिमागमे।।5.58.59।। रावणाद्विनिवृत्तार्था मर्तव्यकृतनिश्चया। कथञ्चिन्मृगशाबाक्षी तूर्णमासादिता मया।।5.58.60।।
explanation: She, repeatedly threatened amidst the demonesses, wearing a single braid, miserable, absorbed in thoughts of her husband, sleeping on the ground, with a pale body, like a lotus plant at the arrival of winter, having rejected Ravana's intentions, and determined to die—that fawn-eyed one was somehow quickly found by me.

shloka_text: सा मया राक्षसीमध्ये तर्ज्यमाना मुहुर्मुहुः।।5.58.58।। एकवेणीधरा दीना भर्तृचिन्तापरायणा। भूमिशय्या विवर्णाङ्गी पद्मिनीव हिमागमे।।5.58.59।। रावणाद्विनिवृत्तार्था मर्तव्यकृतनिश्चया। कथञ्चिन्मृगशाबाक्षी तूर्णमासादिता मया।।5.58.60।।
explanation: She, amidst the demonesses, being repeatedly threatened, wearing a single braid, miserable, solely devoted to thoughts of her husband, sleeping on the ground, with a pale body, like a lotus plant at the arrival of winter, having rejected Ravana

shloka_text: तां दृष्ट्वा तादृशीं नारीं रामपत्नीं यशस्विनीम्। तत्रैव शिंशुपावृक्षे पश्यन्नहमवस्थितः।।5.58.61।।
explanation: "I remained there looking on that renowned wife of Rama from the Simsupa tree.

shloka_text: ततो हलहलाशब्दं काञ्चीनूपुरमिश्रितम्। शृणोम्यधिकगम्भीरं रावणस्य निवेशने।।5.58.62।।
explanation: "Then I heard a deep sound mixed with jingling golden girdles and anklets coming from Ravana's residence.

shloka_text: ततोऽहं परमोद्विग्नः स्वं रूपं प्रत्यसंहरम्। अहं तु शिंशुपावृक्षे पक्षीव गहने स्थितः।।5.58.63।।
explanation: "I was scared and contracted my body size and stood on the Simsupa tree like a bird in the sky.

shloka_text: ततो रावणदाराश्च रावणश्च महाबलः। तं देशं समनुप्राप्ता यत्र सीताऽभवत् स्थिता।।5.58.64।।
explanation: "Then arrived the powerful Ravana with his consorts to that place where Sita was and stood there.

shloka_text: तं दृष्ट्वाथ वरारोहा सीता रक्षोगणेश्वरम्। सङ्कुच्योरूस्तनौ पीनौ बाहुभ्यां परिरभ्य च।।5.58.65।।
explanation: "On seeing Ravana, the king of demons, beautiful Sita, full of fear hid her face and plump breasts between her thighs.

shloka_text: वित्रस्तां परमोद्विग्नां वीक्षमाणां ततस्ततः। त्राणं किञ्चिदपश्यन्तीं वेपमानां तपस्विनीम्।।5.58.66।। तामुवाच दशग्रीवस्सीतां परमदुःखिताम्। अवाक्चिराः प्रपतितो बहुमन्यस्व मामिति।।5.58.67।।
explanation: "Sita was full of fear and worry, looked here and there without any protector to pacify. She was trembling in fear. To that Sita, the tenheaded Ravana bent his head down and said, 'trust me and respect me'.

shloka_text: वित्रस्तां परमोद्विग्नां वीक्षमाणां ततस्ततः। त्राणं किञ्चिदपश्यन्तीं वेपमानां तपस्विनीम्।।5.58.66।। तामुवाच दशग्रीवस्सीतां परमदुःखिताम्। अवाक्चिराः प्रपतितो बहुमन्यस्व मामिति।।5.58.67।।
explanation: "Sita was full of fear and worry, looked here and there without any protector to pacify. She was trembling in fear. To that Sita, the tenheaded Ravana bent his head down and said, 'trust me and respect me'.

shloka_text: यदि चेत्त्वं तु दर्पान्मां नाभिनन्दसि गर्विते। द्वौ मासावन्तरं सीते पास्यामि रुधिरं तव।।5.58.68।।
explanation: 'O Sita if in your pride, you do not respect me, I will see (drink) your blood in two months.

shloka_text: एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य रावणस्य दुरात्मनः। उवाच परमक्रुद्धा सीता वचनमुत्तमम्।।5.58.69।।
explanation: "Hearing the words of evilminded Ravana, Sita became very angry and spoke these approprate words:

shloka_text: राक्षसाधम रामस्य भार्याममिततेजसः। इक्ष्वाकुकुलनाथस्य स्नुषां दशरथस्य च।।5.58.70।। अवाच्यं वदतो जिह्वा कथं न पतिता तव।
explanation: 'O lowly demon I am the wife of valiant Rama and daughterinlaw of Dasaratha, the king of Ikshvaku race. How is it your tongue that spoke unspeakable words has not fallen down?

shloka_text: किञ्चिद्वीर्यं तवानार्य यो मां भर्तुरसन्निधौ।।5.58.71।। अपहृत्याऽऽगतः पाप ते नादृष्टो महात्मना।
explanation: 'O ignoble one when my husband was away, you came and abducted me unseen by the great Rama. You do not have even a little courage (to win me through a straight fight).

shloka_text: न त्वं रामस्य सदृशो दास्येऽप्यस्य न युज्यसे।।5.58.72।। यज्ञीय स्सत्यवादी च रणश्लाघी च राघवः।
explanation: 'You are not equal to Rama and not even fit to be his servant. He does yagnas and always abides in truth. He is valiant in war.

shloka_text: जानक्या परुषं वाक्यमेवमुक्तो दशाननः।।5.58.73।। जज्वाल सहसा कोपाच्चितास्थ इव पावकः।
explanation: "Thus addressed harshly by Janaki, the tenheaded Ravana blazed up in anger suddenly like the flame of the funeral pyre.

shloka_text: विवृत्य नयने क्रूरे मुष्टिमुद्यम्य दक्षिणम्।।5.58.74।। मैथिलीं हन्तुमारब्ध: स्त्रीभिर्हाहाकृतं तदा।
explanation: "Then the wicked Ravana raised his eyebrows and his right fist to strike at Sita and even the shedemon there raised their voice saying, ' alas, alas '

shloka_text: स्त्रीणां मध्यात्समुत्पत्य तस्य भार्या दुरात्मनः।।5.58.75।। वरा मन्दोदरी नाम तया स प्रतिषेधितः।
explanation: "Evilminded Ravana's wife Mandodari, a noble one among women came forward from the midst and prevented him.

shloka_text: उक्तश्च मधुरां वाणीं तया स मदनार्दितः।।5.58.76।। सीतया तव किं कार्यं महेन्द्रसमविक्रमः।
explanation: "She spoke sweetly to Ravana, who was tormented by the god of love saying, 'For what purpose do you desire Sita? You are equal to Mahendra in might'.

shloka_text: देवगन्धर्वकन्याभिर्यक्षकन्याभिरेव च।।5.58.77।। सार्धं प्रभो रमस्वेह सीतया किं करिष्यसि।
explanation: 'O lord you enjoy with the daughters of gods, gandharvas and even the young ladies of yakshas. Why do you need Sita?'

shloka_text: ततस्ताभिस्समेताभिर्नारीभिस्स महाबलः।।5.58.78।। प्रसाद्य सहसा नीतो भवनं स्वं निशाचरः।
explanation: "Then all the women got together and stopped the mighty nightranger, Ravana and quickly took him back to his mansion.

shloka_text: याते तस्मिन् दशग्रीवे राक्षस्यो विकृताननाः।।5.58.79।। सीतां निर्भर्त्सयामासुर्वाक्यैः क्रूरैस्सुदारुणैः।
explanation: When that Dashagriva had gone, the ugly-faced ogresses threatened Sita with cruel and very terrible words.

shloka_text: तृणवद्भाषितं तासां गणयामास जानकी।।5.58.80।। गर्जितं च तदा तासां सीतां प्राप्य निरर्थकम्।
explanation: "Janaki did not care for their words of threat, as though they were a blade of grass and of no use to her.

shloka_text: वृथागर्जितनिश्चेष्टा राक्षस्यः पिशिताशनाः।।5.58.81।। रावणाय शशंसुस्ताः सीताध्यवसितं महत्।
explanation: "Since the threatenings of the shedemons were of no use the ogresses who live on flesh and blood reported to Ravana about great Sita's formidable determination.

shloka_text: ततस्तास्सहितास्सर्वा निहताशा निरुद्यमाः।।5.58.82।। परिक्षिप्य समन्तात्तां निद्रावशमुपागताः।
explanation: "Then all of them gave up hope of their efforts and scattered around her, succumbed to sleep.

shloka_text: तासु चैव प्रसुप्तासु सीता भर्तृहिते रता।।5.58.83।। विलप्य करुणं दीना प्रशुशोच सुदुःखिता।
explanation: While they were asleep, Sita, devoted to her husband's welfare, distressed and extremely sorrowful, lamented piteously and grieved.

shloka_text: तासां मध्यात्समुत्थाय त्रिजटा वाक्यमब्रवीत्।।5.58.84।। आत्मानं खादत क्षिप्रं न सीता विनशिष्यति। जनकस्यात्मजा साध्वी स्नुषा दशरथस्य च।।5.58.85।।
explanation: "From the midst of all of them got up Trijata, saying, 'You eat me if you like. Know that Janaka's daughter is a chaste woman and is the daughterinlaw of Dasaratha. She cannot be destroyed'.

shloka_text: तासां मध्यात्समुत्थाय त्रिजटा वाक्यमब्रवीत्।।5.58.84।। आत्मानं खादत क्षिप्रं न सीता विनशिष्यति। जनकस्यात्मजा साध्वी स्नुषा दशरथस्य च।।5.58.85।।
explanation: "From the midst of all of them got up Trijata, saying, 'You eat me if you like. Know that Janaka's daughter is a chaste woman and is the daughterinlaw of Dasaratha. She cannot be destroyed'.

shloka_text: स्वप्नो ह्यद्य मया दृष्टो दारुणो रोमहर्षणः। रक्षसां च विनाशाय भर्तुरस्या जयाय च।।5.58.86।।
explanation: 'Today I saw in my dream, a dreadful and horripilating scene of destruction of demons and even victory of Sita's husband.

shloka_text: अलमस्मात्परित्रातुं राघवाद्राक्षसीगणम्। अभियाचाम वैदेहीमेतद्धि मम रोचते।।5.58.87।।
explanation: 'To protect the demon clan from destruction by Rama, it is enough if we beg her (pardon). Indeed, I think that way.

shloka_text: यस्या ह्येवंविधस्स्वप्नो दुःखितायाः प्रदृश्यते। सा दुःखैर्विविधैर्मुक्ता सुखमाप्नोत्यनुत्तमम्।।5.58.88।। प्रणिपातप्रसन्ना हि मैथिली जनकात्मजा।
explanation: 'Whoever in a sorrowful state sees such kind of dream, would be not only relieved of all sorrows but will experience immense happiness. Janaka's daughter Sita will bless us with protection if we pray her.

shloka_text: ततस्सा ह्रीमती बाला भर्तुर्विजयहर्षिता।।5.58.89।। अवोचद्यदि तत्तथ्यं भवेयं शरणं हि वः।
explanation: 'On hearing the words (of Trijata) that 'Rama will succeed', young and bashful Sita felt happy and said that 'If it comes true I will protect thee'.

shloka_text: तां चाहं तादृशीं दृष्ट्वा सीताया दारुणां दशाम्। चिन्तयामास विक्रान्तो न च मे निर्वृतं मनः।।5.58.90।।
explanation: "Seeing Sita's deplorable state, her illluck and her dread, I began  to worry and had no peace of mind.

shloka_text: सम्भाषणार्थं च मया जानक्याश्चिन्तितो विधिः।।5.58.91।। इक्ष्वाकूणां हि वंशस्तु ततो मम पुरस्कृतः।
explanation: "I thought of a strategy to enter into conversation with Janaki that is to praise the Ikshvaku race.

shloka_text: श्रुत्वा तु गदितां वाचं राजर्षिगणपूजिताम्।।5.58.92।। प्रत्यभाषत मां देवी बाष्पैः पिहितलोचना।
explanation: "The divine lady heard my enumeration, sanctifying the royal seers. She replied me, with  her eyes blinded by tears:

shloka_text: कस्त्वं केन कथं चेह प्राप्तो वानरपुङ्गवः।।5.58.93।। का च रामेण ते प्रीतिस्तन्मे शंसितुमर्हसि।
explanation: "O foremost of vanaras who are you? Why and how have you come here? How did you make friendship with Rama? Tell me all that in detail.

shloka_text: तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा ह्यहमप्यब्रुवं वचः।।5.58.94।। देवि रामस्य भर्तुस्ते सहायो भीमविक्रमः। सुग्रीवो नाम विक्रान्तो वानरेन्द्रो महाबलः।।5.58.95।।
explanation: "Hearing her I also said, 'O queen Sugriva, the warrior of fierce valour and king of monkeys developed friendship with your husband'.

shloka_text: तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा ह्यहमप्यब्रुवं वचः।।5.58.94।। देवि रामस्य भर्तुस्ते सहायो भीमविक्रमः। सुग्रीवो नाम विक्रान्तो वानरेन्द्रो महाबलः।।5.58.95।।
explanation: "Hearing her I also said, 'O queen Sugriva, the warrior of fierce valour and king of monkeys developed friendship with your husband'.

shloka_text: तस्य मां विद्धि भृत्यं त्वं हनुमन्तमिहागतम्। भर्त्राहं प्रेषितस्तुभ्यं रामेणाक्लिष्टकर्मणा।।5.58.96।।
explanation: 'I came here as a servant sent by your tireless husband to find you.

shloka_text: इदं च पुरुषव्याघ्रः श्रीमान् दाशरथिः स्वयम्। अङ्गुलीयमभिज्ञानमदात्तुभ्यं यशस्विनि।।5.58.97।।
explanation: 'O glorious lady the tiger among men, the illustrious son of Dasaratha himself sent this ring to you as a taken of identity.

shloka_text: तदिच्छामि त्वयाऽऽज्ञप्तं देवि किं करवाण्यहम्। रामलक्ष्मणयोः पार्श्वं नयामि त्वां किमुत्तरम्।।5.58.98।।
explanation: 'O venerable lady I seek your order. What should I do? Should I take you to  Rama and Lakshmana? What do you say?

shloka_text: एतच्छ्रुत्वा विदित्वा च सीता जनकनन्दिनी। आहरावणमुत्साद्य राघवो मां नयत्विति।।5.58.99।।
explanation: "Having heard all that (Hanuman said) Sita, the delight of Janaka thought over and said, 'Rama should kill Ravana and take me'.

shloka_text: प्रणम्य शिरसा देवीं महमार्यामनिन्दिताम्। राघवस्य मनोह्लादमभिज्ञानमयाचिषम्।।5.58.100।।
explanation: "Then bowing down I saluted the noble and blameless queen Sita to give a signet, which would be very pleasing to Rama.

shloka_text: अथ मामब्रवीत्सीता गृह्यतामयमुत्तमः। मणिर्येन महाबाहू रामस्त्वां बहुमन्यते।।5.58.101।।
explanation: "Sita then said to me, 'Take this best of gems and present it to the longarmed Rama as a token'.

shloka_text: इत्युक्त्वा तु वरारोहा मणिप्रवरमद्भुतम्। प्रायच्छत्परमोद्विग्ना वाचा मां सन्दिदेशह।।5.58.102।।
explanation: "Having said so, the noble lady delivered a wonderful jewel with supreme message to me in a sorrowful mood.

shloka_text: ततस्तस्यै प्रणम्याहं राजपुत्र्यै समाहितः। प्रदक्षिणं परिक्राममिहाभ्युद्गतमानसः।।5.58.103।।
explanation: "Reminded by her again (that Rama should turn up soon to take her), I offered reverential salutations by circumambulating her.

shloka_text: उक्तोऽहं पुनरेवेदं निश्चित्य मनसा तया। हनुमन्मम वृत्तान्तं वक्तुमर्हसि राघवे।।5.58.104।।
explanation: I was told by her, who had firmly decided this in her mind, 'O Hanuman, you must relate my story to Rama.'

shloka_text: यथा श्रुत्वैव न चिरात्तावुभौ रामलक्ष्मणौ। सुग्रीवसहितौ वीरावुपेयातां तथा कुरु।।5.58.105।।
explanation: 'O heroic Hanuman narrate in such a way that by hearing you both Rama and Lakshmana will come here soon, accompanied by Sugriva.

shloka_text: यद्यन्यथा भवेदेतद्द्वौ मासौ जीवितं मम। न मां द्रक्ष्यति काकुत्स्थो म्रिये साहमनाथवत्।।5.58.106।।
explanation: 'Otherwise with none to protect me, I will live only  for two months.I will die like an orphan and he will not see me'.

shloka_text: तच्छ्रुत्वा करुणं वाक्यं क्रोधो मामभ्यवर्तत। उत्तरं च मया दृष्टं कार्यशेषमनन्तरम्।।5.58.107।।
explanation: "When I heard her pathetic appeal, I was overtaken by anger. I perceived the task left over for me to do.

shloka_text: ततोऽवर्धत मे कायस्तदा पर्वतसन्निभः। युद्धकाङ्क्षी वनं तच्च विनाशयितुमारभे।।5.58.108।।
explanation: "Thereafter, I increased my body to the size of a mountain, intent on fighting and started destroying the pleasure garden.

shloka_text: तद्भग्नं वनषण्डं तु भ्रान्तत्रस्तमृगद्विजम्। प्रतिबुद्धा निरीक्षन्ते राक्षस्यो विकृताननाः।।5.58.109।।
explanation: "Those uglyfaced ogresses woke up and saw the devastated garden and terrified beasts and birds.

shloka_text: मां च दृष्ट्वा वने तस्मिन् समागम्य ततस्ततः। ता स्समभ्यागताः क्षिप्रं रावणायाचचक्षिरे।।5.58.110।।
explanation: And having seen me in that forest, those who had arrived, gathering from here and there, quickly reported to Ravana.

shloka_text: राजस्वनमिदं दुर्गं तव भग्नं दुरात्मना। वानरेण ह्यविज्ञाय तव वीर्यं महाबल।।5.58.111।।
explanation: 'O powerful king an evilminded vanara has destroyed the inaccessible pleasure garden not knowing your valour.

shloka_text: दुर्बुद्धेस्तस्य राजेन्द्र तव विप्रियकारिणः। वधमाज्ञापय क्षिप्रं यथासौ विलयं व्रजेत्।।5.58.112।।
explanation: 'O king may orders be issued to kill this wickedminded vanara wandering aimlessly. He has done contrary to your interest.

shloka_text: तच्छ्रुत्वा राक्षसेन्द्रेण विसृष्टा भृशदुर्जयाः। राक्षसाः किङ्करा नाम रावणस्य मनोनुगाः।।5.58.113।।
explanation: "Ravana, lord of the demons having heard (the ogresses) sent invincible ogres called kinkaras who know his mind.

shloka_text: तेषामशीतिसाहस्रं शूलमुद्गरपाणिनाम्। मया तस्मिन्वनोद्देशे परिघेण निषूदितम्।।5.58.114।।
explanation: "I killed with an iron bar a battalion of eighty thousand demons who were guarding the garden with tridents and maces.

shloka_text: तेषां तु हतशेषा ये ते गत्वा लघुविक्रमाः। निहतं च महत्सैन्यं रावणायाचचक्षिरे।।5.58.115।।
explanation: "Those who were left behind, the less powerful ones went and reported to Ravana that the great army has been killed.

shloka_text: ततो मे बुद्धिरुत्पन्ना चैत्यप्रासादमाक्रमम्। तत्रस्थान्राक्षसान् हत्वा शतं स्तम्भेन वै पुनः।।5.58.116।। ललामभूतो लङ्कायास्स वै विध्वंसितो मया।
explanation: "Then a thought struck my mind. I took hold of a pillar of the tall, decorated mansion of Lanka and killed with it all the hundred demons stationed there.

shloka_text: ततः प्रहस्तस्य सुतं जम्बुमालिनमादिशत्।।5.58.117।। राक्षसैर्बहुभिस्सार्धं घोररूपैर्भयानकैः।
explanation: Then he ordered Jambumalin, the son of Prahasta, along with many Rakshasas of terrible forms and frightening.

shloka_text: तं महाबलसम्पन्नं राक्षसं रणकोविदम्।।5.58.118।। परिघेणातिघोरेण सूदयामि सहानुगम्।
explanation: "With a dreadful iron bar I slayed Jambumali, who was endowed with mighty strength, and was an expert in war and other terrific ogres who accompanied him.

shloka_text: तच्छ्रुत्वा राक्षसेन्द्रस्तु मन्त्रिपुत्त्रान्महाबलान्।।5.58.119।। पदातिबलसम्पन्नान् प्रेषयामास रावणः।
explanation: "Ravana, the demon king sent his mighty army of strong footsoldiers, the sons of ministers.

shloka_text: परिघेणैव तान् सर्वान्नयामि यमसादनम्।।5.58.120।। मन्त्रिपुत्त्रान्हतान्च्छृत्वा समरेऽलघुविक्रमान्। पञ्च सेनाग्रगाच्छ्रूरान्प्रेषयामास रावणः।।5.58.121।।
explanation: "I sent all of them to the abode of Yama with just an iron bar. Having heard about the death of the less powerful ones, Ravana  sent five heroic army generals.

shloka_text: परिघेणैव तान् सर्वान्नयामि यमसादनम्।।5.58.120।। मन्त्रिपुत्त्रान्हतान्च्छृत्वा समरेऽलघुविक्रमान्। पञ्च सेनाग्रगाच्छ्रूरान्प्रेषयामास रावणः।।5.58.121।।
explanation: "I sent all of them to the abode of Yama with just an iron bar. Having heard about the death of the less powerful ones, Ravana  sent five heroic army generals.

shloka_text: तानहं सहसैन्यान्वै सर्वानेवाभ्यसूदयम्। ततः पुनर्दशग्रीवः पुत्रमक्षं महाबलम्।।5.58.122।। बहुभी राक्षसैस्सार्धं प्रेषयामास रावणः।
explanation: "Since I killed all of them along with the army, the tenheaded Ravana sent out his mighty son Aksha together with many demons.

shloka_text: तं तु मन्दोदरीपुत्त्रं कुमारं रणपण्डितम्।।5.58.123।। सहसा खं समुत्क्रान्तं पादयोश्च गृहीतवान्। चर्मासिनं शतगुणं भ्रामयित्वा व्यपेषयम्।।5.58.124।।
explanation: "When Mandodari's son, an expert in war had risen up to the sky I caught his feet and whirled him round a hundred times and smashed him.

shloka_text: तं तु मन्दोदरीपुत्त्रं कुमारं रणपण्डितम्।।5.58.123।। सहसा खं समुत्क्रान्तं पादयोश्च गृहीतवान्। चर्मासिनं शतगुणं भ्रामयित्वा व्यपेषयम्।।5.58.124।।
explanation: "When Mandodari's son, an expert in war had risen up to the sky I caught his feet and whirled him round a hundred times and smashed him.

shloka_text: तमक्षमागतं भग्नं निशम्य स दशाननः। तत इन्द्रजितं नाम द्वितीयं रावणस्सुतम्।।5.58.125।। व्यादिदेश सुसंकृद्धो बलिनम् युद्धदुर्मदम्।
explanation: "When Aksha was done to death, the tenfaced Ravana was enraged and gave instruction to the second son, called Indrajit who was thirsting for war.

shloka_text: तच्चाप्यहं बलं सर्वं तं च राक्षसपुङ्गवम्।।5.58.126।। नष्टौजसं रणे कृत्वा परं हर्षमुपागमम्।
explanation: "When the army and even the Generals were done to death in combat I was very happy.

shloka_text: महतापि महाबाहुः प्रत्ययेन महाबलः।।5.58.127।। प्रेषितो रावणेनैव सह वीरैर्मदोत्कटैः।
explanation: "Thinking that Indrajit will surely kill me, the strongarmed mighty Ravana again sent intoxicated demon warriors.

shloka_text: सोऽविषह्यं हि मां बुद्ध्वा स्वं बलं चावमर्दितम्।।5.58.128।। ब्राह्मणास्त्रेण स तु मां प्राबध्नाच्छातिवेगितः।
explanation: "Realising that I cannot be slain and that his (Indrajit's) power is reduced, he released Brahma's weapon on me with high speed and captured me.

shloka_text: रज्जुभिश्चाभिबध्नन्ति ततो मां तत्र राक्षसाः।।5.58.129।। रावणस्य समीपं च गृहीत्वा मामुपानयन्।
explanation: "Then the demons bound me with ropes and brought me to Ravana.

shloka_text: दृष्ट्वा सम्भाषितश्चाहं रावणेन दुरात्मना।।5.58.130।। पृष्टश्च लङ्कागमनं राक्षसानां च तं वधम्।
explanation: "The wickedminded Ravana, then enquired me why I came to Lanka and why I killed the demons.

shloka_text: तत्सर्वं च मया तत्र सीतार्थमिति जल्पितम्।।5.58.131।। अस्याहं दर्शनाकाङ्क्षी प्राप्तस्त्वद्भवनं विभो। मारुतस्यौरसः पुत्रो वानरो हनुमानहम्।।5.58.132।।
explanation: 'I have done all this for the sake of Sita, O demon king I came to your mansion desiring to see Sita. I am the legitimate son of Windgod. My name is Hanuman.

shloka_text: तत्सर्वं च मया तत्र सीतार्थमिति जल्पितम्।।5.58.131।। अस्याहं दर्शनाकाङ्क्षी प्राप्तस्त्वद्भवनं विभो। मारुतस्यौरसः पुत्रो वानरो हनुमानहम्।।5.58.132।।
explanation: 'I have done all this for the sake of Sita, O demon king I came to your mansion desiring to see Sita. I am the legitimate son of Windgod. My name is Hanuman.

shloka_text: रामदूतं च मां विद्धि सुग्रीवसचिवं कपिम्। सोऽहं दूत्येन रामस्य त्वत्सकाशमिहागतः।।5.58.133।।
explanation: 'I am a vanara, a messenger of Rama and minister of Sugriva.You may know that I have come here to convey the message of Rama to you.

shloka_text: सुग्रीवश्च महातेजास्सत्वां कुशलमब्रवीत्। धर्मार्थकामसहितं हितं पथ्यमुवाच च।।5.58.134।।
explanation: 'Highly powerful Sugriva enquires your welfare. He sends beneficial advice to you for your righteousness, pleasures and wellbeing.

shloka_text: वसतो ऋश्यमूके मे पर्वते विपुलद्रुमे। राघवो रणविक्रान्तो मित्त्रत्वं समुपागतः।।5.58.135।।
explanation: 'While I was dwelling at the woodedmountain in Rshyamuka, a treaty of friendship was made with Rama, who is skilled in war.

shloka_text: तेन मे कथितं राज्ञा भार्या मे रक्षसा हृता। तत्र साहाय्यमस्माकं कार्यं सर्वात्मना त्वया।।5.58.136।।
explanation: 'The king said, ' My wife was abducted by a demon. I request your help by all means to get her'.

shloka_text: मया च कथितं तस्मै वालिनश्च वधं प्रति। तत्र साहाय्यहेतोर्मे समयं कर्तुमर्हसि।।5.58.137।।
explanation: 'Sugriva told the story of Vali in turn and asked for his help and to make agreement to kill Vali.

shloka_text: वालिना हृतराज्येन सुग्रीवेण महाप्रभुः। चक्रेऽग्निसाक्षिकं सख्यं राघवस्सह लक्ष्मणः।।5.58.138।।
explanation: With fire as witness the great lord, Rama along with Lakshmana made friendship with Sugriva whose kingdom had been usurped.

shloka_text: तेन वालिनमुत्पाट्य शरेणैकेन संयुगे। वानराणां महाराजः कृतस्स प्लवतां प्रभुः।।5.58.139।।
explanation: 'In the combat Rama killed Vali with a single arrow and made Sugriva the king of vanaras.

shloka_text: तस्य साहाय्यमस्माभिः कार्यं सर्वात्मना त्विह। तेन प्रस्थापितस्तुभ्यं समीपमिह धर्मतः।।5.58.140।।
explanation: 'We too have to help him in this task. So a message is sent to you on righteous grounds.

shloka_text: क्षिप्रमानीयतां सीता दीयतां राघवाय च। यावन्न हरयो वीरा विधमन्ति बलं तव।।5.58.141।।
explanation: 'Before the heroic vanaras exterminate your entire army, return Sita at once to Rama.

shloka_text: वानराणां प्रभावो हि न केन विदितः पुरा। देवतानां सङ्काशं च ये गच्छन्ति निमन्त्रिताः।।5.58.142।।
explanation: 'Who knows not the power of Vanaras in the past? Even gods had sought their help.

shloka_text: इति वानरराजस्त्वामाहेत्यभिहितो मया। मामैक्षत ततः क्रुद्धश्चक्षुषा प्रदहन्निव।।5.58.143।।
explanation: 'This I was asked to tell you by the king of vanaras wishing your welfare'. 'Ravana then angrily looked at me as if to burn me.

shloka_text: तेन वध्योऽहमाज्ञप्तो रक्षसा रौद्रकर्मणा। मत्प्रभावमविज्ञाय रावणेन दुरात्मना।।5.58.144।।
explanation: "The evilminded demon, Ravana, who perpetrates dreadful acts ordered my slaughter, not knowing my power.

shloka_text: ततो विभीषणो नाम तस्य भ्राता महामतिः। तेन राक्षसराजोऽसौ याचितो मम कारणात्।।5.58.145।।
explanation: "Vibhisana, a very pious brother of the demon king, interceded on my behalf.

shloka_text: नैवं राक्षसशार्दूल त्यज्यतामेष निश्चयः। राजशास्त्रव्यपेतो हि मार्गः संसेव्यते त्वया।।5.58.146।।
explanation: "Vibhishana, a tiger among demons, asked Ravana to give up his decision as it was a forbidden course according to the science of royal polity.

shloka_text: दूतवध्या न दृष्टा हि राजशास्त्रेषु राक्षस। दूतेन वेदितव्यं च यथार्थं हितवादिना।।5.58.147।।
explanation: 'The royal code prohibits the murder of an emissary. A wellwishing emissary should convey the truth.

shloka_text: सुमहत्यपराधेऽपि दूतस्यातुलविक्रमः। विरूपकरणं दृष्टं न वधोऽस्तीति शास्त्रतः।।5.58.148।।
explanation: 'O Ravana of immeasurable courage even if the emissary has done any kind of harm he may be mutilated but not murdered. Nowhere do the sastras allow killing (of an ambassador).

shloka_text: विभीषणेनैवमुक्तो रावणस्सन्दिदेश तान्। राक्षसानेतदेवास्य लाङ्गूलं दह्यतामिति।।5.58.149।।
explanation: 'On hearing Vibhishana, Ravana instructed the demons to burn my tail.

shloka_text: ततस्तस्य वचः श्रुत्वा मम पुच्छं समन्ततः। वेष्टितं शणवल्कैश्च जीर्णैः कार्पासजैः पटैः।।5.58.150।।
explanation: "Having heard the king's words, all the demons collected and held my tail, wrapped it with saris of fibres and tattered rags of cotton.

shloka_text: राक्षसाः सिद्धसन्नाहास्ततस्ते चण्डविक्रमाः। तदाऽदह्यन्त मे पुच्छं निघ्नन्त: काष्ठमुष्टिभिः।।5.58.151।। बद्धस्य बहुभिः पाशैर्यन्त्रितस्य च राक्षसैः।
explanation: "Many ferociously courageous demons got ready. They bound me and hit me with firesticks and fists. They fastened my tail with ropes and set in on fire.

shloka_text: ततस्ते राक्षसाश्शूरा बद्धं मामग्निसंवृतम्।।5.58.152।। अघोषयन्राजमार्गे नगरद्वारमागताः।
explanation: "The brave demons took me round the city through the royal streets and announced loudly to let every one know that I am bound and that my tail has been set on fire.

shloka_text: ततोऽहं सुमहद्रूपं संक्षिप्य पुनरात्मनः।।5.58.153।। विमोचयित्वा तं बन्धं प्रकृतिस्थः स्थितः पुनः। आयसं परिघं गृह्य तानि रक्षांस्यसूदयम्।।5.58.154।।
explanation: "I reduced my form and rid of the bondage. Then again I assumed my original huge form and took up an iron bar lying near and killed all the demons (present).

shloka_text: ततोऽहं सुमहद्रूपं संक्षिप्य पुनरात्मनः।।5.58.153।। विमोचयित्वा तं बन्धं प्रकृतिस्थः स्थितः पुनः। आयसं परिघं गृह्य तानि रक्षांस्यसूदयम्।।5.58.154।।
explanation: "I reduced my form and rid of the bondage. Then again I assumed my original huge form and took up an iron bar lying near and killed all the demons (present).

shloka_text: ततस्तन्नगरद्वारं वेगेनाप्लुतवानहम्। पुच्छेन च प्रदीप्तेन तां पुरीं साट्टगोपुराम्।।5.58.155।। दहाम्यहमसंभ्रान्तो युगान्ताग्निरिव प्रजाः।
explanation: "Then I leaped to the entrance gate of the city without being perplexed. With my burning tail I set fire to the boundaries and towering mansions which looked like the world at the end of dissolution.

shloka_text: विनष्टा जानकी व्यक्तं न ह्यदग्धः प्रदृश्यते।।5.58.156।। लङ्कायां कश्चिदुद्धेशः सर्वा भस्मीकृता पुरी।
explanation: Janaki is clearly lost, for no unburnt spot is seen in Lanka; the entire city has been reduced to ashes.

shloka_text: दहता च मया लङ्कां दग्धा सीता न संशयः।।5.58.157।। रामस्य हि महत्कार्यं मयेदं वितथीकृतम्।
explanation: "Lanka has been burnt by me and Sita might have also been burnt. There is no doubt. The great purpose of Rama has been spoilt by me'.

shloka_text: इति शोकसमाविष्टश्चिन्तामहमुपागतः।।5.58.158।। अथाहं वाचमश्रौषं चारणानां शुभाक्षराम्। जानकी न च दग्धेति विस्मयोदन्तभाषिणाम्।।5.58.159।।
explanation: "Thus I was overtaken by sorrow and worry. Just then I heard the wonderful propitious utterances of charanas announcing that Sita was not burnt.

shloka_text: इति शोकसमाविष्टश्चिन्तामहमुपागतः।।5.58.158।। अथाहं वाचमश्रौषं चारणानां शुभाक्षराम्। जानकी न च दग्धेति विस्मयोदन्तभाषिणाम्।।5.58.159।।
explanation: "Thus I was overtaken by sorrow and worry. Just then I heard the wonderful propitious utterances of charanas announcing that Sita was not burnt.

shloka_text: ततो मे बुद्धिरुत्पन्ना श्रुत्वा तामद्भुतां गिरम्। अदग्धा जानकीत्येवं निमित्तैश्चोपलक्षिता।।5.58.160।।
explanation: "It was amazing to hear the words of the charanas. On hearing that Jankai had not been burnt, I understood that it is on her account (that he is also not burnt  although his tail was ignited.)

shloka_text: दीप्यमाने तु लाङ्गूले न मां दहति पावकः। हृदयं च प्रहृष्टं मे वातास्सुरभिगन्धिनः।।5.58.161।।
explanation: "My tail was burning but I was not burnt by fire. There was joy in my heart. The wind carried sweet fragrance.

shloka_text: तैर्निमित्तैश्च दृष्टाथै: कारणैश्च महागुणैः। ऋषिवाक्यैश्च सिद्धार्थैरभवं हृष्टमानसः।।5.58.162।।
explanation: "For these two auspicious signs and the highly propitious words uttered by the sages I felt glad at heart.

shloka_text: पुनर्दृष्ट्वा च वैदेहीं विसृष्टश्च तया पुनः। ततः पर्वतमासाद्य तत्रारिष्टमहं पुनः।।5.58.163।। प्रतिप्लवनमारेभे युष्मद्धर्शनकांक्षया।
explanation: Again, having seen Vaidehi and having been dismissed by her, I then reached the mountain. There, unharmed, I again began my return leap, desiring to see you all.

shloka_text: ततः पवनचन्द्रार्कसिद्धगन्धर्वसेवितम्।।5.58.164।। पन्थानमहमाक्रम्य भवतो दृष्टवानिह।
explanation: "Passing along the path of the Windgod, the Moon, the Sun, the siddhas and the gandharvas  I came to see you.

shloka_text: राघवस्य प्रभावेण भवतां चैव तेजसा।।5.58.165।। सुग्रीवस्य च कार्यार्थं मया सर्वमनुष्ठितम्।
explanation: "Everything was favourable to me by the power of Rama, by your goodwill and for the great purpose of Sugriva.

shloka_text: एतत्सर्वं मया तत्र यथावदुपपादितम्।।5.58.166।। अत्र यन्न कृतं शेषं तत्सर्वं क्रियतामिति।
explanation: "Let all that could not be done there and still remains to be done, be accomplished by you. I have presented the entire thing". इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे अष्टपञ्चाशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fiftyeighth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: एतदाख्याय तत्सर्वं हनुमान्मारुतात्मजः। भूयस्समुपचक्राम वचनं वक्तुमुत्तरम्।।5.59.1।।
explanation: Hanuman, son of the Windgod having narrated in detail all that had happened again started disclosing further details৷৷

shloka_text: सफलो राघवोद्योग स्सुग्रीवस्य च सम्भ्रमः। शीलमासाद्य सीताया मम च प्रवणं मनः।।5.59.2।।
explanation: "It is due to Rama's exertions, Sugriva's endeavour and Sita's conduct that I have been successful. My devotion to Sita has further deepened.

shloka_text: तपसा निर्दहेल्लोकान्क्रुद्धो वा निर्दहेदपि। सर्वधातिप्रवृद्धोऽसौ रावणो राक्षसाधिपः ॥ 5.59.3 ॥
explanation: "The demon king is rich in asceticism. He can burn the whole world with the power of his penance. In spite of Sita's anger he was not burnt(Hanuman gives the reason for Ravana's survival).

shloka_text: तस्य तां स्पृशतो गात्रं तपसा न विनाशितम्। न तदग्निशिखा कुर्यात्संस्पृष्टा पाणिना सती।।5.59.4।। जनकस्यात्मजा कुर्याद्यत्क्रोधकलुषीकृता।
explanation: "Sita can burn Ravana with the mere touch of her body but because of the power of his penance, he was not burnt even though he touched her hand. If enraged, Janaki can burn the whole world (by virtue of her chastity) in a way that even the flame of fire can not do. (But she desired that her husband should kill him.)

shloka_text: जाम्बवत्प्रमुखान् सर्वाननुज्ञाप्य महाहरीन्।।5.59.5।। अस्मिन्नेवं गते कार्ये भवतां च निवेदिते। न्याय्यं स्म सह वैदेह्या द्रष्टुं तौ पार्थिवात्मजौ।।5.59.6।।
explanation: Having taken leave of all the great monkeys, with Jambavan as their chief, now that this task has been accomplished and reported to you, it is indeed proper to see those two sons of the king along with Vaidehi.

shloka_text: जाम्बवत्प्रमुखान् सर्वाननुज्ञाप्य महाहरीन्।।5.59.5।। अस्मिन्नेवं गते कार्ये भवतां च निवेदिते। न्याय्यं स्म सह वैदेह्या द्रष्टुं तौ पार्थिवात्मजौ।।5.59.6।।
explanation: Having taken leave of all the great monkeys headed by Jambavan, and this task having been accomplished and reported to you, it is indeed proper to see those two sons of the king along with Vaidehi.

shloka_text: अहमेकोऽपि पर्याप्तस्सराक्षसगणां पुरीम्। तां लङ्कां तरसा हन्तुं रावणं च महाबलम्।।5.59.7।।
explanation: Even I alone am sufficient to swiftly destroy that city of Lanka, along with its demon hordes, and the mighty Ravana.

shloka_text: किं पुन स्सहितो वीरैर्बलवद्भिः कृतात्मभिः। कृतास्त्रै: प्लवगैश्शूरैर्भवद्भिविजयैषिभिः।।5.59.8।।
explanation: "When strong, wise and accomplished persons are there with me desiring victory  why speak again?

shloka_text: अहं तु रावणं युद्धे ससैन्यं सपुरस्सरम्। सहपुत्त्रं वधिष्यामि सहोदरयुतं युधि।।5.59.9।।
explanation: "I can also kill all the army,  his followers, sons and brothers of Ravana in war.

shloka_text: ब्राह्ममैन्द्रं च रौद्रं च वायव्यं वारणं तथा। यदि शक्रजितोऽस्त्राणि दुर्निरीक्षाणि संयुगे।।5.59.10।। तान्यहं वधिष्यामि हनिष्यामि च राक्षसान्।
explanation: "Even if the missiles used by Indrajit are Brahmastra, Indrastra, Rudrastra, Vayavastra, Varunastra which are difficult to see. I will destroy them in war and kill them.

shloka_text: भवतामभ्यनुज्ञातो विक्रमो मे रुणद्धि तम्।।5.59.11।। मयातुला विसृष्टा हि शैलवृष्टिर्निरन्तरा। देवानपि रणे हन्यात्किं पुनस्तान्निशाचरान्।।5.59.12।।
explanation: Now if I am permitted, I shall repulse them and destroy them with my valour. A  ceaseless shower of rocks sent forth by me in war is enough to destroy even gods what to say about the nightrangers?

shloka_text: भवतामभ्यनुज्ञातो विक्रमो मे रुणद्धि तम्।।5.59.11।। मयातुला विसृष्टा हि शैलवृष्टिर्निरन्तरा। देवानपि रणे हन्यात्किं पुनस्तान्निशाचरान्।।5.59.12।।
explanation: Now if I am permitted, I shall repulse them and destroy them with my valour. A  ceaseless shower of rocks sent forth by me in war is enough to destroy even gods what to say about the nightrangers?

shloka_text: सागरोऽप्यतियाद्वेलां मन्दरः प्रचलेदपि। न जाम्बवन्तं समरे कम्पयेदरिवाहिनी।।5.59.13।।
explanation: "The ocean may exceed its limits, the mountain Mandara may be shaken from its position but  no hostile army can move Jambavan in war.

shloka_text: सर्वराक्षससङ्घानां राक्षसा ये च पूर्वकाः। अलमेको विनाशाय वीरो वालिसुतः कपिः।।5.59.14।।
explanation: The heroic monkey, son of Vali, alone is sufficient for the destruction of all the hosts of Rākṣasas, and even those Rākṣasas who are ancient.

shloka_text: पनसस्योरुवेगेन नीलस्य च महात्मनः। मन्दरोऽप्यवशीर्येत किंपुनर्युधि राक्षसाः।।5.59.15।
explanation: "Even the mountain Mandara would be shattered by great Panasa or Nila by the speed of their thighs. What to say in a battle against ogres?

shloka_text: सदेवासुरयक्षेषु गन्धर्वोरगपक्षिषु। मैन्दस्य प्रतियोद्धारं शंसत द्विविदस्य वा।।5.59.16।।
explanation: "Who among gods, yakshas, gandharvas, nagas and birds can contend Mainda or Dvivida in battle?Tell me.

shloka_text: अश्विपुत्रौ महाभागावेतौ प्लवगसत्तमौ। एतयोः प्रतियोद्दारं न पश्यामि रणाजिरे।।5.59.17।।
explanation: "The (two) sons of Aswini are outstanding and foremost fighters and proud of waging war. Who can oppose them? I do not see any one.

shloka_text: पितामहवरोत्सेकात्परमं दर्पमास्थितौ। अमृतप्राशिनावेतौ सर्ववानरसत्तमौ।।5.59.18।।
explanation: "By virtue of the boons received from Brahma, they are very proud. They have also consumed nectar of immortality and are foremost among vanaras.

shloka_text: अश्विनोर्माननार्थं हि सर्वलोकपितामहः। सर्वावध्यत्वमतुलमनयोर्दत्तवान्पुरा।।5.59.19।।
explanation: "Earlier Brahma, the grandsire of all worlds has given the Aswini sons immeasurable invulnerability to honour them.

shloka_text: वरोत्सेकेन मत्तौ च प्रमथ्य महतीं चमूम्। सुराणाममृतं वीरौ पीतवन्तौ प्लवङ्गमौ।।5.59.20।।
explanation: "The heroic monkeys, proud of their boons became intoxicated it and slaughtered vast army and drank the nectar of immortality.

shloka_text: एतावेव हि सङ्कृद्धौ सवाजिरथकुञ्जराम्। लङ्कां नाशयितुं शक्तौ सर्वे तिष्ठन्तु वानराः।।5.59.21।।
explanation: "If these two become angry they have the power to destroy Lanka, the cavalry, chariots and also the elephants even if the vanaras stay away.

shloka_text: मयैव निहता लङ्का दग्धा भस्मीकृता पुनः। राजमार्गेषु सर्वत्र नाम विश्रावितं मया।।5.59.22।।
explanation: "I have burnt Lanka and have made my name popular even on the highways.

shloka_text: जयत्यतिबलो रामो लक्ष्मणश्च महाबलः। राजा जयति सुग्रीवो राघवेणाभिपालितः।।5.59.23।। अहं कोसलराजस्य दासः पवनसम्भवः। हनुमानिति सर्वत्र नाम विश्रावितं मया।।5.59.24।।
explanation: "Mighty Rama and Lakshmana and King Sugriva protected by Rama are renowned for their valour. I am Hanuman, son of the Windgod, a servant of Rama. This I announced.

shloka_text: जयत्यतिबलो रामो लक्ष्मणश्च महाबलः। राजा जयति सुग्रीवो राघवेणाभिपालितः।।5.59.23।। अहं कोसलराजस्य दासः पवनसम्भवः। हनुमानिति सर्वत्र नाम विश्रावितं मया।।5.59.24।।
explanation: "Mighty Rama and Lakshmana and King Sugriva protected by Rama are renowned for their valour. I am Hanuman, son of the Windgod, a servant of Rama. This I announced.

shloka_text: अशोकवनिकामध्ये रावणस्य दुरात्मनः। अध स्ताच्छिंशुपावृक्षे साध्वी करुणमास्थिता।।5.59.25।। राक्षसीभिः परिवृता शोकसंतापकर्शिता। मेघलेखापरिवृता चन्द्रलेखेव निष्प्रभा।।5.59.26।।। अचिन्तयन्ती वैदेही रावणं बलदर्पितम्।
explanation: "In the wicked, Ravana's Ashoka garden under the Simsupa tree the noble lady Sita surrounded by ogresses, is sitting, tormented by tears. Her brightness is like the Moon's, veiled by flakes of clouds. She does not care for Ravana's glory. She is brooding over Rama only.

shloka_text: अशोकवनिकामध्ये रावणस्य दुरात्मनः। अध स्ताच्छिंशुपावृक्षे साध्वी करुणमास्थिता।।5.59.25।। राक्षसीभिः परिवृता शोकसंतापकर्शिता। मेघलेखापरिवृता चन्द्रलेखेव निष्प्रभा।।5.59.26।।। अचिन्तयन्ती वैदेही रावणं बलदर्पितम्।
explanation: "In the wicked, Ravana's Ashoka garden under the Simsupa tree the noble lady Sita surrounded by ogresses, is sitting, tormented by tears. Her brightness is like the Moon's, veiled by flakes of clouds. She does not care for Ravana's glory. She is brooding over Rama only.

shloka_text: पतिव्रता च सुश्रोणी अवष्टब्धा च जानकी।।5.59.27।। अनुरक्ता हि वैदेही रामं सर्वात्मना शुभा। अनन्यचित्ता रामे च पौलोमीव पुरन्दरे।।5.59.28।।
explanation: "Chaste Sita of beautiful hips, an auspicious lady though bound is wholly devoted to Rama alone like Sachi, the wife of Indra who was bound by Nahusha.

shloka_text: पतिव्रता च सुश्रोणी अवष्टब्धा च जानकी।।5.59.27।। अनुरक्ता हि वैदेही रामं सर्वात्मना शुभा। अनन्यचित्ता रामे च पौलोमीव पुरन्दरे।।5.59.28।।
explanation: "Chaste Sita of beautiful hips, an auspicious lady though bound is wholly devoted to Rama alone like Sachi, the wife of Indra who was bound by Nahusha.

shloka_text: तदेकवासस्संवीता रजोध्वस्ता तथैव च। शोकसन्तापदीनाङ्गी सीता भर्तृहिते रता।।5.59.29।।
explanation: "Wearing the same single cloth which she had worn before, filled with dust, Sita remained sorrowful and piteous wishing her husband's welfare.

shloka_text: सा मया राक्षसीमध्ये तर्ज्यमाना मुहुर्मुहुः। राक्षसीभिर्विरूपाभिर्दृष्टा हि प्रमदावने।।5.59.30।। एकवेणीधरा दीना भर्तृचिन्तापरायणा। अधश्शय्या विवर्णाङ्गी पद्मिनीव हिमागमे।।5.59.31।। रावणाद्विनिवृत्तार्था मर्तव्यकृतनिश्चया।
explanation: "I saw Sita often threatened by uglylooking ogresses. Wearing a single braid, she looked pathetic, thinking always about her husband, lying on the bare ground. She was like a lustreless lotus in winter. Spurning the advances by Ravana, she is rather determined to commit suicide.

shloka_text: सा मया राक्षसीमध्ये तर्ज्यमाना मुहुर्मुहुः। राक्षसीभिर्विरूपाभिर्दृष्टा हि प्रमदावने।।5.59.30।। एकवेणीधरा दीना भर्तृचिन्तापरायणा। अधश्शय्या विवर्णाङ्गी पद्मिनीव हिमागमे।।5.59.31।। रावणाद्विनिवृत्तार्था मर्तव्यकृतनिश्चया।
explanation: "I saw Sita often threatened by uglylooking ogresses. Wearing a single braid, she looked pathetic, thinking always about her husband, lying on the bare ground. She was like a lustreless lotus in winter. Spurning the advances by Ravana, she is rather determined to commit suicide.

shloka_text: कथञ्चिन्मृगशाबाक्षी विश्वासमुपपादिता।।5.59.32।। ततः संभाषिता चैव सर्वमर्थं च दर्शिता। रामसुग्रीवसख्यं च श्रुत्वा प्रीतिमुपागता।।5.59.33।।
explanation: "I created a little confidence in the fawneyed lady by pacifying her and explaining her with great difficulty the alliance of Rama and Sugriva on hearing which she became happy.

shloka_text: कथञ्चिन्मृगशाबाक्षी विश्वासमुपपादिता।।5.59.32।। ततः संभाषिता चैव सर्वमर्थं च दर्शिता। रामसुग्रीवसख्यं च श्रुत्वा प्रीतिमुपागता।।5.59.33।।
explanation: "I created a little confidence in the fawneyed lady by pacifying her and explaining her with great difficulty the alliance of Rama and Sugriva on hearing which she became happy.

shloka_text: नियतस्समुदाचारो भक्तिर्भर्तरि चोत्तमा। यन्न हन्ति दशग्रीवं सा महात्मा कृतागसम्।।5.59.34।।
explanation: "Ravana is a great soul because, even though he has done harm to her, he is not killed. This is because Sita being a chaste woman of good conduct and deep devotion towards her husband (she refrained from killing Ravana as she wanted her husband to do that.)

shloka_text: निमित्तमात्रं रामस्तु वधे तस्य भविष्यति। सा प्रकृत्यैव तन्वङ्गी तद्वियोगाच्च कर्शिता।।5.59.35।। प्रतिपत्पाठशीलस्य विद्येव तनुमतां गता।
explanation: "To Rama, killing Ravana is easy (since Ravana's power of penance has already declined by his abduction of Sita). Separated from her husband she is naturally emaciated. She has become slender just like a student on the new Moon day (on the first day of study).

shloka_text: एवमास्ते महाभागा सीता शोकपरायणा।।5.59.36।। यदत्र प्रतिकर्तव्यं तत्सर्वमुपपाद्यताम्।
explanation: "Noble Sita is absorbed in grief. Let us do all that has to be done now." इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे एकोनषष्टितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fiftyninth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा वालिसूनुरभाषत। अयुक्तं तु विना देवीं दृष्टवद्भिश्च वानराः।।5.60.1।। समीपं गन्तुमस्माभी राघवस्य महात्मनः।
explanation: After hearing Hanuman,  Vali's son said" O vanaras (Hanuman) having seen Sita it is not proper on our part to go without Sita to the great soul Rama.

shloka_text: दृष्टा देवी न चानीता इति तत्र निवेदनम्।।5.60.2।। अयुक्तमिव पश्यामि भवद्भिः ख्यातविक्रमैः।
explanation: "O vanaras, you are known for your valour. I think, to tell Rama that we have seen Sita but not brought her is not proper".

shloka_text: न हि नः प्लवने कश्चिन्नापि कश्चित्पराक्रमे।।5.60.3।। तुल्य स्सामरदैत्येषु लोकेषु हरिसत्तमाः।
explanation: "O noble vanaras Indeed either among gods or among demons there is none who can match the vanaras in leaping and exhibiting valour.

shloka_text: तेष्वेवं हतवीरेषु राक्षसेषु हनूमता।।5.60.4।। किमन्यदत्र कर्तव्यं गृहीत्वा याम जानकीम्।
explanation: "Hence, having killed the heroes among ogres what other task has Hanuman to do? Let us get Sita.

shloka_text: तमेवं कृतसङ्कल्पं जाम्बवान् हरिसत्तमः।।5.60.5।। उवाच परमप्रीतो वाक्यमर्थवदर्थवित्।
explanation: "Jambavan, the noble vanara, skilled in the execution of tasks thus commanded in a determined manner:

shloka_text: न तावदेषा मतिरक्षमा नो यथा भवान् पश्यति राजपुत्र। यथा तु रामस्य मतिर्निविष्टा तथा भवान् पश्यतु कार्यसिद्धिम्।।5.60.6।।
explanation: "O prince what you think is  acceptable to us also. Even though we are capable of achieving, knowing what is in Rama's mind, we should act only according to his command to accomplish the task. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे षष्टितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the sixtieth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramyana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: ततो जाम्बवतो वाक्यमगृह्णन्त वनौकसः। अङ्गदप्रमुखा वीरा हनुमांश्च महाकपिः।।5.61.1।।
explanation: In the midst of all the leaders of the monkeys including Angada, Hanuman accepted Jambavan's advice.

shloka_text: प्रीतिमन्तस्ततः सर्वे वायुपुत्रपरस्पराः। महेन्द्राद्रिं परित्यज्य पुप्लुवुः प्लवगर्षभाः।।5.61.2।। मेरुमन्दरसङ्काशा मत्ता इव महागजाः। छादयन्त इवाकाशं महाकाया महाबलाः।।5.61.3।। सभाज्यमानं भूतैस्तमात्मवन्तं महाबलम्। हनूमन्तं महावेगं वहन्त इव दृष्टिभिः।।5.61.4।। राघवे चार्थनिर्ववृत्तिं कर्तुं च परमं यशः। समाधाय समृद्धार्थाः सर्वेसिद्धिभिरुन्नता।।5.61.5।। प्रियाख्यानोन्मुखाः सर्वे सर्वे युद्धाभिनन्दिनः। सर्वे रामप्रतीकारे निश्चितार्था मनस्स्विनः।।5.61.6।।
explanation: Thereafter led by Hanuman, all the vanaras left Mahendra mountain and marched very happily. The vanaras were strong and huge like elephants and resembled mountain Meru. Moreover when they leaped up they seemed to cover the sky (so it was difficult to tell their numbers). Since Hanuman had accomplished the task, the vanaras were praising his strength, his swiftness and courage. They were looking at Hanuman without blinking their eyes, and seemed as though they were carrying him by their eyes. They were determined in their minds to please Rama. Remaining in a state of offering themselves, some of them more accomplished than others, collected together eager to wage war and talking pleasantly among themselves having resolved to assist Rama.

shloka_text: प्रीतिमन्तस्ततः सर्वे वायुपुत्रपरस्पराः। महेन्द्राद्रिं परित्यज्य पुप्लुवुः प्लवगर्षभाः।।5.61.2।। मेरुमन्दरसङ्काशा मत्ता इव महागजाः। छादयन्त इवाकाशं महाकाया महाबलाः।।5.61.3।। सभाज्यमानं भूतैस्तमात्मवन्तं महाबलम्। हनूमन्तं महावेगं वहन्त इव दृष्टिभिः।।5.61.4।। राघवे चार्थनिर्ववृत्तिं कर्तुं च परमं यशः। समाधाय समृद्धार्थाः सर्वेसिद्धिभिरुन्नता।।5.61.5।। प्रियाख्यानोन्मुखाः सर्वे सर्वे युद्धाभिनन्दिनः। सर्वे रामप्रतीकारे निश्चितार्था मनस्स्विनः।।5.61.6।।
explanation: Thereafter led by Hanuman, all the vanaras left Mahendra mountain and marched very happily. The vanaras were strong and huge like elephants and resembled mountain Meru. Moreover when they leaped up they seemed to cover the sky (so it was difficult to tell their numbers). Since Hanuman had accomplished the task, the vanaras were praising his strength, his swiftness and courage. They were looking at Hanuman without blinking their eyes, and seemed as though they were carrying him by their eyes. They were determined in their minds to please Rama. Remaining in a state of offering themselves, some of them more accomplished than others, collected together eager to wage war and talking pleasantly among themselves having resolved to assist Rama.

shloka_text: प्रीतिमन्तस्ततः सर्वे वायुपुत्रपरस्पराः। महेन्द्राद्रिं परित्यज्य पुप्लुवुः प्लवगर्षभाः।।5.61.2।। मेरुमन्दरसङ्काशा मत्ता इव महागजाः। छादयन्त इवाकाशं महाकाया महाबलाः।।5.61.3।। सभाज्यमानं भूतैस्तमात्मवन्तं महाबलम्। हनूमन्तं महावेगं वहन्त इव दृष्टिभिः।।5.61.4।। राघवे चार्थनिर्ववृत्तिं कर्तुं च परमं यशः। समाधाय समृद्धार्थाः सर्वेसिद्धिभिरुन्नता।।5.61.5।। प्रियाख्यानोन्मुखाः सर्वे सर्वे युद्धाभिनन्दिनः। सर्वे रामप्रतीकारे निश्चितार्था मनस्स्विनः।।5.61.6।।
explanation: Thereafter led by Hanuman, all the vanaras left Mahendra mountain and marched very happily. The vanaras were strong and huge like elephants and resembled mountain Meru. Moreover when they leaped up they seemed to cover the sky (so it was difficult to tell their numbers). Since Hanuman had accomplished the task, the vanaras were praising his strength, his swiftness and courage. They were looking at Hanuman without blinking their eyes, and seemed as though they were carrying him by their eyes. They were determined in their minds to please Rama. Remaining in a state of offering themselves, some of them more accomplished than others, collected together eager to wage war and talking pleasantly among themselves having resolved to assist Rama.

Moreover when they leaped up they seemed to cover the sky (so it was difficult to tell their numbers). Since Hanuman had accomplished the task, the vanaras were praising his strength, his swiftness and courage. They were looking at Hanuman without blinking their eyes, and seemed as though they were carrying him by their eyes. They were determined in their minds to please Rama. Remaining in a state of offering themselves, some of them more accomplished than others, collected together eager to wage war and talking pleasantly among themselves having resolved to assist Rama.

shloka_text: प्लवमानाः खमाप्लुत्य ततस्ते काननौकसः। नन्दनोपमयासेदुर्वनं द्रुमलतायुतम्।।5.61.7।।
explanation: "The monkeys leaped into the sky and entered the garden that resembled the garden of Indra filled with trees and creepers.

shloka_text: यत्तन्मधुवनं नाम सुग्रीवस्याभिरक्षितम्। अधृष्यं सर्वभूतानां सर्वभूतमनोहरम्।।5.61.8।।
explanation: The Madhuvanam of Sugriva was wellprotected  and was difficult to access for the vanaras. It was enchating to all beings.

shloka_text: यद्रक्षति महावीर्य स्सदा दधिमुखः कपिः। मातुलः कपिमुख्यस्य सुग्रीवस्य महात्मनः।।5.61.9।।
explanation: Dadhimukha, the foremost of all monkeys, of great valour and the maternal uncle of Sugriva was the caretaker of  the garden.

shloka_text: ते तद्वनमुपागम्य बभूवुः परमोत्कटाः। वानरा वानरेन्द्रस्य मनः कान्ततमं महत्।।5.61.10।।
explanation: On reaching the vanara king's extensive, delightful garden all the vanaras highly rejoiced.

shloka_text: ततस्ते वानरा हृष्टा दृष्टवा मधुवनं महत्। कुमारमभ्ययाचन्त मधूनि मधुपिङ्गलाः।।5.61.11।।
explanation: The honeycoloured monkeys felt happy on seeing the Madhuvanam and sought Angada's permission to drink honey.

shloka_text: ततः कुमारस्तान् वृद्धान् जाम्बवत्प्रमुखान् कपीन्। अनुमान्य ददौ तेषां विसर्गं मधुभिक्षणे।।5.61.12।।
explanation: Young Angada asked old Jambavan's permission for the vanaras to drink honey and Jambavan permitted them.

shloka_text: ततश्चानुमता स्सर्वे सम्प्रहृष्टा वनौकसः। मुदिताः प्रेरिताश्चापि प्रनृत्यन्तोऽभवंस्तदा।।5.61.13।।
explanation: Permitted thus to drink honey the forestdwelling monkeys were motivated. They rejoiced very happily and started dancing.

shloka_text: गायन्ति केचित्प्रणमन्ति केचिन्नृत्यन्ति केचित्प्रहसन्ति केचित्। पतन्ति केचिद्विचरन्ति केचित्ल्पवन्ति केचित्प्रलपन्ति केचित्।।5.61.14।।
explanation: Some sang, some prostrated on the ground, some danced, while some laughed, some jumped from the tree, some roamed about and some jumped up and down.

shloka_text: परस्परं केचिदुपाश्रयन्ते परस्परं केचिदुपाक्रमन्ते। परस्परं केचिदुपब्रुवन्ते परस्परं केचिदुपारमन्ते।।5.61.15।।
explanation: While some supported one another, some held each other, some exchanged secrets with one another, some entertained one another.

shloka_text: द्रुमाद्द्रुमं केचिदभिद्रवन्ते क्षितौ नगाग्रान्निपतन्ति केचित्। महीतलात्केचिदुदीर्णवेगा महाद्रुमाग्राण्यभिसम्पतन्ति।।5.61.16।।
explanation: While some ran from one tree to another, some jumped down from broken branches, and some swiftfooted ones fell down from the top of trees.

shloka_text: गायन्तमन्यः प्रहसन्नुपैति हसन्तमन्यः प्ररुदन्नुपैति। रुदन्तमन्यः प्रणुदन्नुपैति नुदन्तमन्यः प्रणदन्नुपैति।।5.61.17।।
explanation: While one was singing, others approached him laughing while some were laughing others fell on them laughing excessively. While some were roaring, others went pushing them down. While some were encouraged to do something others shouted at them.

shloka_text: समाकुलं तत्कपिसैन्यमासीन्मधुप्रसानोत्कटसत्त्वचेष्टम्। न चात्र कश्चिन्न बभूव मत्तो न चात्र कश्चिन्न बभूव तृप्तः।।5.61.18।।
